title: Connections: ConnectionsDelegate columns, cells and tooltips
description:
## Context
`ConnectionsDelegate`: the `TreeTableDelegate` and `SysDelegate` for the Connections table. It defines the P2 columns (six default, nine optional), the State labels and colours, the PID and Process cells with the shared-socket, kernel-owned and restricted cases, and the tooltips. The page entity is E28-021. The P4 columns Remote host and Namespace are E28-028 and E28-029. Sources: UI-SYS-002, UI-SYS-003 (connection state colours), UI-SYS-061, UI-SYS-062, SYS-029, SYS-030, SYS-036, R-011, ADR-003 (Restricted glyph), ADR-009 (text cache), canonical table (d), E27-A1 API.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/delegate.rs` (new; `mod delegate;` in `pages/connections/mod.rs`):
- `pub struct ConnectionsDelegate { conns: Option<Arc<ConnectionsSnapshot>>, procs: Option<Arc<ProcessSnapshot>>, rows: Arc<[SysRow]>, query_generation: u64, header: ComponentHeader, text: CellTextCache }` implementing `TreeTableDelegate` and `SysDelegate`: `mask()` = `ComponentMask::CONNECTIONS | ComponentMask::PROCESSES`; `install` takes `snap.connections` and `snap.processes` (owner names and icons by `ProcessKey`).
- Row ids `SysNodeId::Conn(cookie)`; all rows `RowKind::Plain`, depth 0, not expandable, selectable; `HeaderLines::One`.
- Columns (`[columns.connections]` ids), widths in logical px:

  | Id | Header | Default width | Min width | Align | Default |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | `proto` | "Proto" | 90 | 60 | left | visible |
  | `local` | "Address local" | 260 | 120 | left, `tnum` | visible |
  | `foreign` | "Address foreign" | 260 | 120 | left, `tnum` | visible |
  | `state` | "State" | 120 | 90 | left | visible |
  | `pid` | "PID" | 80 | width of "999999 +99" | right, `tnum` | visible |
  | `process` | "Process" | 180 | 60 | left | visible |
  | `user` | "User" | 120 | 60 | left | hidden |
  | `family` | "Family" | 70 | 60 | left | hidden |
  | `local_port` | "Local port" | 90 | width of "99999" | right | hidden |
  | `foreign_port` | "Foreign port" | 90 | width of "99999" | right | hidden |
  | `recv_q` | "Recv-Q" | 80 | width of "999999" | right | hidden |
  | `send_q` | "Send-Q" | 80 | width of "999999" | right | hidden |
  | `interface` | "Interface" | 100 | 60 | left | hidden |
  | `inode` | "Inode" | 100 | width of "9999999999" | right | hidden |
  | `service` | "Service" | 200 | 60 | left | hidden |

- Default sort `proto` ascending, then local port ascending (R-011; the engine sorts: addresses by family, address bytes, then port; State in the order LISTENING, SYN-SENT, SYN-RECEIVED, ESTABLISHED, FIN-WAIT-1, FIN-WAIT-2, CLOSE-WAIT, CLOSING, LAST-ACK, TIME-WAIT, CLOSED, UNKNOWN, UNCONNECTED, CONNECTED; PID "?" and "-" after all numbers).
- Cells:
  - `proto`: "TCP" or "UDP". `family`: "IPv4" or "IPv6".
  - `local`, `foreign`: the engine-formatted `Arc<str>` (`a.b.c.d:port`, `[v6%scope]:port`, `0.0.0.0:*`, `[::]:*`, `*:*`; IPv4-mapped IPv6 in IPv4 form) used without copying.
  - `state`: label from the kernel state: LISTEN "LISTENING", SYN_SENT "SYN-SENT", SYN_RECV and NEW_SYN_RECV "SYN-RECEIVED", ESTABLISHED "ESTABLISHED", FIN_WAIT1 "FIN-WAIT-1", FIN_WAIT2 "FIN-WAIT-2", CLOSE_WAIT "CLOSE-WAIT", CLOSING "CLOSING", LAST_ACK "LAST-ACK", TIME_WAIT "TIME-WAIT", CLOSE "CLOSED", other "UNKNOWN"; UDP "UNCONNECTED" or "CONNECTED". No dot. Colour `tone_color(conn_state_tone(class), theme, selected)` with classes Listening (LISTENING), Established (ESTABLISHED), Transitional (SYN-SENT, SYN-RECEIVED, FIN-WAIT-1, FIN-WAIT-2, CLOSE-WAIT, CLOSING, LAST-ACK), TimeWaitOrClosed (TIME-WAIT, CLOSED), Unknown (UNKNOWN), Udp (UNCONNECTED, CONNECTED).
  - `pid` and `process`: normal: "4321" and icon 16 plus display name; shared socket (several owners): "4321 +2" with " +2" in `text_secondary`, owner shown is the one with the lowest PID; kernel-owned (inode 0, for example TIME-WAIT): "-" in `text_secondary` and "No owner (kernel)" in `text_secondary` with no icon; other user's socket not resolved (`owner_validity` Restricted): "?" in `text_secondary` and the 12 px lock icon (ADR-003 Restricted glyph) in `text_secondary`. Never blank, never 0.
  - `user`: user name of the socket uid. `local_port`, `foreign_port`: port numbers, foreign empty for `*`. `recv_q`, `send_q`: counts with U+2009 grouping. `interface`: interface name, empty for index 0. `inode`: integer without grouping. `service`: owning unit id, empty when none.
- Tooltips (500 ms; the PID and Process cells): shared socket: one line per owner "PID <n>  <name>" (two spaces), at most 16 lines, then "and <m> more"; unresolved: "Owned by <user>. Needs the tasklens helper to identify the process".
- Accessible row name "<Proto> <local> to <foreign>, <State>, <Process>".
- `on_activate` (Enter, Alt+Enter, Ctrl+I, double-click) dispatches `OpenProperties`.
- Records read: `ConnectionsSnapshot.records[i]` with `cookie`, `proto`, `family`, `local`, `foreign`, `state`, `owners: SmallVec<[ProcessKey; 1]>`, `owner_validity`, `uid`, `inode`, `ifindex`, `recv_q`, `send_q`, `unit: Option<UnitRef>`, `tcp: Option<TcpInfoView>` (UI-SYS-062), plus the display fields of open item B8-E28-13.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** the delegate **When** `columns()` is read **Then** the six default columns are visible in the order above and the nine optional ones are hidden, with the widths above.
- **Given** a socket owned by PIDs 4321, 4400 and 5000 **When** rendered **Then** PID shows "4321 +2", Process shows PID 4321's name, and the tooltip lists three "PID <n>  <name>" lines.
- **Given** a socket with 20 owners **When** the tooltip is built **Then** it has 16 owner lines and "and 4 more".
- **Given** a TIME-WAIT socket with inode 0 **When** rendered **Then** PID is "-" and Process is "No owner (kernel)" in `text_secondary` with no icon.
- **Given** a socket with `owner_validity` Restricted and uid of user "bob" **When** rendered **Then** PID is "?", Process is the lock glyph, and the tooltip is "Owned by bob. Needs the tasklens helper to identify the process".
- **Given** states LISTEN, NEW_SYN_RECV, CLOSE and an unknown code **When** rendered **Then** the labels are "LISTENING" (`status.info`), "SYN-RECEIVED", "CLOSED" (`text_secondary`) and "UNKNOWN" (`status.warning`).
- **Given** recv_q 123456 **When** rendered **Then** the cell is "123 456" with U+2009; **given** inode 1234567 **then** "1234567".
- **Given** two snapshots with the same cookies in a new order **When** the second is installed **Then** row ids are unchanged per cookie.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/delegate.rs`: create
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/mod.rs`: change (`mod delegate;`)
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_connections.rs`: create with the tests below
- `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: append `connections-column-*`, `connections-state-*`, `connections-owner-*` keys

## Tests
- `ui_connections::connections_columns_default_and_optional`.
- `ui_connections::conn_row_shared_pid_plus_n` and `conn_shared_tooltip_cap_16`.
- `ui_connections::conn_row_kernel_owner`.
- `ui_connections::conn_row_restricted_lock` (security: never "0" or blank for an unresolved owner).
- `ui_connections::conn_state_labels_and_tones`.
- `ui_connections::conn_counts_grouping_and_inode`.
- `ui_connections::conn_row_ids_stable_by_cookie`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A
- Validity: `owner_validity` Restricted shows "?" and the lock glyph; stale component draws text in `text_secondary`.
- Accessibility: row name as above; tooltips on PID and Process.
- Performance: addresses are shared `Arc<str>` from the engine (no formatting per refresh); other cells go through `CellTextCache`; no allocation per frame.
- Privacy: addresses and process names are shown only; never logged.

- `ColumnId` must carry these connection ids (open item B8-E28-11).

title: Connections: ConnectionsPage entity, status text, refresh and actions
description:
## Context
`ConnectionsPage`: the Connections tab entity on E27's `SysTableFrame` with `ConnectionsDelegate` (E28-020). It wires snapshots (connections and processes), the engine-side filter, demand, first-visit refresh, the skeleton and empty states, the status text, F5 refresh, Ctrl-pause and the page Actions. Sources: UI-SYS-001, UI-SYS-002, UI-SYS-004, UI-SYS-005, UI-SYS-060, UI-SYS-067, SYS-028, SYS-036, R-042, R-060, APP-029, UI-SHL-050, R-128.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/actions.rs` (new; `pub mod actions;` in `mod.rs`): unit Actions in namespace `tasklens`: `ConnectionCopyLocal`, `ConnectionCopyForeign`, `ConnectionCloseTcp`, `ConnectionJumpToProcess`, `ConnectionGoToService`; `pub fn bind_keys_connections(cx: &mut App)` which binds nothing in P2 (table (b) has no ConnectionTable row; the shared `Table` keys apply) and exists for later phases.

`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/mod.rs`:
- `pub struct ConnectionsPage { frame: SysTableFrame<ConnectionsDelegate>, status_buf: String, last_status: (u32, u32, u32, u32, u32, usize), refresh: Option<(u64, Task<()>)>, menu_targets: Option<ConnMenuTargets>, _subs: SmallVec<[Subscription; 3]> }` with `pub fn new(hub, demand, client, window, cx)` creating the frame with `SysTableFrame::new(Tab::Connections, "ConnectionTable", &[SourceId::Connections], ConnectionsDelegate::new(..), SortSpec { column: proto, ascending: true }, None, window, cx)`.
- Subscribes to `SnapshotChanged` (frame.on_snapshot, notify on true) and `FilterChanged { tab: Tab::Connections, text }` (frame.on_filter_changed; the engine filters case-insensitive substrings over Proto, both addresses with ports as shown, State, PID, Process and User).
- `set_active`: frame.on_activated / on_deactivated (`Demand.connections`; first visit sends `RefreshNow(SourceId::Connections)`).
- Render: `frame.render(None, Box::new(ClearFilter), ..)`.
- Status text: "Loading…" while the body is `Skeleton`; otherwise "<total> Total | <tcp> TCP | <udp> UDP | <est> EST | <listen> LISTEN" from `ConnectionsSnapshot.counts { total, tcp, udp, established, listening }` (EST and LISTEN count TCP only; counts follow the filter), U+2009 grouping, then " | <n> selected" when 2 or more rows are selected (open item B8-E28-8). `StatusChanged` only on change.
- F5 (`RefreshCurrentTab` while active): `frame.refresh` (sends `RefreshNow(SourceId::Connections)`), then the Info toast "Connections refreshed." when the next connections `header.version` arrives or 2 s after the request, whichever is first.
- Ctrl held with the main window active: the frame shows the paused snapshot (R-042); rows that appear or disappear are not highlighted.

- **Given** Ctrl held **When** a new connections snapshot arrives **Then** the rows do not change until Ctrl is released.
- **Given** F5 and no new version **When** 2 s pass **Then** "Connections refreshed." shows once.
- **Given** the filter "443" **When** `FilterChanged` arrives **Then** a `SetSysTableQuery` with filter "443" and a new generation is sent.

title: Connections: row context menu (P2 items)
description:
## Context
The Connections row context menu (P2 items): order, enable and show rules, disabled tooltips and target capture at menu open. Handlers are E28-023 (copy), E28-024 (jump, go to service) and E28-025 (Properties). "Close TCP connection" is added in P3 by E28-026. Sources: UI-SYS-063, UI-SYS-006, SYS-032, SYS-033, SYS-010, R-012, R-050 (Restricted tooltip), R-091, UI-FND-022, ADR-009 (menu bound to captured keys).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/menu.rs` (new; `mod menu;` in `mod.rs`):
- `pub struct ConnMenuTargets { pub cookies: SmallVec<[u64; 1]>, pub records: SmallVec<[ConnRecordRef; 1]>, pub cell: Option<(u64, ColumnId)> }`, captured when the menu opens (right-click selects the row first if not selected; Shift+F10 and the Menu key use the selection with `cell = None`). `ConnRecordRef` holds the captured record values the handlers need (cookie, proto, family, four-tuple, state, owners, owner validity, unit, local and foreign text). Every Connection action handler uses `menu_targets.take()` when present, else the selection read at command time.
- `ConnectionsDelegate::context_menu` builds a `TlMenu` with min width 220, items in this order:

  | # | Label | Key hint | Action | Shown / enabled |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | 1 | "Copy" | | `CopyCell { col }` | shown only when opened by right-click on a cell |
  | 2 | "Copy row" | Ctrl+C | `CopyDetails` | always |
  | 3 | "Copy rows as table" | Ctrl+Shift+C | `CopyRowsAsTable` | always |
  | 4 | "Copy local address" | | `ConnectionCopyLocal` | enabled for exactly one target |
  | 5 | "Copy foreign address" | | `ConnectionCopyForeign` | enabled for exactly one target whose foreign side is not `*:*` |
  | | separator | | | |
  | 7 | "Jump to process" | | `ConnectionJumpToProcess` | enabled for exactly one target with an owner; no owner: disabled with tooltip "No owning process for this connection"; owner Restricted: disabled with tooltip "Needs administrator access." |
  | 8 | "Go to service" | | `ConnectionGoToService` | shown only for one target whose record has `unit: Some(..)` |
  | 9 | "Properties" | Enter | `OpenProperties` | always |

  (Item 6 "Close TCP connection" and its separator are added by E28-026 in P3; in P2 there is one separator between items 5 and 7.)

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a right-click on an ESTABLISHED socket owned by a process in a systemd unit **When** the menu opens **Then** the labels in order are "Copy", "Copy row", "Copy rows as table", "Copy local address", "Copy foreign address", separator, "Jump to process", "Go to service", "Properties".
- **Given** a LISTENING socket (`*:*` foreign) **When** the menu opens **Then** "Copy foreign address" is disabled.
- **Given** a kernel-owned TIME-WAIT socket **When** the menu opens **Then** "Jump to process" is disabled with tooltip "No owning process for this connection" and "Go to service" is not shown.
- **Given** an unresolved socket of another user **When** the menu opens **Then** "Jump to process" is disabled with tooltip "Needs administrator access.".
- **Given** two rows selected **When** the menu opens **Then** items 4, 5 and 7 are disabled and item 8 is hidden.
- **Given** the menu opened on cookie 77 **When** a refresh reorders rows before an item is clicked **Then** the action targets cookie 77.
- **Given** P2 build **When** any menu opens **Then** no "Close TCP connection" item is present.

title: Connections: copy commands
description:
## Context
Copy commands of the Connections tab: the "Copy row" block, "Copy rows as table", "Copy" (cell) through E27's `sys_copy.rs`, and the two connection-only items "Copy local address" and "Copy foreign address". Sources: UI-SYS-066, UI-SYS-063, UI-SYS-006, SYS-032, R-012, ADR-015 (exports).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/copy.rs` (new; `mod copy;` in `mod.rs`):
- `impl SysCopySource for ConnectionsPage` with `RowId = u64` (cookie):
  - `write_block`, exactly these eight lines (no trailing newline):
    ```
    Protocol: <TCP or UDP>
    Local address: <address without port>
    Local port: <port, or * >
    Foreign address: <address without port>
    Foreign port: <port, or * >
    State: <state label>
    PID: <pid>
    Process: <name>
    ```
    Addresses are written without the port and IPv6 without brackets (scope kept, for example "fe80::1%enp6s0"). A `*` port prints "*"; a wildcard foreign side prints "Foreign address: *" and "Foreign port: *". Shared sockets print every owner PID comma-separated ("PID: 4321, 4400, 5000") and the lowest-PID owner's name. Kernel-owned: "PID: -" and "Process: No owner (kernel)". Unresolved other-user socket: "PID: ?" and "Process: Restricted" (open item B8-E28-14).

title: Connections: Jump to process and Go to service
description:
## Context
"Jump to process" and "Go to service" from the Connections tab. Jump uses the Processes page's shared jump entry point (E22-A3, PROC-071) with the owner's `ProcessKey`; Go to service uses the Services page's arrival entry (E27-A2, UI-SYS-021). Sources: UI-SYS-065, UI-SYS-063, SYS-033, SYS-032, SYS-010, PROC-071, UI-PRC-022, UI-SYS-021.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/flows.rs` (new; `mod flows;` in `mod.rs`):
- `ConnectionJumpToProcess` handler (one target): owner = the owner with the lowest PID when the socket is shared. No owner (kernel-owned): Warning toast "No owning process for this connection", nothing else. Otherwise call the E22-A3 entry point `ProcessesPage::select_by_key(key, source)` (reached the way E22-A3 exposes it to other pages, with the Connections source value it defines) with these caller texts: success "Switched to owning process."; present but hidden by the filter or Hide system "Owning process not visible in the current process view." with the "Show" button; not in the view (exited) "Process not found in current view".
- `ConnectionGoToService` handler (one target with `unit: Some(u)`): dispatches the Services arrival entry of E27-A2 (`GoToService` routed by the main window to `ServicesPage::select_unit(u, JumpOrigin::Connections, cx)`); the Services page shows its own toasts ("Switched to Services tab", "Switched to service.", "Service not found in current view").
- Both use `menu_targets` when present, else the selection (exactly one row; otherwise nothing happens).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a socket owned by PIDs 5000 and 4321 **When** "Jump to process" runs **Then** `select_by_key` receives PID 4321's `ProcessKey`.
- **Given** the owner is visible in the process view **When** the jump completes **Then** the Processes tab is active, the row is selected and the toast is "Switched to owning process.".
- **Given** the owner is hidden by the process filter **When** the jump runs **Then** the toast "Owning process not visible in the current process view." with "Show" appears.
- **Given** the owner exited **When** the jump runs **Then** the toast is "Process not found in current view".
- **Given** a kernel-owned socket and the keyboard path **When** `ConnectionJumpToProcess` runs **Then** the toast "No owning process for this connection" shows and the tab does not change.
- **Given** a socket whose owner is in `sshd.service` **When** "Go to service" runs **Then** the Services tab is active with `sshd.service` selected.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/flows.rs`: create
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/mod.rs`: change (`mod flows;`, handlers)
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_connections.rs`: add tests; `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: append `connections-jump-*` keys

## Cross-cutting

- Validity: Restricted owners never reach this handler from the menu (item disabled); from the keyboard they get the no-owner toast only when `owners` is empty, else the jump runs with the known key.

title: Connections: Connection Properties window
description:
## Context
The read-only Connection Properties window, opened by Properties on a connection row, refreshed every 2 s by socket cookie. Sources: UI-SYS-068, UI-SYS-050 (copy button pattern), SYS-034, APP-045, UI-FND-021, UI-FND-025, UI-FND-032 (`TlLink`), canonical table (d), docs/ui/INDEX.md (`WindowKey::ConnectionProperties(u64)`, cap 10), ADR-008 (`Demand.connections` while a Connection Properties window is open).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/connection_properties.rs`:
- `pub fn open_connection_properties(cookie: u64, hub, demand, cx)`: existing `WindowKey::ConnectionProperties(cookie)` → activate it; 10 already open → Warning toast "Too many connection properties windows are already open" in the main window, nothing opens; else a `TlSecondaryWindow` (Properties kind, not modal) titled "Connection properties: <Proto> <State>" (for example "Connection properties: TCP ESTABLISHED"), default 560 × 520, minimum 440 × 360.
- `ConnectionPropertiesView` (Entity): subscribes to `SnapshotHub`; on CONNECTIONS or PROCESSES changes it looks up its record by cookie and notifies only when the record changed (at most every 2 s). While any of these windows is open it holds `Demand.connections = true` through `DemandAggregator` (released when the last one closes).
- Content: `TlKeyValueGrid` inline, `.label_width(200)`, padding `sp6`, scroll region, a copy button per line exactly as in Startup Properties (icon `copy` 14 in a 20 × 20 hit area, `text_secondary` 60% alpha, full on hover or focus, accessible name "Copy <label>", toast "Copied to clipboard"); footer 48 px with `TlButton::Secondary` "Close".
- Lines, in order:

  | Label | Value |
  |---|---|
  | "Protocol / State / Family" | "TCP / ESTABLISHED / IPv4" |
  | "Local" | "<addr> Port <n>", for example "192.168.1.10 Port 51234" |
  | "Foreign" | "<addr> Port <n>", or "*" for listeners and unconnected UDP |
  | "Process" | `TlLink` "<name> PID <n>" (lowest-PID owner) that runs the E28-024 jump; "No owner (kernel)"; or "Restricted" |
  | "User" | user name |
  | "Inode" | integer, no grouping |
  | "Interface" | name, or "None" |
  | "Recv-Q / Send-Q" | "<recv> / <send>", for example "0 / 0", U+2009 grouping |
  | "RTT" (TCP only) | "<rtt> ms (var <rttvar> ms)" with two decimals, for example "0.42 ms (var 0.10 ms)" |
  | "Congestion window" (TCP only) | "<n> segments" |
  | "Bytes sent / received" (TCP only) | "<acked> / <received>" IEC two decimals, for example "1.22 MiB / 34.68 MiB" |
  | "Retransmits" (TCP only) | count |
  | "Last data received" (TCP only) | "<n> ms ago" with U+2009 grouping, for example "1 240 ms ago" |
  | "Closable here" | in P2 always "No (not supported in this version)"; E28-027 adds the P3 reasons |

  A TCP value missing from `tcp_info` shows "Not reported". UDP sockets have no TCP lines.
- Socket gone (cookie no longer in the snapshot): the title appends " (closed)" and all values turn `text_secondary`, keeping the last values.
- Esc, Ctrl+W and "Close" close the window; Ctrl+C copies the focused line.
- `ConnectionsPage` handles `OpenProperties`: one window per selected cookie through `open_connection_properties`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** the fixture TCP socket **When** Properties opens **Then** the title is "Connection properties: TCP ESTABLISHED" and the lines equal golden `tests/golden/conn_props_lines.txt`.
- **Given** a UDP socket **When** opened **Then** no RTT, Congestion window, Bytes, Retransmits or Last data received line is present.
- **Given** a TCP socket whose `tcp_info` lacks the RTT **When** opened **Then** RTT shows "Not reported".
- **Given** an open window **When** a snapshot without its cookie arrives **Then** the title ends with " (closed)" and values are `text_secondary`.
- **Given** 10 open windows **When** an 11th is requested **Then** the toast "Too many connection properties windows are already open" shows.
- **Given** a window open and the Connections tab left **When** demand is read **Then** `Demand.connections` is still true; after the window closes it is false.
- **Given** the Process link **When** activated with Enter **Then** the owner jump runs (E28-024 behaviour).

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/connection_properties.rs`: change (fill the stub)
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/mod.rs`: change (`OpenProperties` handler)
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_connections.rs`: add tests; `crates/tl-ui/tests/golden/conn_props_lines.txt`: create
- `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: append `connections-props-*` keys

## Tests
- `ui_connections::conn_props_lines_golden`.
- `ui_connections::conn_props_tcp_lines_only_for_tcp`.
- `ui_connections::conn_props_tcp_value_not_reported`.
- `ui_connections::conn_props_closed_title`.
- `ui_connections::conn_props_cap` and `conn_props_same_cookie_focuses`.
- `ui_connections::conn_props_keeps_demand_while_open`.
- `ui_connections::conn_props_process_link_jumps`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: "Too many connection properties windows are already open".
- Validity: "Not reported" for missing `tcp_info` values; "Restricted" for an unresolved owner.
- Accessibility: copy buttons and the Process link are Tab stops; Esc closes.
- Performance: renders at most every 2 s; nothing when unchanged.
- Privacy: addresses and names shown only; never logged.

title: Information: InfoSection entity, row types and page actions
description:
## Context
The Information tab is built from ten sections. This bead creates the section entity `InfoSection` that draws one section: the title band with the 3 px accent bar, optional distro logo and copy button, then the rows in a `TlKeyValueGrid` inline layout. It also fixes the shared types the section builders and the page use. Sources: UI-SYS-081, UI-SYS-082, UI-FND-025, UI-FND-032, PERF-013, PERF-094, PERF-095, R-050, R-110, D-007.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/actions.rs` (new; `pub mod actions;` added to `pages/information/mod.rs`): the page's GPUI Actions in namespace `tasklens` (R-128): `CopyInformationSection { section: InfoSectionId }` (data action, `#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema, Action)]`), and unit actions `InformationScrollLineUp`, `InformationScrollLineDown`, `InformationScrollPageUp`, `InformationScrollPageDown`, `InformationScrollTop`, `InformationScrollBottom`. No key bindings here (E28-033 adds `bind_keys_information`).

In `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/section.rs` (and `pub mod section;` added to `pages/information/mod.rs`):
- `#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug, serde::Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)] pub enum InfoSectionId { OperatingSystem, Processor, System, Memory, MemoryModules, DiskDrives, BiosFirmware, Motherboard, Graphics, NetworkAdapters }` with `pub const ALL: [InfoSectionId; 10]` in the one-column order (OperatingSystem, Processor, System, Memory, MemoryModules, DiskDrives, BiosFirmware, Motherboard, Graphics, NetworkAdapters) and `pub fn title(self) -> SharedString` returning exactly "Operating System", "Processor", "System", "Memory", "Memory modules", "Disk drives", "BIOS/Firmware", "Motherboard", "Graphics", "Network adapters" (through `tr`, keys `information-section-<slug>`, for example `information-section-operating-system`).
- `pub struct InfoRow { pub label: SharedString, pub value: TlValue, pub live: bool, pub block: u8, pub label_tooltip: Option<SharedString> }`. `block` is 0 for unindented rows and n >= 1 for rows of sub-block n. A value with several lines (Resolution, IP address) holds them separated by `\n`; the row height is `row_h × line_count`. `label_tooltip` exists for the System section's Handle count label (UI-SYS-088).
- `pub struct InfoSection { id: InfoSectionId, rows: Arc<[InfoRow]>, logo: Option<SharedString>, copy_enabled: bool, render_count: usize /* #[cfg(test)] */ }` as a GPUI `Entity` with `pub fn new(id, cx) -> Self`, `pub fn set_rows(&mut self, rows: Arc<[InfoRow]>, cx)` (notifies only when the new `Arc` differs by pointer and by content), `pub fn set_logo(&mut self, path: Option<SharedString>, cx)`, `pub fn set_copy_enabled(&mut self, on: bool, cx)`.
- Render, all sizes multiplied by `UiMetrics` scale:
  - Band: full column width, height `row_h` (28), fill `header`, corners `r_sm`. Accent bar 3 px wide, full band height, at the band's left edge, colour `accent`. Title after the bar with left padding `sp4` (8), `t_md` weight 500 `text_primary`. Operating System only: logo `img(path)` 16 × 16 after the title, gap `sp3` (6); no logo element when `logo` is `None`.
  - Copy button: `TlButton::Icon` sm 24 × 24, icon `copy` at `i_sm`, right padding `sp2`, colour `text_secondary`, hover `text_primary` with `tab_hover` fill, tooltip "Copy section", accessible name "Copy <section title>". Click dispatches `CopyInformationSection { section: id }`. Disabled (`copy_enabled = false`) while the section has no data.
  - Gap band to first row: `sp4` (8).
  - Rows: `TlKeyValueGrid` inline layout with `.row_height(row_h)`, `.label_width(232)`, `.block_indent(sp5 = 12)`, `.block_gap(sp5 = 12)`; label inset `sp4` from the band's left edge; label `t_base` `text_secondary` ending with ":" (the builder passes the label without the colon; the section appends ":"); value `t_base` `text_primary`, one line per value line, end ellipsis with the full text in a tooltip, selectable text. Clicking a value does not copy.
  - Value words per validity come from `TlValue` (UI-FND-025, PERF-013): Valid shows the text; WarmingUp "Collecting…" tooltip "Collecting first sample"; Stale last value in `text_secondary` tooltip "Last updated {age} ago"; Restricted "Restricted"; Unsupported with setup reason "Needs setup" (plain word in P2; link in P3, E28-037); Unsupported hardware "Not supported" tooltip "Not available on this device"; Unsupported no value "Not reported" with the source path as tooltip; Failed "Unavailable" tooltip "Could not read: {last_error}"; unknown enum "Unknown". All non-valid words `text_secondary`.
  - Right-click on a row opens `TlMenu` with "Copy value", "Copy row", "Copy section" (UI-FND-025): "Copy value" writes the value text (word for non-valid values, lines joined with ", "), "Copy row" writes `Label: value`, "Copy section" dispatches `CopyInformationSection { section: id }`. Toast "Copied to clipboard" on success, "Failed to copy to clipboard" on failure.
- `pub fn value_copy_text(row: &InfoRow, out: &mut String)`: appends the copy form of the value (the text, or the PERF-013 word; lines joined with ", "). Used by E28-035.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** an `InfoSection` for OperatingSystem with two rows **When** rendered headlessly **Then** the band is `row_h` tall with a 3 px `accent` bar at x = 0, the title "Operating System" and a copy button at the right end.
- **Given** the OperatingSystem section with `logo = None` **When** rendered **Then** no image element follows the title.
- **Given** a row with validity Restricted **When** rendered **Then** the value text is "Restricted" in `text_secondary`.
- **Given** a row with block = 1 **When** rendered **Then** its label starts 12 px (scaled) right of a block 0 row's label.
- **Given** a value with two lines "a\nb" **When** rendered **Then** the row is `2 × row_h` tall, and `value_copy_text` returns "a, b".
- **Given** the copy button **When** clicked **Then** `CopyInformationSection { section: OperatingSystem }` is dispatched.
- **Given** `copy_enabled = false` **When** the copy button is clicked **Then** nothing is dispatched.
- **Given** `set_rows` with an `Arc` equal in content to the current one **When** called **Then** the section's render count does not increase.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/section.rs`: create
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/actions.rs`: create (Action declarations)
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/mod.rs`: change (add `pub mod actions;` and `pub mod section;`)
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_information.rs`: create with the tests below
- `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: append the keys this bead uses (`information-section-*`, `information-copy-section`, `information-menu-copy-value`, `information-menu-copy-row`, `information-menu-copy-section`)

## Tests
- `ui_information::info_section_band_layout`: band height, 3 px accent bar, title text, copy button present (render test with `TestAppContext`).
- `ui_information::info_os_logo_omitted_when_missing`: no image child when `logo` is `None`; one when set.
- `ui_information::info_row_validity_words`: one row per validity; asserts the word and `text_secondary` colour.
- `ui_information::info_block_indent_12`: block 1 label offset is 12 px at 100% scale, 18 px at 150%.
- `ui_information::info_multiline_row_height_and_copy_join`.
- `ui_information::info_copy_button_dispatches_section` and `info_copy_button_disabled_without_data`.
- `ui_information::info_set_rows_same_content_no_rerender`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: clipboard write failure shows the toast "Failed to copy to clipboard".
- Validity: every validity of ADR-003 maps to its PERF-013 word above; Missing rows are never built (the builder omits them).
- Accessibility: section title is a heading; the copy button is a Tab stop with accessible name "Copy <section title>".
- Performance: no allocation in render; rows are `Arc<[InfoRow]>` built by the page; the section is embedded with `.cached(..)` by the page.
- Privacy: N/A (no memory module serial is ever passed in; D-007 is enforced by the builders, E28-032).

title: Information: row builders for OS, Processor, System, BIOS and Motherboard
description:
## Context
Row builders for the five "machine identity" sections of the Information tab: Operating System, Processor, System, BIOS/Firmware and Motherboard. Each builder turns the snapshot into `InfoRow`s (E28-030) with fixed labels, formats and hide rules, so the section entity only draws. Sources: UI-SYS-082, UI-SYS-086, UI-SYS-087, UI-SYS-088, UI-SYS-092, UI-SYS-093, PERF-013, PERF-034 (uptime), PERF-095, PERF-096, PERF-097, PERF-101, PERF-102, APP-041, R-050, canonical table (d).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/sections.rs` (new; `pub mod sections;` in `pages/information/mod.rs`) with:
```rust
pub struct InfoInputs<'a> { pub inv: &'a InventorySnapshot, pub sys: &'a SystemSnapshot, pub devices: &'a DeviceCatalog }
pub fn build_os(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>);
pub fn build_processor(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>);
pub fn build_system(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>);
pub fn build_bios(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>);
pub fn build_motherboard(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>);
pub fn os_logo(i: &InfoInputs) -> Option<SharedString>; // os-release LOGO resolved path, None when not found
```
Rows, in this order. Labels are written without the trailing colon. "Live" rows set `live = true`; all others `false`. A value whose source field is not `Valid` becomes the `TlValue` with that validity (E28-030 maps it to the word).
- **Operating System**: "OS name" = `PRETTY_NAME`; "Version" = `VERSION_ID`, or the text "Rolling" (Valid) when `VERSION_ID` is absent; "Build" = `BUILD_ID`, or Unsupported-no-value ("Not reported") when absent; "Kernel" = kernel release (for example "6.17.1-2-cachyos"); "Kernel version" = `uname` version string; "Architecture" = "<machine> (<n>-bit)", for example "x86_64 (64-bit)" (n per open item B8-E28-4); "Install date" = local time "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; "Package manager" = for example "pacman 7.0.0", row omitted when no package manager was found (APP-041); "Machine ID" = the 32 hex characters.
- **Processor**: "Name" (model name; "Unknown processor" as Valid text when missing), "Vendor" (for example "AuthenticAMD"), "Architecture" ("x86_64"), "Identifier" ("Family 25 Model 97 Stepping 2"), "Cores" ("16"), "Logical processors" ("32"), "Base speed" ("4200 MHz", integer MHz), "Max speed" ("5759 MHz"), "Microcode" ("0xa601209"), "Flags summary" = "Virtualization: <v>, AVX-512: <a>" where v is "Yes (AMD-V)" when the `svm` flag is present, "Yes (VT-x)" when `vmx` is present, else "No"; a is "Yes" when any `avx512f` flag is present, else "No". Example "Virtualization: Yes (AMD-V), AVX-512: Yes".
- **System**: "Computer name" = "<pretty> (<static>)" when a pretty hostname is set and differs from the static hostname, else only the static hostname (example "Hawk desktop (hawk)"); "User name"; "Domain" (DNS or NIS domain), row omitted when empty or exactly "(none)"; "System uptime" (live) in the table (d) uptime format "N day(s), Hh Mm Ss" with hours always shown ("2 days, 2h 38m 15s", "1 day, 2h 38m 15s", "0h 38m 15s"); use the table (d) formatter, do not re-implement it; "Boot time" local "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; "Process count" (live), "Thread count" (live), "Handle count" (live) as counts with U+2009 thin-space grouping ("5 596", "253 248"), and the Handle count row has `label_tooltip = "Open file descriptors, system-wide"`; "Desktop" (for example "KDE Plasma 6.4.5"), row omitted when unknown; "Windowing system" ("Wayland"); "Session type" = "<Class> (<word>)" from logind Class and Type, example "user (graphical)" (word mapping per open item B8-E28-5); "Virtual terminal" ("2"), row omitted when `XDG_VTNR` is not set.
- **BIOS/Firmware**: "Firmware type" ("UEFI" or "Legacy BIOS"), "BIOS vendor", "BIOS version", "BIOS date", "BIOS release", "Secure Boot" ("Enabled", "Disabled", or Unsupported-no-value "Not reported").
- **Motherboard**: "Manufacturer", "Product", "Version", "System vendor", "System product", "Chassis type", "Serial number". Chassis type maps the DMI number to the SMBIOS word: 1 Other, 2 Unknown, 3 Desktop, 4 Low Profile Desktop, 5 Pizza Box, 6 Mini Tower, 7 Tower, 8 Portable, 9 Laptop, 10 Notebook, 11 Hand Held, 12 Docking Station, 13 All in One, 14 Sub Notebook, 15 Space-saving, 16 Lunch Box, 17 Main Server Chassis, 18 Expansion Chassis, 19 SubChassis, 20 Bus Expansion Chassis, 21 Peripheral Chassis, 22 RAID Chassis, 23 Rack Mount Chassis, 24 Sealed-case PC, 25 Multi-system chassis, 26 Compact PCI, 27 Advanced TCA, 28 Blade, 29 Blade Enclosure, 30 Tablet, 31 Convertible, 32 Detachable, 33 IoT Gateway, 34 Embedded PC, 35 Mini PC, 36 Stick PC; any other number shows "Unknown". "Serial number" when Restricted shows "Restricted" with tooltip exactly "Needs administrator access." in every phase (PERF-102: the shield cannot read it).
- Field names on `InventorySnapshot` are the ones E03-A2 defines (open item B8-E28-2). Live values (uptime, process, thread and handle counts) come from `SystemSnapshot` (PERF-033 counts).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** an os-release fixture without `VERSION_ID` **When** `build_os` runs **Then** the Version row is "Rolling".
- **Given** no `BUILD_ID` **When** `build_os` runs **Then** Build shows "Not reported" in `text_secondary`.
- **Given** no package manager found **When** `build_os` runs **Then** there is no "Package manager" row.
- **Given** flags containing `svm` and `avx512f` **When** `build_processor` runs **Then** Flags summary is "Virtualization: Yes (AMD-V), AVX-512: Yes".
- **Given** flags with neither `svm`, `vmx` nor `avx512f` **When** built **Then** Flags summary is "Virtualization: No, AVX-512: No".
- **Given** pretty hostname "Hawk desktop" and static "hawk" **When** `build_system` runs **Then** Computer name is "Hawk desktop (hawk)"; **given** pretty equal to static **then** it is "hawk".
- **Given** domain "(none)" **When** `build_system` runs **Then** there is no Domain row.
- **Given** uptime 181095 s **When** built **Then** System uptime is "2 days, 2h 18m 15s".
- **Given** thread count 5596 **When** built **Then** the value is "5 596" with U+2009.
- **Given** a board serial with validity Restricted **When** `build_motherboard` runs **Then** the value is "Restricted" with tooltip "Needs administrator access.".
- **Given** chassis number 3 **When** built **Then** Chassis type is "Desktop"; **given** 99 **then** "Unknown".

title: Information: row builders for Memory, modules, disks, graphics and network
description:
## Context
Row builders for the five hardware sections of the Information tab: Memory, Memory modules, Disk drives, Graphics and Network adapters. Sub-block sections produce one block per module, disk, GPU or adapter. The Public IP row of the Network adapters section is a separate bead (E28-036). Sources: UI-SYS-082, UI-SYS-089, UI-SYS-090, UI-SYS-091, UI-SYS-094, UI-SYS-095, PERF-098 to PERF-100, PERF-103, PERF-104, PERF-004 (visible interfaces), PERF-013, PERF-069, D-007, R-030, canonical table (d).

## Deliverable
Added to `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/sections.rs` (same `InfoInputs` as E28-031):
```rust
pub fn build_memory(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>);
pub fn build_modules(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>);
pub fn build_disks(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>);
pub fn build_graphics(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>);
pub fn build_network(i: &InfoInputs, out: &mut Vec<InfoRow>); // adapter blocks only, no Public IP row
pub const BLOCK_FIRST_LABELS: [&str; 4] = ["Module", "Model", "Name", "Connection"]; // used by the filter (E28-034)
```
Sizes are IEC with two decimals ("62.70 GiB"), percent "%.1f%%", counts thin-space grouped (table d).
- **Memory** (block 0): "Total physical"; "Available physical" (live); "Memory usage" (live, the used percent shown on the Memory page, for example "54.6%"); "Committed" (live, `Committed_AS`); "Commit limit"; "Peak committed (since tasklens started)" (live; source per open item B8-E28-3); "Page size" ("4096 bytes"); "Huge page size" ("2.00 MiB"); "Swap total"; "zram size" ("31.35 GiB", or the Valid text "None" when no zram device exists). The Peak committed label wraps to two lines inside the 232 px label column and that row is `2 × row_h` tall (the only wrapping label).
- **Memory modules**: one block per populated module in slot order, block numbers 1..n, rows "Module" ("Module <n>", n counting from 1 in slot order), "Slot" ("P0 CHANNEL A (DIMM 1)"), "Capacity" ("32.00 GiB"), "Speed" ("6000 MT/s"), "Type" ("DDR5"), "Form factor" ("DIMM"), "Manufacturer", "Part number". All blocks are shown (no collapse). There is never a serial row and no module serial string reaches any row (D-007). With no module data at all: one block-0 row "Modules" with Unsupported-no-value ("Not reported").
- **Disk drives**: one block per physical disk in the Performance sidebar order: "Model"; "Type" ("SSD" when the rotation rate is 0 or the disk is non-rotational, "HDD" otherwise); "Interface" ("NVMe", "SATA", "USB", "SCSI" or "virtio"); "Capacity" ("1.82 TiB"); "Space" (live, "<free> free of <capacity>", for example "812.40 GiB free of 1.82 TiB"); "Volumes" (mount paths joined with ", ", for example "/, /home", or "None" when no partition is mounted); "Serial" (always shown; its validity word when not readable).
- **Graphics**: one block per GPU: "Name" ("Unknown GPU" as Valid text when missing); "Driver version"; "Kernel module"; "Vulkan version"; "OpenGL version"; "Temperature" (live, "52 °C"); "Temperature source" (the PERF-069 value); "Dedicated memory"; "Shared memory"; "Resolution" with one line per display "<w>x<h> @ <hz> Hz", " (primary)" appended on the primary display, for example "3840x2160 @ 144 Hz (primary)"; the row grows by `row_h` per extra display.
- **Network adapters**: one block per interface that the Performance sidebar shows (PERF-004 rules): "Connection" ("<ifname> (<kind>)", for example "enp6s0 (Ethernet)"; "Unknown adapter" when the name is missing); "Details" ("<adapter name>, <driver>, <speed> Mbps", for example "Intel Ethernet Controller I225-V, igc, 2500 Mbps"); "IP address" (one line per address with prefix, "192.168.1.10/24", "fe80::1c2:3ff:fe4a:5b6c/64"; the row grows per line); "MAC address" ("a8:a1:59:12:34:56").

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a host without zram **When** `build_memory` runs **Then** "zram size" is "None".
- **Given** the Memory section **When** rendered at 100% scale **Then** the Peak committed row is `2 × row_h` and every other Memory row is `row_h`.

- **Given** a disk with no mounted partition **When** built **Then** Volumes is "None".

title: Information: InformationPage layout, loading, live refresh and keys
description:
## Context
The `InformationPage` entity: the two-column layout of ten cached `InfoSection`s in one scroll region, the demand it sets while visible, the first-load skeleton, the 1 Hz refresh of live sections, F5 refresh, the error state and keyboard scrolling. Sources: UI-SYS-080, UI-SYS-085, PERF-094, APP-059, R-060, R-110, table (b) Information rows, ADR-008 schedule (Inventory on page open and `RefreshNow`), ADR-009 (page entities, `.cached`, notify rules), UI-SHL-050 (no status text on Information).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/mod.rs`:
- `pub struct InformationPage { sections: [Entity<InfoSection>; 10], scroll: ScrollHandle, focus: FocusHandle, first_data_seen: bool, refresh_pending: Option<(u64 /*inventory version at F5*/, Task<()>)>, filter: Arc<str>, width_px: Pixels, _subs: SmallVec<[Subscription; 2]> }`, created in `pub fn new(hub: &Entity<SnapshotHub>, demand: &Entity<DemandAggregator>, window, cx)`. All entities, subscriptions and the focus handle are created in `new`.
- `pub fn set_active(&mut self, active: bool, cx)`: when active, sets `Demand.inventory = true`, `Demand.memory = true`, `Demand.gpus = true`, `Demand.disks = true` through `DemandAggregator`; when inactive, clears this page's contribution. On the first activation in the session it also sends `Command::RefreshNow(SourceId::Inventory)`.
- Layout (all sizes × `UiMetrics` scale): page padding top 16 (`sp6`), left 24, right 24, bottom 24 (`sp7`). When the page content width is 880 px or more: two equal flex columns, each min width 360, gap 24; left column Operating System, Processor, System, BIOS/Firmware, Motherboard; right column Memory, Memory modules, Disk drives, Graphics, Network adapters. Below 880 px: one column in `InfoSectionId::ALL` order. Section gap 32 (`sp8`) between one section's last row and the next band. One vertical scroll region for the whole page (both columns move together) with the kit `Scrollbar` in `ScrollbarMode::Scrolling` on the page's right edge. Each section is embedded with `.cached(StyleRefinement::default())` sized to its content.
- Data: subscribes to `SnapshotHub` `SnapshotChanged { mask, .. }`. INVENTORY changes rebuild every section's rows (E28-031, E28-032 builders) and the OS logo. SYSTEM or DEVICES changes rebuild only System, Memory, Disk drives and Graphics (the sections with live rows), at most 4 sections per second. Sections whose rows are unchanged do not notify.
- Loading: until `InventorySnapshot.header.validity` is not `WarmingUp` (or data arrives) for the first time this session, each section shows its band with the copy button disabled and a `TlSkeletonBlock` of 8 lines as its body. `first_data_seen` never resets in the session; F5 never shows the skeleton again.
- Error: inventory source `Failed` before any data: the whole content area shows `TlEmptyState` with icon `circle-alert` in `status.warning`, text "Could not load system information", button "Retry" dispatching `RefreshCurrentTab`. A failure after data keeps the last values (per-row words only).
- Refresh: handles `RefreshCurrentTab` while active: sends `Command::RefreshNow(SourceId::Inventory)`, then pushes the Info toast "Information refreshed." when the next inventory `header.version` arrives or 2 s after the request, whichever comes first (one toast per F5, `ToastKey` fixed per page).
- Keyboard and focus: key context `Information` on the scroll region; the scroll region is focusable and is the page's initial focus target. Handlers: `InformationScrollLineUp/Down` move by `row_h`; `InformationScrollPageUp/Down` move by viewport height minus `row_h`; `InformationScrollTop/Bottom` go to the ends. Tab moves through the section copy buttons, links and the Public IP button in reading order, left column first.
- `pub fn status_text(&self, out: &mut String)` writes nothing (the chip is empty on Information).
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/actions.rs`: add `pub fn bind_keys_information(cx: &mut App)` binding in context `Information`: `up` InformationScrollLineUp, `down` InformationScrollLineDown, `pageup` InformationScrollPageUp, `pagedown` InformationScrollPageDown, `home` InformationScrollTop, `end` InformationScrollBottom.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a page width of 1280 **When** rendered **Then** there are two columns with Operating System at the top left and Memory at the top right.
- **Given** a page width of 879 **When** rendered **Then** there is one column in the order Operating System, Processor, System, Memory, Memory modules, Disk drives, BIOS/Firmware, Motherboard, Graphics, Network adapters.
- **Given** the page becomes active **When** demand is read **Then** `inventory`, `memory`, `gpus` and `disks` are true; **given** another tab becomes active **then** this page's contribution is cleared.
- **Given** the first activation **When** it happens **Then** exactly one `RefreshNow(Inventory)` command is sent; a second activation sends none.
- **Given** an inventory component still `WarmingUp` **When** rendered **Then** every section shows its band and an 8-line skeleton block; **given** data then arrives, then leaves and returns to WarmingUp **then** no skeleton is shown again.
- **Given** a snapshot that changes only SYSTEM **When** installed **Then** the Operating System and Processor render counters do not change and the System section's does.
- **Given** two SYSTEM snapshots 1 s apart with different uptime **When** installed **Then** the System uptime value text changes.
- **Given** F5 on the page **When** the next inventory version arrives after 300 ms **Then** the toast "Information refreshed." shows once; **given** no new version **then** it shows at 2 s.
- **Given** the inventory source Failed before any data **When** rendered **Then** the empty state "Could not load system information" with "Retry" shows; clicking Retry dispatches `RefreshCurrentTab`.
- **Given** focus in the page **When** End is pressed **Then** the scroll offset is at the bottom; **When** PgUp **Then** it moves up by viewport height minus `row_h`.

## Files

- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/actions.rs`: change (add `bind_keys_information`)
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_information.rs`: add tests
- `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: append `information-refreshed`, `information-error-load`, `information-error-retry`

## Tests

- `ui_information::info_refresh_now_on_first_visit_only`.
- `ui_information::info_skeleton_once`.
- `ui_information::info_only_live_sections_rerender`.
- `ui_information::info_live_uptime_ticks`.
- `ui_information::info_refresh_toast` (both paths, with `TestAppContext` time advance).

- `ui_information::info_keyboard_scrolling`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: "Could not load system information" empty state with "Retry"; refresh toast "Information refreshed.".
- Validity: `header.validity` WarmingUp drives the skeleton; Failed before data drives the error state.
- Accessibility: key context `Information`; scroll region focusable; reading order left column first; section titles are headings.
- Performance: about 120 rows; static sections never re-render after load; at most 4 section rebuilds per second; nothing notifies inside render.

title: Information: filter
description:
## Context
The Information tab filter. The shell `FilterBox` sends `FilterChanged { tab, text }` after its 100 ms debounce; the Information page filters its about 120 rows in the UI (no engine query). Sources: UI-SYS-084, PERF-094, APP-028, UI-SHL-024, UI-FND-029.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/filter.rs` (new; `pub mod filter;` in `pages/information/mod.rs`):
```rust
/// Returns the rows of one section that stay visible for `needle` (already lowercased).
/// Empty result means the section is hidden, band included.
pub fn filter_section(title: &str, rows: &[InfoRow], needle: &str) -> Arc<[InfoRow]>;
```
Rules, in this order:
1. Empty `needle`: every row stays.
2. The section title contains `needle` (case-insensitive): every row of the section stays.
3. Otherwise a row stays when its label or its displayed value text (the Valid text, or the PERF-013 word for a non-valid value; all lines) contains `needle`, case-insensitive.
4. In a sub-block (`block >= 1`) where at least one row stays, the block's first row (label in `BLOCK_FIRST_LABELS`: "Module", "Model", "Name", "Connection") also stays, so the block keeps its identity.
5. A section with no remaining rows is hidden, including its band.
Matched text is not highlighted.

In `InformationPage` (`pages/information/mod.rs`):
- Keeps `full_rows: [Arc<[InfoRow]>; 10]` and `filter: Arc<str>`. `pub fn apply_filter(&mut self, text: Arc<str>, cx)` lowercases once, recomputes every section's visible rows with `filter_section`, calls `set_rows` on each section (sections whose result is unchanged do not notify), and hides sections with no rows. New snapshot rows are filtered with the current filter before `set_rows`.
- Handles the shell event `FilterChanged { tab: Tab::Information, text }`.
- When every section is hidden: the content area shows `TlEmptyState` with text "No information matches the filter." and a "Clear filter" button dispatching `ClearFilter`.
- Copy ignores the filter (E28-035 copies `full_rows`).

title: Information: copy section, copy all and Ctrl+C
description:
## Context
Copy from the Information tab: one section (band copy button, row menu "Copy section"), all sections (tab copy icon, `CopyInformationAll`), and Ctrl+C. Copy text never includes memory module serials and always covers every row, whatever the filter. Sources: UI-SYS-083, UI-SYS-081, PERF-094, APP-041, R-012, D-007, UI-SHL-023, table (b) Information Ctrl+C row, UI-FND-025.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/information/copy.rs` (new; `pub mod copy;` in `pages/information/mod.rs`):
```rust
pub fn section_text(id: InfoSectionId, rows: &[InfoRow], out: &mut String);
pub fn all_text(sections: &[(InfoSectionId, Arc<[InfoRow]>); 10], out: &mut String); // InfoSectionId::ALL order
```
Format, exactly:
- A section is its title line, then one `Label: value` line per row (value from `value_copy_text`, E28-030: non-valid values copy their word such as "Restricted"; multi-line values joined with ", ").
- One blank line is written whenever the row's `block` differs from the previous row's `block` inside a section, so sub-blocks are separated by one blank line.
- Sections are separated by one blank line. No trailing blank line at the end.
- Example:
  ```
  Operating System
  OS name: CachyOS Linux
  Version: Rolling

  Memory modules
  Module: Module 1
  Slot: P0 CHANNEL A (DIMM 1)

  Module: Module 2
  ```

In `InformationPage`:
- `CopyInformationSection { section }` handler: builds `section_text` from the section's full (unfiltered) rows and writes it with `cx.write_to_clipboard(ClipboardItem::new_string(..))`; toast "Copied to clipboard" (Success); on failure "Failed to copy to clipboard" (Error).
- `CopyInformationAll` handler (the shell's tab copy icon dispatches it, UI-SHL-023): `all_text` over all ten sections in `InfoSectionId::ALL` order (single-column order, whatever the layout), same toasts.
- Ctrl+C in context `Information`: `bind_keys_information` gains `ctrl-c` bound to `CopyInformationAll`; the handler first checks whether a value in any section has a text selection and, if so, copies the selected text instead (toast "Copied to clipboard").
- Hidden rows (rows the builders omit, such as an empty Domain) are not in the copy, because they are never built. Rows hidden only by the filter are in the copy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** the fixture snapshot **When** `CopyInformationAll` runs **Then** the clipboard text equals the golden file `tests/golden/info_copy_all.txt`.
- **Given** a filter "kernel" is active **When** `CopyInformationSection { section: OperatingSystem }` runs **Then** the clipboard contains every Operating System row, not only the Kernel rows.
- **Given** a module fixture with `SERIAL_NUMBER=ABC123` **When** `CopyInformationAll` runs **Then** "ABC123" does not appear in the clipboard text.
- **Given** a value with a text selection "6.17.1" **When** Ctrl+C is pressed **Then** the clipboard is "6.17.1"; **given** no selection **then** the clipboard holds the full copy-all text.
- **Given** a clipboard write that fails **When** a copy runs **Then** the toast "Failed to copy to clipboard" shows.

title: Connections: Close TCP connection flow (P3)
description:
## Context
Phase 3: "Close TCP connection" on the Connections tab. It sends `ActionKind::SockDestroy` for a TCP socket identified by cookie and four-tuple; the tasklens helper sends the kernel's `SOCK_DESTROY` under polkit. Listening sockets need a confirmation first. This is a privileged, security-relevant flow. Sources: UI-SYS-064, UI-SYS-063 (item 6), UI-SYS-062 ("Closing…"), UI-SYS-007, SYS-031, R-002, R-004, R-119, ADR-005 (`ActionTarget::Socket`), ADR-006 (helper boundary), UI-FND-021 (`TlDialog::confirm`).

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/menu.rs`: item 6 "Close TCP connection" (`ConnectionCloseTcp`) between two separators after item 5. Item states, first match wins:

| Condition | Item |
|---|---|
| any target is UDP or TIME-WAIT | hidden (only when every target is UDP or TIME-WAIT; mixed selections act on the TCP non-TIME-WAIT targets) |
| helper not installed (health reports no tl-helper) | disabled, tooltip "Needs the tasklens helper" |
| `ConnectionsSnapshot.destroy_supported == Some(false)` (EOPNOTSUPP earlier this session) | disabled, tooltip "Kernel lacks CONFIG_INET_DIAG_DESTROY" |
| a close is pending on every target cookie | disabled, tooltip "Closing…" |
| otherwise | enabled |

In `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/flows.rs`: `ConnectionCloseTcp` handler:
1. Targets: captured TCP records not in TIME-WAIT and not already pending, as `ActionTarget::Socket { cookie, family, proto, four_tuple }` built from the captured record (never re-read from a newer snapshot).
2. If any target is LISTENING: `TlDialog::confirm` window titled "tasklens", heading "Close listening socket?", text "The program will stop accepting new connections on <addr>." (one target), or heading "Close <n> listening sockets?" with one address per line (at most 5, then "and <m> more"); buttons "Cancel" (focused) and "Close socket" (`TlButton::Danger`). Cancel sends nothing.
3. Submit through `SysActions::submit(ActionKind::SockDestroy, ActionKindTag::CloseTcp, targets, texts)` with: pending_one "TCP connection close requested" (Info icon with the pending spinner), done_one "TCP connection closed", failed_prefix "Failed to close TCP connection" (failure text "Failed to close TCP connection: <errno text>"), unknown "Outcome unknown", busy "A connection action is already in progress." (open item B8-E28-10), done_many and partial_many per the UI-SYS-007 pattern "{ $n } TCP connections closed" and "{ $ok } of { $n } TCP connections closed. { $failed } failed.", progress_cap true.
4. When the helper session is locked, polkit prompts for `io.github.oysteinkrog.tasklens.helper`; the toast stays pending. A cancelled prompt gives the Warning toast "Authentication cancelled".
5. While pending, `ConnectionsDelegate` draws the State cell as "Closing…" in `status.info` until the row disappears at the next refresh or the action fails.

In `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/delegate.rs`: the "Closing…" State cell.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a P3 build with the helper installed and an ESTABLISHED TCP row **When** the menu opens **Then** "Close TCP connection" is enabled between two separators.
- **Given** a UDP row or a TIME-WAIT row **When** the menu opens **Then** the item is not shown.
- **Given** the helper not installed **When** the menu opens on a TCP row **Then** the item is disabled with tooltip "Needs the tasklens helper".
- **Given** `destroy_supported == Some(false)` **When** the menu opens **Then** the item is disabled with tooltip "Kernel lacks CONFIG_INET_DIAG_DESTROY".
- **Given** a LISTENING row on 0.0.0.0:22 **When** the item is chosen **Then** the confirmation reads "Close listening socket?" and "The program will stop accepting new connections on 0.0.0.0:22.", focus is on "Cancel", and Enter sends nothing.
- **Given** an ESTABLISHED row **When** the item is chosen and the engine answers `Succeeded` **Then** the request is `SockDestroy` with exactly the captured cookie and four-tuple, the toast goes "TCP connection close requested" then "TCP connection closed" in place, and the State cell showed "Closing…" meanwhile.
- **Given** the engine answers `Failed(Os(95))` (EOPNOTSUPP) **When** the event arrives **Then** the toast reads "Failed to close TCP connection: <errno text>" and, after the next snapshot with `destroy_supported = Some(false)`, the item is disabled with the kernel tooltip.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/menu.rs`: change (item 6)
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/flows.rs`: change (close flow)
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/connections/delegate.rs`: change ("Closing…")
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_connections.rs`: add tests; `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: append `connections-close-*` keys

## Tests

- `ui_connections::close_listening_requires_confirm` and `close_listening_plural_heading`.
- `ui_connections::close_toast_sequence`.
- `ui_connections::close_eopnotsupp_disables_item`.
- `ui_connections::close_targets_exact_cookie_and_tuple` (security regression: a newer snapshot with the same four-tuple and a different cookie does not change the target).
- `ui_connections::close_auth_cancelled_toast`.

## Cross-cutting

- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: confirmation focus on Cancel; the destructive button needs Tab then Enter.
- Performance: one request per command.
- Privacy: the four-tuple goes only into the request; the UI logs nothing.

title: Startup Apps: StartupDelegate columns, cells, impact and tooltips
description:
## Context
`StartupDelegate`: the `TreeTableDelegate` and `SysDelegate` for the Startup Apps table. It defines the seven columns, the cell content and styles of a startup row, the Startup impact cell with its tooltip, and the row tooltip. The page entity (E28-011) owns the table through E27's `SysTableFrame`. Sources: UI-SYS-002 (delegate hooks), UI-SYS-003 (startup status looks), UI-SYS-041, UI-SYS-042, UI-SYS-043, SYS-019, SYS-020, SYS-021, R-011, ADR-009 (text caching), E27-A1 API.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/startup/delegate.rs` (new; `mod delegate;` in `pages/startup/mod.rs`):
- `pub struct StartupDelegate { snap: Option<Arc<StartupSnapshot>>, rows: Arc<[SysRow]>, query_generation: u64, header: ComponentHeader, text: CellTextCache, home: Arc<str> }` implementing `TreeTableDelegate` (E18) and `SysDelegate` (E27-A1): `mask()` = `ComponentMask::STARTUP`; `install` takes `snap.startup`; `rows_len`, `query_generation`, `component_header` from it.
- Row ids `SysNodeId::Startup(StartupRef)`; every row `RowKind::Plain`, depth 0, not expandable, all rows selectable; `header_lines` = `HeaderLines::One`.
- Columns (`columns()`), display order, all visible by default, no optional columns; ids are the `state.toml` `[columns.startup]` ids:

  | Id | Header label | Default width | Min width | Align |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `name` | "Name" | 220 | 120 | left |
  | `publisher` | "Publisher" | 180 | 60 | left |
  | `status` | "Status" | 90 | 80 | left |
  | `impact` | "Startup impact" | 100 | 80 | left |
  | `type` | "Type" | 190 | 60 | left |
  | `location` | "Location" | 260 | 60 | left |
  | `command` | "Command" | 170 | 60 | left |

- Default sort `SortSpec { column: status, ascending }`, tie-break name ascending (R-011; the engine sorts). For the record, the engine's ascending orders are: Status Enabled, Disabled, Masked, Not in this desktop, Missing program; Startup impact High, Medium, Low, None, Not measured (UI-SYS-041).
- Cells (`cell`, `name_cell`), text through `CellTextCache` keyed by `(SysNodeId, ColumnId)`:
  - `name`: icon 16 × scale (`img(icon_path)`; fallback Lucide `app-window` for XDG autostart entries, `cog` for systemd user units, `file-code` for Plasma scripts), gap `sp3`, the name in `text_primary`.
  - `publisher`: "name version", "User" (in `text_secondary`), or empty.
  - `status`: `status_cell(status_look(s), status_label(s), selected, stale, ..)` from `pages/sys_status.rs` with `s` mapped from the entry status (Enabled, Disabled, Masked, NotInThisDesktop, MissingProgram).
  - `impact`: text only, `t_base`: High `status.warning`; Medium and Low `text_primary`; None and Not measured `text_secondary`.
  - `type`: "Autostart (user)", "Autostart (system)", "Autostart (system, overridden)" (in `text_secondary`), "systemd user unit", "Plasma pre-startup script", "Plasma logout script".
  - `location`: directory path with a leading `$HOME` shown as `~`, `text_secondary`.
  - `command`: `Exec`, `ExecStart` or the script path, `text_primary`.
  - A row with `overridden_by_user` (a shadowed system entry) draws every text cell in `text_secondary`.
  - Text columns end with an ellipsis; Location and Command show the full value in a tooltip.
- Tooltips (600 ms on the Name cell, `row_tooltip`): two lines, the full command, then the source file path.
- Startup impact tooltip (600 ms on the impact cell): for High, Medium and Low three lines "Activation time: <n> ms", "Started <s.s> s after login", "CPU time: <h:mm:ss>" (example "Activation time: 412 ms" / "Started 3.2 s after login" / "CPU time: 0:00:01"); when `impact_detail.fork_exec_only` a fourth line "For this unit type only the time to start the program is measured."; for None "Disabled entries do not run at login."; for Not measured "This entry did not start through systemd in this session.".
- Accessible row name "<Name>, <Status>, <Type>".
- `on_activate` (Enter, Alt+Enter, Ctrl+I, double-click) dispatches `OpenProperties`.
- Entry fields read: `StartupSnapshot.entries[record]` with `id: StartupRef`, `name`, `icon_path`, `publisher`, `status`, `impact`, `impact_detail { activation_ms, start_offset_ms, cpu_ns, fork_exec_only }`, `kind: StartupKind`, `location`, `command`, `source_path`, `can_toggle`, `can_delete`, `can_run`, `overridden_by_user` (UI-SYS-042).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** the delegate **When** `columns()` is read **Then** it returns the seven ids in the order above with the default and min widths above.
- **Given** an XDG autostart entry with no resolvable icon **When** the Name cell renders **Then** it shows the Lucide `app-window` icon; a user unit shows `cog`; a Plasma script `file-code`.
- **Given** an entry with `overridden_by_user = true` **When** rendered **Then** every text cell uses `text_secondary`.
- **Given** an entry with status Enabled **When** the Status cell renders **Then** it shows a filled `status.success` dot and "Enabled".
- **Given** impact High **When** rendered **Then** the impact text is `status.warning`.
- **Given** an entry with activation 412 ms, start offset 3200 ms, cpu 1 s, `fork_exec_only = true` **When** the impact tooltip is built **Then** it has the four lines above with "412 ms", "3.2 s" and "0:00:01".
- **Given** a location "/home/u/.config/autostart" and `HOME=/home/u` **When** rendered **Then** the cell reads "~/.config/autostart".
- **Given** a snapshot with an older `query_generation` than the last query sent **When** the frame offers it **Then** the delegate is not asked to install it (frame rule).

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/startup/delegate.rs`: create
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/startup/mod.rs`: change (`mod delegate;`)
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_startup.rs`: create with the tests below

- `ui_startup::startup_status_cell_looks` (five statuses).
- `ui_startup::impact_colors` and `impact_tooltip_lines` (High with and without `fork_exec_only`, None, Not measured).

- Validity: stale component (`header.validity` Stale) draws status cells with `stale = true` (E27 `status_cell`).
- Accessibility: row name "<Name>, <Status>, <Type>"; Name tooltip after 600 ms.

title: Startup Apps: StartupPage entity, status text, refresh and actions
description:
## Context
`StartupPage`: the Startup Apps tab entity built on E27's `SysTableFrame` with `StartupDelegate` (E28-010). It wires snapshots, the filter, demand, first-visit refresh, the skeleton and empty states, the status text, F5 refresh and the page's GPUI Actions and key binding. Sources: UI-SYS-001, UI-SYS-002, UI-SYS-004, UI-SYS-005, UI-SYS-040, UI-SYS-049, SYS-027, R-060, R-082, APP-029, UI-SHL-050, table (b) StartupTable row, R-128.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/startup/actions.rs` (new; `pub mod actions;` in `mod.rs`): unit Actions in namespace `tasklens`: `StartupEnable`, `StartupDisable`, `StartupRunNow`, `StartupCopyCommand`, `StartupOpenFileLocation`, `StartupDelete`; and `pub fn bind_keys_startup(cx: &mut App)` binding `delete` to `StartupDelete` in context `StartupTable`. The shared table keys (Enter, Alt+Enter, Ctrl+I Properties; Ctrl+C; Ctrl+Shift+C; arrows; Shift+F10) come from E18's `Table` context.

`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/startup/mod.rs`:
- `pub struct StartupPage { frame: SysTableFrame<StartupDelegate>, status_buf: String, last_status: (u32, u32, u32, usize), refresh: Option<(u64, Task<()>)>, _subs: SmallVec<[Subscription; 3]> }` with `pub fn new(hub, demand, client, window, cx)` creating the frame with `SysTableFrame::new(Tab::Startup, "StartupTable", &[SourceId::Startup], StartupDelegate::new(..), SortSpec { column: status, ascending: true }, None, window, cx)`. Entities, subscriptions and focus handles are created in `new` only.
- Subscribes to `SnapshotHub` `SnapshotChanged`: calls `frame.on_snapshot`, notifies only on `true`.
- Handles `FilterChanged { tab: Tab::Startup, text }` with `frame.on_filter_changed`.
- `pub fn set_active(&mut self, active, cx)`: `frame.on_activated` / `frame.on_deactivated` (demand flag `Demand.startup`; first visit sends `RefreshNow(SourceId::Startup)`). Rescans and inotify run only while the tab is active (engine, R-082).
- Render: `frame.render(None, Box::new(ClearFilter), window, cx)`; the page root is embedded by `MainWindow` with `.cached(size_full)`.
- Status text (`pub fn status_text(&self, out: &mut String)`): while the frame body is `Skeleton`, "Loading…"; otherwise "<total> Total | <enabled> Enabled | <disabled> Disabled" from `StartupSnapshot.counts { total, enabled, disabled }` (counts follow the text filter; Disabled counts every entry that is not Enabled, so Total = Enabled + Disabled), counts with U+2009 grouping, then " | <n> selected" when the selection holds 2 or more rows (open item B8-E28-8). Emit `StatusChanged` only when one of the three counts or the selection size changes.
- F5 (`RefreshCurrentTab` while active): `frame.refresh(cx)` (sends `RefreshNow(SourceId::Startup)`), then the Info toast "Startup entries refreshed." when the next `StartupSnapshot.header.version` arrives or 2 s after the request, whichever comes first.
- Selection is kept by `SysNodeId::Startup(StartupRef)` across rescans (E18 identity selection); a rescan that changes rows in place keeps the selected entry selected.
- Space does nothing on this table (no tree).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a fake snapshot with 12 entries, 9 Enabled **When** the page renders **Then** the status text is "12 Total | 9 Enabled | 3 Disabled".

- **Given** the page is activated twice **When** commands are read **Then** `RefreshNow(Startup)` was sent once and `Demand.startup` is true while active and false after another tab is activated.
- **Given** no startup data yet **When** rendered **Then** the body shows skeleton rows and the status text is "Loading…".
- **Given** F5 and a new startup version 500 ms later **When** time advances **Then** "Startup entries refreshed." shows once; **given** no new version **then** it shows at 2 s.
- **Given** entry "Discord" selected **When** a rescan snapshot reorders the rows **Then** "Discord" is still the only selected row.

title: Startup Apps: row context menu and Delete key
description:
## Context
The Startup Apps row context menu: item list, order, enable rules, reason tooltips, target capture at menu-open time, and the Delete key rule. The actions behind the items are wired in E28-013 (enable, disable, run), E28-014 (delete) and E28-015 (copy, open location). Sources: UI-SYS-044, UI-SYS-006, SYS-022 to SYS-025, R-012, R-091, UI-FND-022 (`TlMenu`, system table min width 220), table (b) StartupTable Delete row, ADR-009 (right-click selects, menu bound to captured keys).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/pages/startup/menu.rs` (new; `mod menu;` in `mod.rs`):
- `pub struct StartupMenuTargets { pub refs: SmallVec<[StartupRef; 1]>, pub cell: Option<(StartupRef, ColumnId)> }`, captured when the menu opens (right-click selects the row first if it is not selected, E18; Shift+F10 and the Menu key open it for the selection with `cell = None`). `StartupPage` stores it in `menu_targets: Option<StartupMenuTargets>`; every Startup action handler uses `menu_targets.take()` when present, else the current selection. The menu stays bound to the captured refs even if rows move.
- `StartupDelegate::context_menu` builds a `TlMenu` with min width 220, items in this order:

  | # | Label | Key hint | Action | Enabled when |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | 1 | "Disable" when every target is Enabled; "Enable" when no target is Enabled; both items ("Disable" then "Enable") for a mixed selection | | `StartupDisable` / `StartupEnable` | `can_toggle` for at least one target that would change |
  | 2 | "Run now" | | `StartupRunNow` | `can_run` for at least one target |
  | | separator | | | |
  | 3 | "Copy" | | `CopyCell { col }` (column captured at right-click) | always; hidden when opened from the keyboard (no cell) |
  | 4 | "Copy row" | Ctrl+C | `CopyDetails` | always |
  | 5 | "Copy rows as table" | Ctrl+Shift+C | `CopyRowsAsTable` | always |
  | 6 | "Copy command" | | `StartupCopyCommand` | exactly one target |
  | 7 | "Open file location" | | `StartupOpenFileLocation` | exactly one target |
  | 8 | "Properties" | Enter | `OpenProperties` | always |
  | | separator | | | |
  | 9 | "Delete entry…" | Delete | `StartupDelete` | `can_delete` for at least one target |

- Disabled items carry a tooltip with the reason of the first captured target that fails the condition:
  - status Not in this desktop: "This entry is not used in this desktop (OnlyShowIn or NotShowIn)."
  - status Missing program: "The program for this entry is not installed (TryExec)."
  - status Masked (systemd unit): "This unit is masked. Change its startup type in the Services tab."
  - Delete on an XDG system entry (Type "Autostart (system)" or "Autostart (system, overridden)"): "System entries cannot be deleted. Use Disable instead."
  - Delete on a systemd user unit with `can_delete = false`: "This unit belongs to a package. Use Disable instead."
- Delete key: `StartupDelete` from the keyboard on a selection where no target has `can_delete` pushes the Warning toast "This startup entry cannot be deleted" and opens nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** one Enabled entry **When** the menu opens **Then** the labels in order are "Disable", "Run now", separator, "Copy", "Copy row", "Copy rows as table", "Copy command", "Open file location", "Properties", separator, "Delete entry…", with key hints "Ctrl+C", "Ctrl+Shift+C", "Enter", "Delete".
- **Given** one Enabled and one Disabled entry selected **When** the menu opens **Then** both "Disable" and "Enable" are shown and "Copy command" and "Open file location" are disabled.
- **Given** an entry with status Not in this desktop **When** the menu opens **Then** the toggle item is disabled with tooltip "This entry is not used in this desktop (OnlyShowIn or NotShowIn)."
- **Given** an XDG system entry **When** the menu opens **Then** "Delete entry…" is disabled with tooltip "System entries cannot be deleted. Use Disable instead."
- **Given** a system entry selected and the table focused **When** Delete is pressed **Then** the toast "This startup entry cannot be deleted" shows and no dialog opens.
- **Given** the menu opened on row A **When** a rescan moves row A before the item is clicked **Then** the action targets row A.
- **Given** Shift+F10 **When** the menu opens **Then** "Copy" (cell) is not shown.

## Files

- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/startup/delegate.rs`: change (`context_menu` hook calls into `menu.rs`)
- `crates/tl-ui/src/pages/startup/mod.rs`: change (`mod menu;`, `menu_targets` field, Delete-key rule)
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_startup.rs`: add tests; `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: append `startup-menu-*` keys

## Tests

- `ui_startup::startup_menu_mixed_shows_both`.
- `ui_startup::startup_menu_reason_tooltips` (all five reasons).
- `ui_startup::delete_key_on_system_entry_toast`.
- `ui_startup::startup_menu_targets_captured_at_open`.
- `ui_startup::startup_menu_keyboard_hides_copy_cell`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: "This startup entry cannot be deleted" (Warning toast) for the Delete key on undeletable entries.
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: Shift+F10 and the Menu key open the menu; every item is reachable with arrows; disabled items keep their tooltip.
- Performance: the menu is built on open only.
- Privacy: N/A
