title: E03-054 snapshot.rs: Services component and UnitDetails
description:
## Context
Adds the Services component to `tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`: unit records the Services table renders, counts, manager health, and the per-unit details the Service Properties window shows. The systemd workers (E14) fill it; the UI only reads. Sources: ADR-003 "Per-component fields" (`ServicesSnapshot`), UI-SYS-002, UI-SYS-015, UI-SYS-031 to UI-SYS-035, SYS-001, SYS-003, SYS-011 to SYS-014, SYS-018, R-115, R-119.

## Deliverable
Append to `crates/tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`:

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum ServiceStatus { Running, Active, Starting, Stopping, Reloading, Stopped, Failed, Maintenance }
// SYS-003 mapping: active+running = Running; other active (exited, listening, mounted, waiting,
// elapsed, plugged) = Active; activating = Starting; deactivating = Stopping; reloading or
// refreshing = Reloading; inactive = Stopped; failed = Failed; maintenance = Maintenance.
impl ServiceStatus { pub fn from_states(active_state: &str, sub_state: &str) -> ServiceStatus; } // unknown active_state -> Stopped

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum StartupType { Enabled, EnabledRuntime, Disabled, Static, Indirect, Masked, Generated, Transient, Alias, Linked, NoUnitFile }
// UnitFileState words: enabled, enabled-runtime, disabled, static, indirect, masked (and masked-runtime),
// generated, transient, alias, linked (and linked-runtime); empty or missing = NoUnitFile (shown "-").
impl StartupType { pub fn from_unit_file_state(s: &str) -> StartupType; }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum ServiceBackend { Systemd, OpenRc }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ServiceCounts { pub total: u32, pub running: u32, pub stopped: u32 }

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct UnitRecord {
    pub unit: UnitRef,
    pub kind: UnitType,
    pub description: Arc<str>,           // Description=, the "Display name" column
    pub status: ServiceStatus,
    pub sub_state: Arc<str>,
    pub load_state: Arc<str>,
    pub startup: StartupType,
    pub main_pid: u32,                   // 0 = none (column blank)
    pub user: Arc<str>,                  // SYS-003 rule: MainPID real uid owner, else User=, else root / current user
    pub path: Arc<str>,                  // SYS-003 Path column rule
    pub unit_file: Option<Arc<str>>,     // FragmentPath
    pub active_since_us: Option<u64>,    // ActiveEnterTimestamp, CLOCK_REALTIME microseconds; None when 0
    pub triggered_by: Arc<[Arc<str>]>,
    pub has_cgroup_procs: bool,
    pub cgroup_pids: Arc<[ProcessKey]>,  // child process rows, sorted by ProcessKey
    pub cpu_pct: Total<f32>,             // cgroup cpu.stat usage_usec delta; Missing when no cgroup
    pub memory_bytes: Total<u64>,        // memory.current
    pub disk_bps: Total<f64>,            // io.stat rbytes + wbytes delta per second
    pub tasks: Total<u64>,               // pids.current
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default)]
pub struct RecoverySettings {            // SYS-013, all from unit properties; None = "Not reported"
    pub restart: Option<Arc<str>>,       // Restart= word
    pub restart_usec: Option<u64>,       // RestartUSec
    pub restart_steps: Option<u32>,      // RestartSteps
    pub restart_max_delay_usec: Option<u64>, // RestartMaxDelayUSec
    pub start_limit_burst: Option<u32>,
    pub start_limit_interval_usec: Option<u64>,
    pub start_limit_action: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub failure_action: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub on_failure: Arc<[Arc<str>]>,     // OnFailure= units; empty = "None"
    pub n_restarts: Option<u32>,         // NRestarts
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum Relation {
    Requires, Requisite, Wants, BindsTo, PartOf, Upholds,                 // "Depends on:"
    RequiredBy, RequisiteOf, WantedBy, BoundBy, ConsistsOf, UpheldBy,     // "Dependents:"
    After, Before,                                                        // "Ordering"
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct DepEntry { pub unit: UnitRef, pub relation: Relation }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct PidIds { pub uid: u32, pub gid: u32 }   // "Runs as: uid 1000, gid 1000"

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct UnitDetails {
    // General (SYS-011, UI-SYS-031)
    pub id: Arc<str>,
    pub description: Arc<str>,
    pub documentation: Arc<[Arc<str>]>,
    pub exec_start_argv: Arc<[Arc<str>]>,
    pub fragment_path: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub drop_in_paths: Arc<[Arc<str>]>,
    pub startup: StartupType,
    pub active_state: Arc<str>,
    pub sub_state: Arc<str>,
    pub active_enter_timestamp_us: Option<u64>,  // CLOCK_REALTIME microseconds
    pub main_pid: u32,
    pub memory_current: Option<u64>,     // None when systemd reports u64::MAX
    pub tasks_current: Option<u64>,      // None when systemd reports u64::MAX
    pub cpu_usage_nsec: Option<u64>,
    pub manager: Manager,
    // Log On (SYS-012, UI-SYS-032)
    pub user: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub group: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub dynamic_user: bool,
    pub supplementary_groups: Arc<[Arc<str>]>,
    pub pam_name: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub main_pid_ids: Option<PidIds>,    // None when MainPID is 0 ("Not running")
    pub graphical_session: bool,
    // Recovery (SYS-013, UI-SYS-033)
    pub recovery: RecoverySettings,
    pub recovery_dropin_exists: bool,
    // Dependencies (SYS-014, UI-SYS-034)
    pub deps: Arc<[DepEntry]>,           // sorted by unit name, one row per relation
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ServicesSnapshot {
    pub header: ComponentHeader,
    pub rows: Arc<[SysRow]>,
    pub query_generation: u64,
    pub units: Arc<[UnitRecord]>,
    pub counts: ServiceCounts,
    pub managers: [ManagerState; 2],     // index 0 = System, 1 = User
    pub details: Arc<HashMap<UnitRef, Arc<UnitDetails>>>, // units in Demand.unit_details (max 10)
    pub backend: ServiceBackend,
}
```

`HashMap` is `std::collections::HashMap`. `Default` for `ServicesSnapshot`: default header, empty slices and map, generation 0, counts zero, both managers in the `ManagerState` default, `backend: Systemd`. `Total` is from `table.rs` (E03-051); `SysRow`, `UnitRef`, `UnitType`, `Manager` from `table.rs` (E03-052); `ManagerState` from `health.rs` (E03-A1 half).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `("active", "running")`, `("active", "exited")`, `("activating", "start")`, `("deactivating", "stop")`, `("reloading", "")`, `("refreshing", "")`, `("inactive", "dead")`, `("failed", "failed")`, `("maintenance", "")` **When** `ServiceStatus::from_states` runs **Then** the results are Running, Active, Starting, Stopping, Reloading, Reloading, Stopped, Failed, Maintenance.
- **Given** `"enabled-runtime"`, `"masked-runtime"`, `"linked-runtime"` and `""` **When** `StartupType::from_unit_file_state` runs **Then** the results are EnabledRuntime, Masked, Linked and NoUnitFile.
- **Given** each of the other seven words in the StartupType comment **When** parsed **Then** each maps to its variant.
- **Given** `ServicesSnapshot::default()` **When** read **Then** `units` and `rows` are empty, `details` is empty and `backend` is `Systemd`.

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`: append the Services types above.

## Tests
- `snapshot.rs` unit tests: `service_status_mapping_sys003`, `startup_type_from_unit_file_state_all`, `services_snapshot_default_empty`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A here; source errors are in `HealthSnapshot`.
- Validity: resource fields carry `Validity`; units without a cgroup use `Missing` (column shows "-", never 0, SYS-003).
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: all strings are `Arc<str>` built once per unit change; unchanged units reuse their records.
- Privacy: `exec_start_argv` can hold secrets passed on command lines; never log it above debug level (ADR-015).

## Notes
- ADR-003 writes `details` as `FxHashMap`. `rustc-hash` is not in tl-model's allowed row (ADR-001), so this bead uses `std::collections::HashMap` (at most 10 entries). Open item "FxHashMap in tl-model".
- Field names come from the UI-SYS data bindings (`UnitDetails` fields in UI-SYS-031, 032; `units[record]` in UI-SYS-015); field types are derived (open item "Service record types"). `ServiceStatus` and `StartupType` words are SYS-003's.
- Depends on E03-050 (`ComponentHeader`), E03-051 (`Total`), E03-052 (`SysRow`, `UnitRef`, `UnitType`, `Manager`), E03-A1 (`ManagerState`, `ProcessKey`).
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-model`.

title: E03-055 snapshot.rs: Startup Apps and Connections components
description:
## Context
Adds the Startup Apps and Connections components to `tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`. The Startup and Connections workers (E14) fill them; the two P2 tabs and their Properties windows read them. Sources: ADR-003 "Per-component fields" (`StartupSnapshot`, `ConnectionsSnapshot`), UI-SYS-042, UI-SYS-062, SYS-019 to SYS-021, SYS-028 to SYS-031, SYS-034, R-082.

## Deliverable
Append to `crates/tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`:

```rust
// ---- Startup Apps ----
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum StartupStatus { Enabled, Disabled, Masked, NotInThisDesktop, MissingProgram }
// labels: "Enabled", "Disabled", "Masked", "Not in this desktop", "Missing program" (SYS-020)

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum StartupKind { AutostartUser, AutostartSystem, AutostartSystemOverridden, UserUnit, PlasmaPreStartup, PlasmaLogout }
// labels: "Autostart (user)", "Autostart (system)", "Autostart (system, overridden)",
//         "systemd user unit", "Plasma pre-startup script", "Plasma logout script"
impl StartupKind { pub const fn label(self) -> &'static str; }
impl StartupStatus { pub const fn label(self) -> &'static str; }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug, PartialOrd, Ord)]
pub enum Impact { High, Medium, Low, None, NotMeasured }  // sort order ascending as declared
impl Impact {
    /// SYS-021: High at 1000 ms or more, Medium 300..=999 ms, Low under 300 ms.
    pub const fn from_activation_ms(ms: u64) -> Impact;
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct ImpactDetail {
    pub activation_ms: u64,          // ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic - InactiveExitTimestampMonotonic
    pub started_after_login_ms: u64, // InactiveExitTimestampMonotonic - UserspaceTimestampMonotonic
    pub cpu_nsec: Option<u64>,       // CPUUsageNSec
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct StartupEntry {
    pub id: StartupRef,
    pub name: Arc<str>,
    pub icon_path: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub publisher: Option<Arc<str>>,     // "name version", "User", or None (blank)
    pub status: StartupStatus,
    pub impact: Impact,
    pub impact_detail: Option<ImpactDetail>,
    pub kind: StartupKind,
    pub location: Arc<str>,              // directory path
    pub command: Arc<str>,               // Exec, ExecStart or the script path
    pub source_path: Arc<str>,
    pub can_toggle: bool,
    pub can_delete: bool,
    pub can_run: bool,
    pub overridden_by_user: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default)]
pub struct StartupCounts { pub total: u32, pub enabled: u32, pub disabled: u32 }

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct StartupSnapshot {
    pub header: ComponentHeader,
    pub rows: Arc<[SysRow]>,
    pub query_generation: u64,
    pub entries: Arc<[StartupEntry]>,
    pub counts: StartupCounts,
}

// ---- Connections ----
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum ConnState {
    Listening, SynSent, SynReceived, Established, FinWait1, FinWait2, CloseWait,
    Closing, LastAck, TimeWait, Closed, Unknown,   // TCP
    Unconnected, Connected,                         // UDP
}
impl ConnState {
    /// Labels (SYS-029): LISTENING, SYN-SENT, SYN-RECEIVED, ESTABLISHED, FIN-WAIT-1, FIN-WAIT-2,
    /// CLOSE-WAIT, CLOSING, LAST-ACK, TIME-WAIT, CLOSED, UNKNOWN, UNCONNECTED, CONNECTED.
    pub const fn label(self) -> &'static str;
    /// Kernel TCP state number (include/net/tcp_states.h): 1 ESTABLISHED, 2 SYN_SENT, 3 SYN_RECV,
    /// 4 FIN_WAIT1, 5 FIN_WAIT2, 6 TIME_WAIT, 7 CLOSE, 8 CLOSE_WAIT, 9 LAST_ACK, 10 LISTEN,
    /// 11 CLOSING, 12 NEW_SYN_RECV (-> SynReceived); anything else -> Unknown.
    pub const fn from_tcp_state(n: u8) -> ConnState;
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct TcpInfoView {
    pub rtt_us: u32, pub rttvar_us: u32,      // "RTT <ms> (var <ms>)"
    pub snd_cwnd: u32,                        // "Congestion window"
    pub bytes_acked: u64, pub bytes_received: u64, // tcpi_bytes_acked / tcpi_bytes_received
    pub retransmits: u32,                     // tcpi_total_retrans
    pub last_data_recv_ms: u32,               // "Last data received <ms> ago"
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ConnRecord {
    pub cookie: u64,
    pub proto: Proto,
    pub family: Family,
    pub four_tuple: FourTuple,                // for SockDestroy targets
    pub local: Arc<str>,                      // engine-formatted once per cookie (table d forms)
    pub foreign: Arc<str>,                    // "*:*" for listeners and unconnected UDP
    pub state: ConnState,
    pub owners: SmallVec<[ProcessKey; 1]>,
    pub owner_validity: Validity,             // Restricted when the owner needs the helper
    pub uid: u32,
    pub inode: u64,
    pub ifindex: u32,
    pub recv_q: u32,
    pub send_q: u32,
    pub unit: Option<UnitRef>,
    pub tcp: Option<TcpInfoView>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ConnCounts { pub total: u32, pub tcp: u32, pub udp: u32, pub established: u32, pub listening: u32 }

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ConnectionsSnapshot {
    pub header: ComponentHeader,
    pub rows: Arc<[SysRow]>,
    pub query_generation: u64,
    pub records: Arc<[ConnRecord]>,
    pub counts: ConnCounts,
    pub destroy_supported: Option<bool>,      // set after the first SockDestroy answer
}
```

`Proto`, `Family`, `FourTuple` come from `actions.rs` (E03-053); `SysRow`, `StartupRef`, `UnitRef` from `table.rs` (E03-052).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** 1000, 999, 300, 299 and 0 ms **When** `Impact::from_activation_ms` runs **Then** the results are High, Medium, Medium, Low, Low.
- **Given** the kernel TCP state numbers 1 to 12 **When** `ConnState::from_tcp_state` runs **Then** they map to Established, SynSent, SynReceived, FinWait1, FinWait2, TimeWait, Closed, CloseWait, LastAck, Listening, Closing, SynReceived; 0 and 13 map to Unknown.
- **Given** each `ConnState` **When** `label()` is called **Then** it returns the SYS-029 label exactly.
- **Given** each `StartupKind` and `StartupStatus` **When** `label()` is called **Then** it returns the SYS-020 text exactly.
- **Given** `Impact` values **When** sorted ascending **Then** the order is High, Medium, Low, None, NotMeasured (UI-SYS impact order).

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`: append the Startup and Connections types above.

## Tests
- `snapshot.rs` unit tests: `impact_thresholds_sys021`, `conn_state_from_kernel_numbers`, `conn_state_labels_sys029`, `startup_labels_sys020`, `impact_sort_order`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: `owner_validity` is `Valid`, `Restricted` (another user's socket, needs the helper) or `Missing` (owner gone).
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: address strings are formatted once per cookie by the engine and shared, so an unchanged socket costs nothing per refresh.
- Privacy: commands of startup entries may contain secrets; never log `command` above debug level.

## Notes

title: E03-056 snapshot.rs: Inventory component and public IP state
description:
## Context
Adds the Inventory component to `tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`: the static values of the Information tab's ten sections. Live rows (uptime, available memory, counts, temperatures) come from `SystemSnapshot`, `SeriesSet` and `DeviceCatalog`, not from here. The `Inventory` worker (E12-A3) fills it on page open and on `RefreshNow`. Sources: ADR-003 (`InventorySnapshot` in the snapshot), ADR-008 (inventory row), PERF-094 to PERF-104, PERF-060 (public IP), UI-SYS-080 to UI-SYS-096, D-007 (no DIMM serials), R-030, R-050.

## Deliverable
Append to `crates/tl-model/src/snapshot.rs` (`Total<T>` from `table.rs` carries a value and its `Validity`; it is used here as the field type for every value):

```rust
pub type InvField<T> = Total<T>; // value + Validity; Restricted, Unsupported ("Not reported") as R-050

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct OsInfo {          // PERF-095
    pub name: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub logo_icon: Option<Arc<str>>, // os-release PRETTY_NAME, LOGO
    pub version: InvField<Arc<str>>,        // VERSION_ID, or "Rolling" when missing
    pub build: InvField<Arc<str>>,          // BUILD_ID; Unsupported when missing
    pub kernel: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub kernel_version: InvField<Arc<str>>, // uname release, version
    pub architecture: InvField<Arc<str>>,   // uname machine, e.g. "x86_64"
    pub install_date_s: InvField<i64>,      // unix seconds
    pub package_manager: InvField<Arc<str>>,// "pacman 7.0.0"
    pub machine_id: InvField<Arc<str>>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct ProcessorInfo {   // PERF-096
    pub name: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub vendor: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub architecture: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub family: InvField<u32>, pub model: InvField<u32>, pub stepping: InvField<u32>, // "Family 25 Model 97 Stepping 2"
    pub cores: InvField<u32>, pub logical: InvField<u32>,
    pub base_mhz: InvField<u32>, pub max_mhz: InvField<u32>,
    pub microcode: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub virtualization: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub avx512: InvField<bool>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct SystemInfo {      // PERF-097 static rows
    pub pretty_hostname: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub static_hostname: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub user_name: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub domain: Option<Arc<str>>,           // None hides the row (empty or "(none)")
    pub boot_time_s: InvField<i64>,         // unix seconds, now - CLOCK_BOOTTIME
    pub desktop: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub windowing_system: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub session_type: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub virtual_terminal: InvField<Arc<str>>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct MemoryInfo {      // PERF-098 static rows
    pub total_bytes: InvField<u64>, pub page_size: InvField<u64>, pub huge_page_size: InvField<u64>,
    pub swap_total_bytes: InvField<u64>, pub zram_bytes: InvField<u64>,
    pub peak_committed_bytes: InvField<u64>, // maximum Committed_AS seen since tasklens started
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct MemoryModule {    // PERF-099; no serial field (D-007)
    pub slot: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub capacity_bytes: InvField<u64>, pub speed_mts: InvField<u32>,
    pub kind: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub form_factor: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub manufacturer: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub part_number: InvField<Arc<str>>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct DiskDrive {       // PERF-100
    pub device: Option<DeviceIdx>,
    pub model: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub kind: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub interface: InvField<Arc<str>>,      // NVMe, SATA, USB, SCSI, virtio
    pub capacity_bytes: InvField<u64>, pub free_bytes: InvField<u64>,
    pub volumes: Arc<[Arc<str>]>,           // mount paths
    pub serial: InvField<Arc<str>>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)] pub enum FirmwareType { Uefi, LegacyBios }
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct FirmwareInfo {    // PERF-101
    pub firmware_type: InvField<Option<FirmwareType>>,
    pub bios_vendor: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub bios_version: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub bios_date: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub bios_release: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub secure_boot: InvField<bool>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct BoardInfo {       // PERF-102
    pub manufacturer: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub product: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub version: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub system_vendor: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub system_product: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub chassis_type: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub serial: InvField<Arc<str>>,         // board_serial is 0400: Restricted unprivileged
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct DisplayMode { pub width: u32, pub height: u32, pub refresh_mhz: u32, pub primary: bool } // "3840x2160 @ 144 Hz (primary)"
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct GraphicsAdapter { // PERF-103 static rows
    pub device: Option<DeviceIdx>,
    pub name: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub driver_version: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub kernel_module: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub vulkan_version: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub opengl_version: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub temperature_source: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub dedicated_bytes: InvField<u64>, pub shared_bytes: InvField<u64>,
    pub displays: Arc<[DisplayMode]>,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)] pub struct NetworkAdapter {  // PERF-104
    pub device: Option<DeviceIdx>,
    pub connection: InvField<Arc<str>>,     // name and type
    pub adapter_name: InvField<Arc<str>>, pub driver: InvField<Arc<str>>,
    pub link_speed_mbps: InvField<u32>,
    pub ip_addresses: Arc<[Arc<str>]>, pub mac: InvField<Arc<str>>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub enum PublicIpState {                    // PERF-060; never saved to disk
    #[default] NotFetched,
    Fetching,
    Fetched { v4: Option<Arc<str>>, v6: Option<Arc<str>>, fetched_at_s: i64 }, // "203.0.113.4 (fetched 14:02)"
    Failed(Arc<str>),
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct InventorySnapshot {
    pub header: ComponentHeader,
    pub os: OsInfo,
    pub processor: ProcessorInfo,
    pub system: SystemInfo,
    pub memory: MemoryInfo,
    pub modules: Arc<[MemoryModule]>,
    pub disks: Arc<[DiskDrive]>,
    pub firmware: FirmwareInfo,
    pub board: BoardInfo,
    pub graphics: Arc<[GraphicsAdapter]>,
    pub network: Arc<[NetworkAdapter]>,
    pub public_ip: PublicIpState,
}
```

`Total<T>` needs `Default` with `validity = WarmingUp` for every `T: Default`; add `impl<T: Default> Default for Total<T>` in `table.rs` here if E03-051 did not already provide it (it is the same file owner, E03).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `InventorySnapshot::default()` **When** read **Then** every field's validity is `WarmingUp`, every list is empty and `public_ip` is `NotFetched`.
- **Given** the `MemoryModule` type **When** its fields are listed in a test with a destructuring pattern **Then** the pattern has exactly the seven fields above (no serial; the test fails to compile if a field is added, which forces a review against D-007).

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`: append the inventory types above.
- `crates/tl-model/src/table.rs`: only if missing, `impl<T: Default> Default for Total<T>`.

## Tests
- `snapshot.rs` unit tests: `inventory_default_warming_up`, `memory_module_has_no_serial` (exhaustive destructuring `let MemoryModule { slot, capacity_bytes, speed_mts, kind, form_factor, manufacturer, part_number } = m;`).

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: inventory failure is the header validity `Failed` (UI "Could not load system information").
- Validity: per field: `Valid`, `Restricted` (board serial unprivileged), `Unsupported` ("Not reported"), `WarmingUp` before the first scan, `Failed`.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: the component is rebuilt only on page open and refresh.
- Privacy: DIMM serials are never read or stored (D-007, R-030). Machine ID, MAC and serials are shown only on screen; never log them.

## Notes
- No doc gives `InventorySnapshot`'s fields. They are derived one-to-one from the PERF-095 to PERF-104 row lists, static rows only. `PublicIpState` is placed here because PERF-060 has no snapshot home and the Information tab and Network page both show it; the fetch is `Command::RefreshNow(SourceId::PublicIp)` if E03-A1's `SourceId` has that variant. Open items "InventorySnapshot fields" and "Public IP state and trigger".
- Depends on E03-050, E03-051.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-model`.

title: E03-057 details.rs: Properties frame, General and Threads payloads
description:
## Context
First part of `tl-model/src/details.rs`: the Properties data path frame (targets, tabs, the per-target container and the `TabPayload` enum) and the General and Threads payloads. The `ProcessDetail` worker (E10-A2) fills these for the targets in `Demand.details`; the Properties windows (E23) read them. Live numbers (CPU, RssAnon, VmRSS, PSS, USS, swap, threads, I/O and network rates, GPU) are not in the payload; the window reads them from `ProcessRecord`. Sources: ADR-003 (`DetailsSnapshot`), UI-PWN-002, UI-PWN-006 (General fields), UI-PWN-008 (hashes and package check), UI-PWN-010 (Threads, `ThreadRow`), PROC-077 to PROC-079, R-096, R-097, R-119.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-model/src/details.rs` (placeholder from E03-001):

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum DetailTarget { Process(ProcessKey), App(GroupKey) }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum DetailTab { General, Threads, Fds, Maps, Security, Environment, Strings, AppGeneral, AppProcesses }
impl DetailTab { pub const ALL: [DetailTab; 9]; pub const fn index(self) -> usize; } // declaration order 0..=8

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum TabPayload {
    General(Arc<GeneralDetail>),
    Threads(Arc<[ThreadRow]>),
    Fds(Arc<FdDetail>),             // E03-058
    Maps(Arc<MapsDetail>),          // E03-058
    Security(Arc<SecurityDetail>),  // E03-058
    Environ(Arc<EnvDetail>),        // E03-058
    Strings(Arc<StringScanState>),  // E03-059
    AppGeneral(Arc<AppGeneralDetail>), // E03-059
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct TabSlot { pub payload: Option<Arc<TabPayload>>, pub version: u64, pub validity: Validity }

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct TargetDetail { pub tabs: [TabSlot; 9] }   // indexed by DetailTab::index(); AppProcesses has no payload (reads Snapshot.processes)
impl TargetDetail { pub fn tab(&self, tab: DetailTab) -> &TabSlot; }

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum HashError { ReadFailed { errno: i32 }, ExePathUnavailable }
// UI text: "Failed to compute one or more hashes" (with errno text), "Executable path unavailable"

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub enum HashState { #[default] Pending, Done { sha256: [u8; 32], md5: [u8; 16] }, Failed(HashError) }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub enum PackageCheck { #[default] NotVerified, Verifying, Matches, DoesNotMatch, NotPackaged, NoChecksum, Failed }
// words: "Not verified", "Verifying…", "Matches package", "Does not match package", "Not packaged",
// "No checksum in package database"; Failed = toast "Could not verify against the package."

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] pub enum Relro { Full, Partial, None }
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] pub enum Seccomp { Disabled, Strict, Filter { filters: u32 } }
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] pub enum ElfArch { X86_64, X86, AArch64, Unknown } // "x86-64", "x86 (32-bit)", "AArch64", "Unknown"
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ExeLocation { TempDirectory, UserDownloads, UserData, UserProfile, System, OptionalSoftware, Flatpak, AppImage, WinePrefix, Deleted, Other }
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] pub enum GpuEngine { ThreeD, Compute, VideoDecode, VideoEncode } // "3D", "Compute", "Video decode", "Video encode"

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct IdTriple { pub real: u32, pub effective: u32, pub saved: u32, pub fs: u32 }

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PackageInfo { pub name: Arc<str>, pub version: Arc<str>, pub packager: Option<Arc<str>> } // "firefox 131.0-1"

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct GeneralDetail {
    // column 1 (UI-PWN-006)
    pub started_s: Total<i64>,             // unix seconds, "Started:" YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS local
    pub uids: Total<IdTriple>, pub uid_names: Total<(Arc<str>, Arc<str>, Arc<str>)>, // real, effective, saved names
    pub policy: Total<SchedPolicy>, pub rt_prio: u8, pub kernel_prio: Total<i32>,
    pub autogroup: Total<(Arc<str>, i8)>,  // ("autogroup-12", nice); Unsupported when /proc/<pid>/autogroup is absent
    pub affinity: Total<CpuSet>, pub affinity_threads_differ: bool,
    pub pie: Total<bool>, pub nx_stack: Total<bool>, pub relro: Total<Relro>,
    pub shadow_stack: Total<bool>,         // Unsupported when no x86_Thread_features line
    pub aslr_system: Total<u8>,            // 0, 1, 2 from /proc/sys/kernel/randomize_va_space
    pub aslr_disabled_for_process: Total<bool>, // personality ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE
    pub no_new_privs: Total<bool>, pub seccomp: Total<Seccomp>,
    pub architecture: Total<ElfArch>,
    pub exe: Total<Arc<str>>, pub exe_deleted: bool,
    pub location: Total<ExeLocation>,
    pub package: Total<Option<PackageInfo>>, // Valid(None) = "Not packaged"
    pub description: Total<Arc<str>>,      // package %DESC%, else desktop Comment, else Unsupported
    pub cwd: Total<Arc<str>>, pub root: Total<Arc<str>>,
    pub cgroup: Option<Arc<str>>, pub unit: Option<UnitRef>, pub app_id: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub cmdline: Total<Arc<str>>,          // full, up to 32 KiB (R-008), sanitized
    // column 2 and 3 values that are not in ProcessRecord
    pub hashes: HashState, pub package_check: PackageCheck,
    pub handles: Total<u32>,
    pub rss_shared_bytes: Total<u64>,      // RssFile + RssShmem
    pub commit_bytes: Total<u64>,          // VmData + VmStk
    pub cpu_time_ms: Total<u64>,           // utime + stime
    pub io_rchar: Total<u64>, pub io_wchar: Total<u64>, pub io_syscr: Total<u64>, pub io_syscw: Total<u64>,
    pub disk_read_bytes: Total<u64>, pub disk_write_bytes: Total<u64>, pub cancelled_write_bytes: Total<u64>,
    pub gpu_mem_shared_bytes: Total<u64>,  // Unsupported when not reported
    pub gpu_engine: Total<Option<GpuEngine>>, // Valid(None) = "None"
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ThreadRow {                     // UI-PWN-010
    pub tid: u32, pub comm: Arc<str>, pub state: ProcState,
    pub cpu_pct: f32, pub utime_ms: u64, pub stime_ms: u64,
    pub policy: SchedPolicy, pub rt_prio: u8, pub nice: i8,
    pub cpus: Arc<str>,                    // Cpus_allowed_list text, e.g. "0-7,16-23"
    pub last_cpu: u32, pub vol_ctx: u64, pub invol_ctx: u64,
    pub wchan: Arc<str>,
    pub validity: Validity,
}
```

`FdDetail`, `MapsDetail`, `SecurityDetail`, `EnvDetail`, `StringScanState` and `AppGeneralDetail` are declared by E03-058 and E03-059. So this file compiles on its own, this bead declares each of those six as an empty `pub struct X {}` with a `// filled by E03-05n` comment; the later beads replace the empty struct in place.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `DetailTab::ALL` **When** iterated **Then** `index()` returns 0..=8 in declaration order.
- **Given** `TargetDetail::default()` **When** `tab(DetailTab::Strings)` is read **Then** `payload` is `None`, `version` is 0 and `validity` is `WarmingUp`.
- **Given** `HashState::default()` and `PackageCheck::default()` **When** read **Then** they are `Pending` and `NotVerified`.
- **Given** two `DetailTarget::Process` values with the same key **When** hashed and compared **Then** they are equal; a `Process` and an `App` target are never equal.

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/details.rs`: the types above plus the six empty forward structs.

## Tests
- `details.rs` unit tests: `detail_tab_index_order`, `target_detail_default_slots`, `hash_and_package_defaults`, `detail_target_eq_hash`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: hash errors as `HashError`; the UI words are in the comments above (UI-PWN-008).
- Validity: every payload field that can be unreadable is a `Total<T>`; `Restricted` for exe, cwd, root, personality, io and smaps of other UIDs (UI-PWN-006).
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: payloads are whole `Arc`s per tab; an unchanged tab reuses its `Arc` so the UI compares pointers.
- Privacy: `cmdline` may hold secrets; it is sanitized by tl-collect (ADR-015) and never logged.

## Notes
- ADR-003 and UI-PWN-002 name `TabPayload`, `TargetDetail` and the payload type names; the field lists of `GeneralDetail` and `ThreadRow` are mapped one-to-one from the UI-PWN-006 and UI-PWN-010 field lists (only values not already in `ProcessRecord`). `TabSlot` and the `[TabSlot; 9]` layout are this bead's form of "one `Option<Arc<TabPayload>>` per tab with its own version and validity". Open item "Properties payload fields".
- `ProcState` and `CpuSet` come from the E03-A1 half; `SchedPolicy` from `actions.rs` (E03-053); `UnitRef` from `table.rs`; `Total` from `table.rs`.
- Depends on E03-051, E03-052, E03-053, E03-A1.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-model`.

title: E03-058 details.rs: file descriptor, memory map, security and environment payloads
description:
## Context
Second part of `tl-model/src/details.rs`: the File descriptors, Memory maps, Security and Environment payloads of the Process Properties window. Replaces the empty forward structs `FdDetail`, `MapsDetail`, `SecurityDetail` and `EnvDetail` that E03-057 declared. Sources: UI-PWN-012 (fds), UI-PWN-013 (maps), UI-PWN-014 and UI-PWN-015 (security), UI-PWN-016 (environment), PROC-080 to PROC-083, R-098, R-099.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-model/src/details.rs`, replace the four empty structs with:

```rust
// ---- File descriptors (UI-PWN-012) ----
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum FdKind { File, Directory, Tcp, Udp, Unix, Netlink, Pipe, Fifo, Eventfd, Eventpoll, Timerfd,
                  Signalfd, Inotify, Fanotify, Memfd, Dmabuf, Drm, Pidfd, IoUring, AnonInode, Device }
impl FdKind {
    /// "file", "directory", "TCP", "UDP", "unix", "netlink", "pipe", "FIFO", "eventfd", "eventpoll",
    /// "timerfd", "signalfd", "inotify", "fanotify", "memfd", "dmabuf", "DRM", "pidfd", "io_uring",
    /// "anon_inode", "device"
    pub const fn label(self) -> &'static str;
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct FdRow {
    pub fd: i32,
    pub kind: FdKind,
    pub name: Arc<str>,             // readlink target or socket text, sanitized
    pub unnamed: bool,              // anon_inode and other unnamed handles (Hide unnamed handles)
    pub pos: Option<u64>,           // fdinfo pos; None for sockets and pipes ("-")
    pub flags: Option<u32>,         // fdinfo flags (octal "Raw flags"); None when fdinfo unreadable
    pub mnt_id: Option<u32>,

}

// ---- Memory maps (UI-PWN-013) ----

pub struct MapRegion {
    pub start: u64, pub end: u64,
    pub perms: [u8; 4],             // e.g. *b"r-xp"

    pub label: Option<Arc<str>>,    // "[heap]", "[stack]", "[vdso]", "[vvar]", "anonymous", "memfd:<name>"
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct MapNode {
    pub name: Arc<str>,             // file name; the UI adds " (Primary)" or shows "Outside loaded modules"
    pub path: Option<Arc<str>>,

    pub shared_object: bool,        // counts for "Shared libraries only" (includes Wine .dll mappings)
    pub base: u64,                  // lowest start
    pub size_bytes: u64,            // sum of region sizes
    pub rss_bytes: Total<u64>,      // sum of region RSS
    pub description: Option<Arc<str>>, // package %DESC%
    pub package: Option<Arc<str>>,  // "glibc 2.42-1"
    pub regions: std::ops::Range<u32>, // indexes into MapsDetail.regions, address order
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]

// ---- Security (UI-PWN-014, UI-PWN-015) ----
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)] pub enum Elevated { Root, Capabilities, Setuid, No }
// "Yes (root)", "Yes (capabilities)", "Setuid", "No"

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct GroupMembershipRow { pub name: Arc<str>, pub gid: u32, pub primary: bool,
                                pub root_equivalent: bool, // docker, libvirt, lxd, disk
                                pub admin: bool }          // wheel, sudo, root, adm
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct SecurityDetail {
    pub uids: Total<IdTriple>, pub uid_names: Total<[Arc<str>; 4]>,  // real, effective, saved, fs
    pub gids: Total<IdTriple>, pub gid_names: Total<[Arc<str>; 4]>,
    pub elevated: Total<Elevated>,
    pub no_new_privs: Total<bool>, pub seccomp: Total<Seccomp>, pub dumpable: Total<bool>,

    pub store_bypass: Total<Arc<str>>,   // Speculation_Store_Bypass text as given
    pub indirect_branch: Total<Arc<str>>,// SpeculationIndirectBranch text
    pub caps: Arc<[CapRow]>,             // capabilities set in Effective, Permitted, Inheritable or Ambient
    pub groups: Arc<[GroupMembershipRow]>,
}

// ---- Environment (UI-PWN-016) ----
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct EnvDetail {
    pub vars: Arc<[(Box<str>, Box<str>)]>, // name, value; read once on open and on DetailRefresh
    pub truncated: bool,                   // cut at 1 MiB
    pub read_errno: Option<i32>,           // "(read failed)" row with the errno text
    pub unavailable: bool,                 // zombie or kernel thread: "Environment block unavailable"
}

/// R-099: names masked by default, case-insensitive substring match.
pub const ENV_MASK_PATTERNS: [&str; 7] = ["TOKEN", "SECRET", "PASSWORD", "PASSWD", "KEY", "COOKIE", "CREDENTIAL"];
pub fn env_name_is_masked(name: &str) -> bool; // ASCII case-insensitive contains of any pattern
```

`Seccomp` and `IdTriple` are from E03-057.

- **Given** each `FdKind` **When** `label()` is called **Then** it returns the UI-PWN-012 word exactly.

- **Given** the names `PATH`, `HOME`, `DISPLAY`, `LANG` **When** `env_name_is_masked` runs **Then** each returns false.

## Tests

- Errors: unreadable fdinfo sets `fdinfo_available = false` ("Handle detail query unavailable."); environment read error carries the errno.
- Validity: whole-tab `Restricted` is the `TabSlot.validity` (UI-PWN-018 access state); per-field `Total` validity for namespaces of other UIDs.
- Accessibility: N/A.

title: E03-059 details.rs: Strings, App, handle search, affinity and DetailsSnapshot
description:
## Context
Last part of `tl-model/src/details.rs`: the Strings scan state, the App Properties payload, the Search File Handles state, the affinity masks for the Set Affinity dialog, and the `DetailsSnapshot` component that holds all of them. Replaces the empty forward structs `StringScanState` and `AppGeneralDetail` that E03-057 declared. Sources: ADR-003 (`DetailsSnapshot`), UI-PWN-017 (strings), UI-PWN-020 (App Properties), UI-PWN-021 (affinity), UI-PWN-030 and UI-PWN-031 (handle search), PROC-084, PROC-085, PROC-096, R-061, R-102, R-119.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-model/src/details.rs`:

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug, PartialOrd, Ord)] pub struct ScanId(pub u64);   // allocated by the UI, starting at 1
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug, PartialOrd, Ord)] pub struct SearchId(pub u64); // allocated by the UI, starting at 1

// ---- Strings (UI-PWN-017, PROC-084) ----
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct StringScanOpts { pub min_len: u8, pub ascii: bool, pub utf8: bool, pub utf16le: bool, pub include_file_backed: bool }
// Default: min_len 4 (range 4..=64), ascii, utf8, utf16le true, include_file_backed false
impl StringScanOpts {
    pub const MIN_LEN_RANGE: std::ops::RangeInclusive<u8> = 4..=64;
    pub fn any_encoding(&self) -> bool; // false disables Scan ("Choose at least one encoding")
}
pub const STRING_SCAN_MAX_HITS: u32 = 1_000_000;
pub const STRING_SCAN_MAX_TEXT_BYTES: u64 = 256 * 1024 * 1024;
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)] pub enum StringEncoding { Ascii, Utf8, Utf16Le } // "ASCII", "UTF-8", "UTF-16LE"
#[derive(Clone, Debug)] pub struct StringHit { pub address: u64, pub encoding: StringEncoding, pub length: u32, pub value: Arc<str> }
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ScanPhase { Scanning, Finished, Cancelled, StoppedLimit, StoppedExited, Failed(Arc<str>) }
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct StringScanState {
    pub scan: ScanId,
    pub progress_pct: u8,
    pub found: u32,
    pub chunks: Arc<[Arc<[StringHit]>]>,  // append-only; each new payload reuses the old chunk Arcs
    pub phase: ScanPhase,
}

// ---- App Properties (UI-PWN-020) ----
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)] pub enum AppKind { App, Unit }   // "App", "Unit"
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct AppGeneralDetail {
    pub name: Arc<str>,
    pub kind: AppKind,
    pub icon_path: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub app_id: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub desktop_file: Option<Arc<str>>,
    pub unit: Option<UnitRef>,

    pub swap_bytes: Total<u64>,          // memory.swap.current
    pub disk_read_bps: Total<f64>,       // io.stat rbytes delta
    pub disk_write_bps: Total<f64>,      // io.stat wbytes delta
    pub primary_cmdline: Total<Arc<str>>,// "Command line (primary process)"
}

// ---- Set Affinity (UI-PWN-021) ----
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct AffinityInfo { pub mask: CpuSet, pub cpuset_limit: CpuSet }

// ---- Search File Handles (UI-PWN-030, UI-PWN-031) ----
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum HandlePhase { Initializing, Retrieving, Searching, Done, Stopped, Failed }
// "Initializing... please wait.", "Retrieving file handles... 42% (18 234 total handles)", "Searching...",
// "Found 12 matches" / "Found 1 match" / "No results found.", "Search stopped. Found 12 matches", "Handle search failed"
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)] pub enum HandleKind { Fd, Mmap, Cwd, Exe, Root } // "fd", "mmap", "cwd", "exe", "root"
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct HandleHit { pub key: ProcessKey, pub name: Arc<str>, pub user: Arc<str>,
                       pub kind: HandleKind, pub fd: Option<i32>, pub path: Arc<str> }
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct HandleSearchState {
    pub search: SearchId,
    pub phase: HandlePhase,
    pub progress_pct: u8,
    pub total_handles: u64,              // "(18 234 total handles)"
    pub chunks: Arc<[Arc<[HandleHit]>]>, // append-only, never copied
    pub searched: u32,                   // processes searched
    pub total: u32,                      // processes in total
    pub skipped: u32,                    // processes that need administrator rights
}

// ---- the component ----
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct DetailsSnapshot {
    pub header: ComponentHeader,
    pub targets: HashMap<DetailTarget, Arc<TargetDetail>>,   // max 16 (Demand.details)
    pub affinity: HashMap<ProcessKey, AffinityInfo>,         // keys of Demand.affinity_targets, max 256
    pub handle_search: Option<Arc<HandleSearchState>>,
}
```

`HashMap` is `std::collections::HashMap`. `Default for StringScanOpts` follows the comment. `CpuSet` and `ProcessKey` come from the E03-A1 half; `UnitRef` and `Total` from `table.rs`; `ComponentHeader` from `snapshot.rs`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `StringScanOpts::default()` **When** read **Then** `min_len == 4`, the three encodings are on and `include_file_backed` is off.
- **Given** options with all three encodings off **When** `any_encoding()` is called **Then** it returns false.
- **Given** `DetailsSnapshot::default()` **When** read **Then** `targets` and `affinity` are empty and `handle_search` is `None`.
- **Given** the constants **When** read **Then** `STRING_SCAN_MAX_HITS == 1_000_000` and `STRING_SCAN_MAX_TEXT_BYTES == 268_435_456`.

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/details.rs`: replace the two empty forward structs and add the rest above.

## Tests
- `details.rs` unit tests: `string_scan_opts_default`, `string_scan_no_encoding`, `details_snapshot_default_empty`, `string_scan_limits`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: `ScanPhase::Failed` and `HandlePhase::Failed` carry the "Failed to read process memory." and "Handle search failed" states; texts live in the UI.
- Validity: App payload values carry `Total` validity.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: hits are append-only `Arc` chunks so a 1,000,000-row result is never copied; payloads arrive at most 4 times per second while scanning (engine rule).
- Privacy: string hits are process memory and may contain secrets; never log `StringHit.value` or `HandleHit.path` above debug level.

## Notes
- ADR-003 writes `targets` and `affinity` as `FxHashMap`; `rustc-hash` is not in tl-model's allowed row, so `std::collections::HashMap` is used (open item "FxHashMap in tl-model"). ADR-003 writes handle `chunks: Arc<[HandleHit]>`; UI-PWN-030 says "chunks of hits" and needs append-only reuse, so the chunk list form of the Strings tab is used here as well (open item "Properties payload fields").
- `StoppedExited` is the "Scan stopped: the process exited." state of UI-PWN-017.
- Depends on E03-057, E03-058, E03-050.

title: E03-060 demand.rs: Demand, ColumnSet, DetailDemand and TrayDemand
description:
## Context
Fills `tl-model/src/demand.rs`: the `Demand` value the UI's `DemandAggregator` builds and sends with `EngineClient::set_demand`, and which every engine worker reads to pick its rate or switch off. Sources: ADR-008 "Demand type" and "Schedule", UI-PWN-002 (`DetailDemand`), UI-PWN-021, UI-SYS-013, UI-SYS-030, UI-SYS-069, UI-SYS-070, R-119.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-model/src/demand.rs` (placeholder from E03-001):

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default)]
pub enum CpuDemand { #[default] Off, Total, PerCore }   // PerCore implies Total
impl CpuDemand { pub fn wants_total(self) -> bool; pub fn wants_per_core(self) -> bool; }

/// Bitset of ColumnId, 256 bits. Bit index = ColumnId's dense index from ids.rs (E03-A1).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ColumnSet(pub [u64; 4]);
impl ColumnSet {
    pub const EMPTY: Self = Self([0; 4]);
    pub fn insert(&mut self, c: ColumnId);
    pub fn remove(&mut self, c: ColumnId);
    pub fn contains(&self, c: ColumnId) -> bool;
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
    pub fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = ColumnId> + '_;
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub struct DetailDemand { pub target: DetailTarget, pub tab: DetailTab }

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Debug, Default)]
pub struct TrayDemand {               // P3
    pub icons_shown: bool,            // any tray icon visible (counts as a visible surface)
    pub cpu: bool, pub memory: bool, pub disks: bool, pub nets: bool, pub gpus: bool,
    pub process_keys: Arc<[ProcessKey]>, // process tray graph sources
}

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Demand {
    pub any_surface_visible: bool,
    pub cpu: CpuDemand,               // Off | Total | PerCore
    pub cpu_fast: bool,               // a visible CPU chart is animating: use 10 Hz
    pub memory: bool, pub disks: bool, pub nets: bool, pub gpus: bool, pub sensors: bool,
    pub process_table: bool,
    pub process_columns: ColumnSet,
    pub detail_keys: Arc<[ProcessKey]>,     // visible rows plus one viewport of overscan, max 512
    pub gpu_process: bool,
    pub connections: bool, pub services: bool, pub startup: bool, pub inventory: bool,
    pub details: Arc<[DetailDemand]>,       // P2: open Properties windows, max 16
    pub affinity_targets: Arc<[ProcessKey]>,// P2: open Set Affinity dialog, max 256
    pub service_cgroup_stats: bool,         // P2: a unit resource column is shown
    pub unit_details: Arc<[UnitRef]>,       // P2: open Service Properties windows, max 10
    pub remote_host_cookies: Arc<[u64]>,    // P4: visible rows of the Remote host column
    pub connections_all_netns: bool,        // P4: Namespaces "All"
    pub tray: TrayDemand,                   // P3
    pub recording: bool,                    // history recording enabled (P3)
}

pub const DETAIL_KEYS_MAX: usize = 512;
pub const DETAILS_MAX: usize = 16;
pub const AFFINITY_TARGETS_MAX: usize = 256;
pub const UNIT_DETAILS_MAX: usize = 10;

impl Demand {
    /// Truncates every list to its max above (keeps the first entries). The aggregator calls it before sending.
    pub fn clamp_lists(&mut self);
}
```

`DetailTarget` and `DetailTab` come from `details.rs` (E03-057); `UnitRef` from `table.rs`; `ProcessKey`, `ColumnId` from `ids.rs`. `Demand::default()` means nothing is visible and every source is off.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `CpuDemand::PerCore` **When** `wants_total()` is called **Then** it returns true; `CpuDemand::Off` returns false for both methods.
- **Given** an empty `ColumnSet` **When** the ids for `cpu` and `memory` are inserted **Then** `contains` is true for both, false for `pid`, and `iter()` yields exactly those two.
- **Given** a set with `cpu` **When** `remove(cpu)` runs **Then** `is_empty()` is true.
- **Given** a `Demand` with 600 `detail_keys`, 20 `details`, 300 `affinity_targets` and 12 `unit_details` **When** `clamp_lists` runs **Then** the lengths are 512, 16, 256 and 10 and the kept entries are the first ones.
- **Given** two `Demand` values that differ only in `cpu_fast` **When** compared **Then** they are not equal (the UI sends only when demand changed).
- **Given** `Demand::default()` **When** read **Then** every bool is false, `cpu` is `Off` and every list is empty.

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/demand.rs`: the types, constants and methods above.

## Tests
- `demand.rs` unit tests: `cpu_demand_per_core_implies_total`, `column_set_insert_contains_iter`, `column_set_remove_empty`, `demand_clamp_lists`, `demand_eq_detects_cpu_fast`, `demand_default_all_off`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: `Demand` is cloned at most every 100 ms; lists are shared `Arc` slices.
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- **ColumnSet bit index.** ADR-008 says "bitset of ColumnId" without a size. This bead needs a dense index per column (0..256) from `ids.rs`. If E03-A1's `ColumnId` has no dense index, stop and raise it to the leader; do not edit `ids.rs` from this bead. Open item "ColumnId dense index for ColumnSet".
- **TrayDemand fields** are not defined in any doc (ADR-008 names the type, P3). The fields above are the recommendation in open item "TrayDemand fields"; confirm before starting.

title: E03-061 journal.rs: journal query, events and JournalHandle
description:
## Context
Fills `tl-model/src/journal.rs`: the journal stream types behind `EngineClient::journal`, used by the Service Properties Logs tab. The engine runs `journalctl` per handle and batches entries at most every 100 ms; dropping the handle kills the child. Sources: ADR-005 (client trait and journal types), ADR-016 (service logs), R-074, R-118, UI-SYS-036, UI-SYS-037, SYS-015.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-model/src/journal.rs` (placeholder from E03-001):

```rust
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct JournalQuery { pub unit: UnitRef, pub follow: bool }  // last 200 entries of this boot first

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct JournalEntry { pub realtime_us: u64, pub priority: u8, pub pid: Option<u32>,
                          pub message: Arc<str>, pub cursor: Arc<str> }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum JournalAccess { All, OwnOnly }

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum JournalError { NotFound, Timeout, Exit { code: i32, stderr_first_line: Arc<str> } }

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum JournalEvent {
    Batch { entries: Arc<[JournalEntry]>, older: bool, exhausted: bool },
    Access(JournalAccess),
    Error(JournalError),
}

/// Control messages from the handle to the engine's journal task.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum JournalControl { LoadOlder, SetFollow(bool) }

pub const JOURNAL_PAGE: usize = 200;   // entries per initial load and per load_older

pub struct JournalHandle {
    events: async_channel::Receiver<JournalEvent>,
    control: async_channel::Sender<JournalControl>,
}
impl JournalHandle {
    /// Engine side builds the pair; the engine keeps the event sender and control receiver.
    pub fn new(events: async_channel::Receiver<JournalEvent>, control: async_channel::Sender<JournalControl>) -> Self;
    pub fn events(&self) -> async_channel::Receiver<JournalEvent>;  // clone of the receiver
    pub fn load_older(&self);            // try_send(LoadOlder); a full or closed channel is ignored
    pub fn set_follow(&self, on: bool);  // try_send(SetFollow(on)); off kills the `-f` child, on resumes with --after-cursor
}
// Dropping the handle drops `control`; the engine's task sees the closed channel and kills the child.
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a handle built from a fresh pair of channels **When** `load_older()` then `set_follow(false)` are called **Then** the control receiver yields `LoadOlder` then `SetFollow(false)` in that order.
- **Given** a handle **When** it is dropped **Then** the control receiver reports closed (`recv_blocking` returns `Err`).
- **Given** a control channel that is closed **When** `load_older()` is called **Then** it does not panic.
- **Given** an event sent on the engine side **When** the UI receives from `events()` **Then** it gets the same event.

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/journal.rs`: the types above.

## Tests
- `journal.rs` unit tests (use `async_channel::bounded` and the blocking `recv_blocking` / `send_blocking`, no runtime): `handle_control_order`, `handle_drop_closes_control`, `handle_closed_control_no_panic`, `handle_events_pass_through`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: `JournalError::{NotFound ("journalctl not found"), Timeout ("Reading the journal took too long."), Exit { .. } ("Could not read the journal")}`; texts belong to the UI.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: entries arrive in `Arc` batches at most every 100 ms.
- Privacy: log messages can contain secrets; the engine and UI never write them to tasklens's own log.

## Notes
- ADR-005 says the handle is "async_channel receiver plus a control sender"; `JournalControl`, `new()` and the try-send rule are the concrete form of that sentence. The control channel capacity is chosen by the engine bead (E14-A4).
- `async-channel` is in tl-model's allowed row (ADR-001).
- Depends on E03-052 (`UnitRef`).
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-model`.

title: E03-062 history.rs: RecordSink and HistoryView types
description:
## Context
Fills `tl-model/src/history.rs`: the `RecordSink` hook the reducer holds (`None` in P1 and P2, set by the P3 recorder and rolling window) and the `HistoryView` component that answers `Command::HistoryQuery`. The hook is binding on P1 code (ADR-012 constraint 4); the view types are needed up front because `Snapshot.history` exists from P1. Sources: ADR-012, ADR-009 (decimation), UI-PRC-030 to UI-PRC-037, PROC-086 to PROC-092, D-003, D-010.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-model/src/history.rs` (placeholder from E03-001):

```rust
pub trait RecordSink: Send + 'static {
    fn on_system_sample(&mut self, t_ns: TimeNs, series: &[(SeriesId, Sample)]);
    fn on_process_sweep(&mut self, t_ns: TimeNs, records: &Arc<[ProcessRecord]>);
    fn on_device_catalog(&mut self, catalog: &DeviceCatalog);
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum HistoryMetric { Cpu, Memory, Disk, Network, Gpu }   // legend chips, keys 1..5 (UI-PRC-035)

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug, Default)]
pub enum HistorySource { #[default] RollingWindow, Store }   // recording off = RollingWindow (D-010)

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Debug)]
pub struct HistoryPoint { pub t_ns: TimeNs, pub min: f32, pub max: f32, pub gap_before: bool } // decimated min/max

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct HistorySeries { pub metric: HistoryMetric, pub key: Option<ProcessKey>, // None = system total
                           pub points: Arc<[HistoryPoint]> }                      // max 1,024 points

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct HistoryProcessRow {
    pub key: ProcessKey, pub ppid: u32,
    pub comm: Arc<str>, pub name: Arc<str>, pub exe_basename: Option<Arc<str>>, pub app_id: Option<Arc<str>>, // no cmdline (ADR-015)
    pub cpu_pct: f32,            // from cpu_permille
    pub mem_anon_bytes: u64,     // from mem_anon_kib (RssAnon, D-004)
    pub io_read_bps: f32, pub io_write_bps: f32,
    pub net_bps: f32,
    pub gpu_pct: f32,
    pub alive: bool,             // false when the identity ended before the queried time
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct HistoryTopEntry { pub key: ProcessKey, pub name: Arc<str>, pub value: f32 }

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct HistoryView {
    pub header: ComponentHeader,
    pub query_id: u64,                       // id of the HistoryQuery this answers
    pub source: HistorySource,
    pub span: Option<(TimeNs, TimeNs)>,      // oldest and newest retained time
    pub series: Arc<[HistorySeries]>,        // for the requested range and metric
    pub overview: Arc<[HistoryPoint]>,       // whole retention, max 1,024 points
    pub rows: Arc<[HistoryProcessRow]>,      // at the scrub time or over the range
    pub top: Arc<[HistoryTopEntry]>,         // answer to TopAt (n = 3)
    pub deleted: Arc<[ProcessKey]>,          // keys removed by HistoryDelete, filtered by the engine
}

pub const HISTORY_MAX_POINTS: usize = 1024;
```

`TimeNs`, `SeriesId`, `Sample`, `ProcessRecord`, `DeviceCatalog`, `ProcessKey` come from the E03-A1 half; `ComponentHeader` from `snapshot.rs`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a test struct implementing `RecordSink` that counts calls **When** it is boxed as `Box<dyn RecordSink>` and each method is called once **Then** the counts are one each (the trait is object safe and `Send`).
- **Given** `HistoryView::default()` **When** read **Then** `source` is `RollingWindow`, `span` is `None` and every list is empty.
- **Given** `HISTORY_MAX_POINTS` **When** read **Then** it is 1024.

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/history.rs`: the trait, types and constant above.

## Tests
- `history.rs` unit tests: `record_sink_object_safe_send`, `history_view_default`, `history_max_points`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: load errors are toasts from PROC-087 raised by the engine; N/A here.
- Validity: header validity `WarmingUp` while the store loads (first 2 s).
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: views are whole `Arc`s; at most 1,024 points per series.
- Privacy: command lines are never stored in history and never appear in these types (ADR-012, ADR-015).

## Notes
- ADR-012 fixes `RecordSink` exactly and names `HistoryView`, `HistoryPoint`, `HistoryProcessRow` (00-epics section 2). Their fields are derived from the UI-PRC-030 to UI-PRC-037 data bindings (`series`, `span`, `overview`, `rows`, `source`, TopAt answer) and the ADR-012 `HistProcess` fields. Open item "History query and view types".

title: E03-063 command.rs: Command, KWinCommand, SetupStep, history query, AppRequest and Tab
description:
## Context
Fills `tl-model/src/command.rs`: every command the UI queues with `EngineClient::send`, the KWin bridge commands, the setup steps, the history query parameters, `CommandError`, and the `AppRequest` that `tl-app`'s single-instance handler sends to the UI. Sources: ADR-005 "UI to engine" (the `Command` enum), R-119, R-136, ADR-010 (single instance), UI-SHL-112, UI-SHL-014 (picker), PROC-052 to PROC-055, PERF-086 (detached graph geometry), R-084, R-086, UI-PRF-052, table (c) (`tasklens-setup` subcommands, `--tab`, `ActivateAction`), R-023 (tab set).

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-model/src/command.rs` (placeholder from E03-001):

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum Tab { Processes, Performance, Services, Startup, Connections, Information } // R-023 order
impl Tab {
    pub const ALL: [Tab; 6];
    pub const fn as_str(self) -> &'static str;   // "processes", "performance", "services", "startup", "connections", "information"
    pub fn from_str(s: &str) -> Option<Tab>;     // exact lowercase match (used by --tab and ActivateAction "tab")
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AppRequest { Activate { token: Option<Arc<str>> }, SelectTab(Tab), SelectPid(u32), Quit }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum CommandError { Busy, EngineStopped }

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum KWinCommand {
    Activate { internal_id: Arc<str> },
    Close { internal_id: Arc<str> },
    KeepAbove { pid: u32, caption: Option<Arc<str>>, on: bool },   // caption None = the main window
    SetFrameGeometry { pid: u32, caption: Arc<str>, geometry: FrameGeometry }, // detached graph windows (R-084, R-086)
    Pick,
    CancelPick,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum SetupStep { RaplEnable, RaplRevert, SensorsDetect, PolkitRule { on: bool } }
impl SetupStep {
    /// Arguments after `pkexec /usr/lib/tasklens/tasklens-setup`: ["rapl-enable"], ["rapl-revert"],
    /// ["sensors-detect"], ["polkit-rule", "on" | "off"] (table (c)).
    pub fn args(self) -> &'static [&'static str];
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct SetupStatus { pub journal_group: bool, pub lm_sensors_present: bool } // answer to Command::SetupStatus

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SetupEvent {
    Line { step: SetupStep, stderr: bool, text: Arc<str> },
    Finished { step: SetupStep, exit_code: i32 },  // 126 or 127 = pkexec prompt cancelled
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct HistoryRange { pub start_ns: TimeNs, pub end_ns: TimeNs }

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum HistoryWhat {
    Range { metric: HistoryMetric, keys: Arc<[ProcessKey]> }, // series for the range, system total plus these keys
    At { t_ns: TimeNs },                                      // process rows at the scrub time
    TopAt { t_ns: TimeNs, metric: HistoryMetric, n: u8 },     // hover card, n = 3
    Overview { metric: HistoryMetric },                       // whole retention for the minimap
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum Command {
    SetTableQuery(TableQuery),
    SetSysTableQuery(SysTableQuery),   // P2
    Action(ActionRequest),
    RefreshNow(SourceId),
    ResetBaselines,
    ReprobeSource(SourceId),           // P3
    KWin(KWinCommand),                 // P2
    DetailRefresh { target: DetailTarget, tab: DetailTab },     // P2
    ComputeHashes(ProcessKey),
    VerifyPackage(ProcessKey),
    StringScan { scan: ScanId, key: ProcessKey, opts: StringScanOpts },
    CancelStringScan(ScanId),
    HandleSearch { search: SearchId, pattern: Arc<str>, include_maps: bool, privileged: bool }, // P2
    CancelHandleSearch(SearchId),
    HistoryQuery { id: u64, range: HistoryRange, what: HistoryWhat },  // P3
    HistoryDelete { keys: Arc<[ProcessKey]> },
    SetupStatus,                       // P3
    RunSetup { step: SetupStep },
}
```

`SourceId` is from `health.rs` (E03-A1 half); `FrameGeometry` from `snapshot.rs` (E03-050); `TableQuery`, `SysTableQuery` from `table.rs`; `ActionRequest` from `actions.rs`; `DetailTarget`, `DetailTab`, `ScanId`, `SearchId`, `StringScanOpts` from `details.rs`; `HistoryMetric` from `history.rs` (E03-062).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** each `Tab` **When** `as_str` then `from_str` run **Then** the original tab comes back, and `Tab::ALL` lists the six tabs in R-023 order.
- **Given** `"Processes"` (capital P), `"last_used"` and `""` **When** `Tab::from_str` runs **Then** each returns `None`.
- **Given** each `SetupStep` **When** `args()` is called **Then** it returns `["rapl-enable"]`, `["rapl-revert"]`, `["sensors-detect"]`, `["polkit-rule", "on"]` and `["polkit-rule", "off"]`.
- **Given** a `Command` value of every variant **When** constructed in a test **Then** it compiles (a `match` with no wildcard arm in the test proves the variant list is complete; adding a variant breaks the test on purpose).

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/command.rs`: the types above.

## Tests
- `command.rs` unit tests: `tab_roundtrip_and_order`, `tab_from_str_rejects`, `setup_step_args_table_c`, `command_variants_exhaustive` (exhaustive match over all 18 `Command` variants).

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: `CommandError::Busy` when the 256-slot command queue is full; `EngineStopped` after shutdown.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: `Command` values are moved into a bounded queue; no clone on the hot path.
- Privacy: `HandleSearch.pattern` is user input; never log above debug level.
- Security: `SetupStep::args` is the only source of `tasklens-setup` arguments; no free-form argument exists.

## Notes
- `Command`, `CommandError` and `AppRequest` are copied from ADR-005 and R-136. The following are derived and listed as open items: `Tab` (no type in the docs; values from R-023 and table (a) `start_tab`, open item "Tab type"), `KWinCommand` variant fields (open item "KWinCommand fields"; the docs name activate, close, keep above with `{ pid, caption, on }`, pick, cancel pick and frame geometry), `SetupStep` (open item "SetupStep and setup events"; from table (c) subcommands; the Fan sensors "Revert" button has no subcommand), `SetupStatus` and `SetupEvent` fields and their delivery path (no channel is named for engine-to-UI setup answers or the KWin pick reply; open item "Engine answers outside ActionEvent"), `HistoryRange` and `HistoryWhat` (open item "History query and view types").
- Depends on E03-050, E03-051, E03-052, E03-053, E03-059, E03-062, E03-A1.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-model`.

title: E03-001 tl-model dependencies, full module list and placeholder files

## Context

Every module starts as an empty placeholder; later E03 beads fill one or two files each. title: E03-064 snapshot.rs: Snapshot struct, empty snapshot and change mask
description:
## Context
Adds the `Snapshot` struct to `tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`, now that every component type exists, plus an empty-snapshot constructor the engine publishes before its first data and the fake engine uses in UI tests. Also adds the mask computation the UI hub needs, so the rule "compare every component's `header.version` with the installed snapshot" lives in one tested place. Sources: ADR-003 "Snapshot", ADR-005 (hub `install`, mask, retention), ADR-004 (epochs), R-119.

## Deliverable
Append to `crates/tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`:

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Snapshot {
    pub sequence: u64,           // strictly increasing per engine process
    pub epoch: u32,              // engine session number (ADR-004)
    pub boot_id: BootId,
    pub published_ns: TimeNs,
    pub system: Arc<SystemSnapshot>,
    pub series: Arc<SeriesSet>,
    pub processes: Arc<ProcessSnapshot>,
    pub table: Arc<ProcessTableView>,
    pub connections: Arc<ConnectionsSnapshot>,
    pub services: Arc<ServicesSnapshot>,
    pub startup: Arc<StartupSnapshot>,
    pub inventory: Arc<InventorySnapshot>,
    pub devices: Arc<DeviceCatalog>,
    pub health: Arc<HealthSnapshot>,
    pub windows: Arc<WindowsSnapshot>, // P2
    pub details: Arc<DetailsSnapshot>, // P2
    pub history: Arc<HistoryView>,     // P3
}

impl Snapshot {
    /// sequence 0, the given epoch and boot id, published_ns 0, every component its Default
    /// (headers WarmingUp, empty lists). WindowsSnapshot header validity WarmingUp too; the KWin
    /// worker sets Unsupported when the bridge is unavailable.
    pub fn empty(boot_id: BootId, epoch: u32) -> Snapshot;

    /// Components whose header.version differs from `prev`, plus the SeriesIds whose
    /// SeriesView.version differs or which are new. SERIES is set when any series changed.
    /// DEVICES compares DeviceCatalog.version; HEALTH compares HealthSnapshot's version field
    /// (use whatever version field E03-A1 gives HealthSnapshot).
    pub fn changed_since(&self, prev: &Snapshot, changed_series: &mut SmallVec<[SeriesId; 64]>) -> ComponentMask;
}
```

`DeviceCatalog` and `HealthSnapshot` come from the E03-A1 half; if either has no `Default`, `empty` builds it with version 0 and empty entries. The other component types come from E03-050 to E03-062.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `Snapshot::empty(BootId(7), 3)` **When** read **Then** `sequence == 0`, `epoch == 3`, `boot_id == BootId(7)` and every component header has validity `WarmingUp`.
- **Given** two snapshots that share every `Arc` **When** `changed_since` runs **Then** the mask is `ComponentMask::NONE` and `changed_series` is empty.
- **Given** a next snapshot where only `table.header.version` increased **When** `changed_since` runs **Then** the mask is exactly `ComponentMask::TABLE`.
- **Given** a next snapshot where one of three series has a higher `SeriesView.version` **When** `changed_since` runs **Then** the mask is exactly `SERIES` and `changed_series` holds only that `SeriesId`.
- **Given** a next snapshot with one new series added **When** `changed_since` runs **Then** `SERIES` is set and the new id is in `changed_series`.
- **Given** a next snapshot where `devices.version` increased **When** `changed_since` runs **Then** `DEVICES` is set.

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/snapshot.rs`: append `Snapshot`, `empty`, `changed_since`.

## Tests
- `snapshot.rs` unit tests: `snapshot_empty_defaults`, `changed_since_none_when_shared`, `changed_since_table_only`, `changed_since_one_series`, `changed_since_new_series`, `changed_since_devices`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: N/A beyond headers.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: `changed_since` compares versions only (no deep compare), walks the two sorted series lists in one merge pass, and does not allocate when at most 64 series changed (`SmallVec` inline capacity).
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- ADR-005 puts the mask computation in the hub's `install`; this bead gives the hub a pure function to call, so the comparison rule has unit tests in `tl-model`. The hub (E16-A1) still owns sequence ordering and the `SnapshotChanged` emit.
- `Snapshot::empty` is derived (no doc names it); the engine needs a value for `latest()` before the first publish and the fake engine needs one for tests. Open item "Snapshot::empty and changed_since".
- Depends on E03-050, E03-051, E03-054, E03-055, E03-056, E03-059, E03-062, E03-A1.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-model`.

title: E03-065 settings.rs: Settings root and sections general to properties
description:
## Context
First of three beads that fill `tl-model/src/settings.rs`, the only settings schema (ADR-011, canonical table (a)). This bead writes the `Settings` root, `SCHEMA_VERSION`, and the sections `[general]` to `[properties]` of `settings.toml`. No file I/O here: `tl-app` (E33-A2) loads and saves. Sources: ADR-011 "Schema", canonical table (a) in `docs/RECONCILIATION.md`, R-018, R-019, R-020, R-021, R-024, R-069, R-071, R-075, APP-032, PROC-099.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-model/src/settings.rs` (placeholder from E03-001). Every struct derives `Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize` and has `#[serde(default)]`; every enum is `Copy` with the serde names shown.

```rust
pub const SCHEMA_VERSION: u32 = 1;

#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum StartTab { #[default] Processes, Performance, Services, Startup, Connections, Information, LastUsed } // "last_used"
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")] pub enum Decorations { #[default] Client, Server }
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")] pub enum NetworkUnit { #[default] Bits, Bytes }
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")] pub enum ColumnResize { #[default] Proportional, LastColumn }

pub const LANGUAGES: [&str; 12] = ["system", "en-US", "de-DE", "es-ES", "fr-FR", "ja-JP", "ko-KR", "pt-BR", "ru-RU", "uk-UA", "zh-CN", "nb-NO"];

pub struct GeneralSettings { pub start_tab: StartTab /* processes */, pub language: String /* "system" */ }
pub struct ThemeSettings { pub active: String /* "Default Dark" */, pub follow_system: bool /* false */,
                           pub light: String /* "Default Light" */, pub dark: String /* "Default Dark" */ }
pub struct AppearanceSettings {
    pub ui_scale_pct: u16 /* 100, 75..=200 step 5 */, pub row_height_pct: u16 /* 100, 80..=150 step 5 */,
    pub decorations: Decorations /* client; label "Use system title bar"; restart */,
    pub rounded_corners: bool /* true */, pub heat_coloring: bool /* true */,
    pub heat_intensity_pct: u8 /* 50, 0..=100 */, pub shadow_intensity_pct: u8 /* 100, 0..=100 */,
}
pub struct MotionSettings {
    pub animations: bool /* true; ANDed with system reduce-motion */, pub smooth_graphs: bool /* true */,
    pub smooth_scroll: bool /* true */, pub smooth_scroll_amount: u8 /* 15, 1..=50 */,
    pub tab_switch_ms: u16 /* 250, 0..=500 step 10 */,
}
pub struct UnitsSettings { pub network: NetworkUnit /* bits */, pub network_auto_scale: bool /* false */ }
pub struct ProcessesSettings {
    pub interval_ms: u32 /* 1000, 250..=10000; menu 250 500 1000 2000 5000 10000 */,
    pub mode: TableMode /* grouped */, pub tree_guide_lines: bool /* false */,
    pub highlight_new_exited: bool /* true */, pub filter_include_children: bool /* false */,
    pub hide_system: bool /* false */, pub subtree_totals: bool /* false */,
    pub dump_type: DumpMode /* mini */,
}
pub struct TablesSettings { pub column_resize: ColumnResize /* proportional */,
                            pub column_separators: bool /* false */, pub dim_zero_values: bool /* false */ }
pub struct PropertiesSettings { pub hide_unnamed_handles: bool /* true */,
                                pub shared_objects_only: bool /* true */, pub env_mask: bool /* true */ }
pub const PROCESS_INTERVAL_MENU_MS: [u32; 6] = [250, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000];

pub struct Settings {
    pub schema_version: u32,       // 1
    pub general: GeneralSettings, pub theme: ThemeSettings, pub appearance: AppearanceSettings,
    pub motion: MotionSettings, pub units: UnitsSettings, pub processes: ProcessesSettings,
    pub tables: TablesSettings, pub properties: PropertiesSettings,
    // sections [performance] .. [debug] are added by E03-066
}
```

The `/* ... */` comments give each default; implement `Default` by hand for every struct with exactly those values (not `derive(Default)` where a default is not the type's zero). TOML keys are the field names (snake_case) and section names are `general`, `theme`, `appearance`, `motion`, `units`, `processes`, `tables`, `properties`. `TableMode` comes from `table.rs` (E03-051), `DumpMode` from `actions.rs` (E03-053).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `Settings::default()` **When** each field of these eight sections is read **Then** it equals the table (a) default written in the comment above (for example `appearance.ui_scale_pct == 100`, `processes.interval_ms == 1000`, `theme.light == "Default Light"`).
- **Given** `StartTab::LastUsed` **When** serialized with serde to a string value **Then** it is `"last_used"`; `Decorations::Server` is `"server"`; `ColumnResize::LastColumn` is `"last_column"`.
- **Given** `SCHEMA_VERSION` **When** read **Then** it is 1, and `Settings::default().schema_version == 1`.
- **Given** `LANGUAGES` **When** read **Then** it has the twelve values of table (a) in that order.

## Files
- `crates/tl-model/src/settings.rs`: the items above.

## Tests
- `settings.rs` unit tests: `defaults_general_to_properties` (every field of the eight sections), `enum_serde_names` (each enum variant's string form, using serde's `IntoDeserializer` / a string serializer test helper; no `toml` dependency in tl-model), `schema_version_one`, `languages_table_a`.
- The full table (a) comparison against a TOML text lives in `tests/settings_defaults.rs` (E03-A2).

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A (no I/O).
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: `motion.animations` is ANDed with the system reduce-motion setting by the UI.
- Performance: N/A.
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- Canonical table (a) is the only schema: no key outside it may be added (ADR-011, R-071). Theme names and the language are `String` (serde has only the `derive` feature, so `Arc<str>` cannot be deserialized).
- Large-file rule: `settings.rs` grows over three beads; commit this part before building or testing.
- Depends on E03-051, E03-053.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-model`.

E03-067 settings.rs: UiState, EngineSettings and clamping
description:
## Context
Last of three beads that fill `tl-model/src/settings.rs`: `UiState` (everything in `state.toml`), `EngineSettings` (derived, never persisted, sent with `EngineClient::set_settings`), and the clamp step of loading (ADR-011 load step 4).
