title: E23-A1 Process Properties window and General tab (PropsWindow, props/mod.rs)
description:
## Context
Anchor E23-A1 "Properties window and General tab". Builds `PropsWindow`, the Process Properties window: open, activate-existing and cap rules, the tab strip with counts, the data path (demand registration and payload checks), keys, the exited state, and the access-block helper. With the frame (E23-002), actions (E23-001), filter (E23-009) and General layout (E23-010) done before it, closing this anchor gives a working Properties window with its General tab. E29 depends on it for the Grant access flows. Sources: UI-PWN-002, UI-PWN-003, UI-PWN-004, UI-PWN-018 (texts), PROC-077, PROC-071 (failure toast), PROC-056, R-050, R-073, R-119, D-008, ADR-003, ADR-008.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/mod.rs` (replaces the stub; keeps `pub mod filter; pub mod general;`):
- `pub struct PropsWindow` (Entity, window root view, key context `PropsWindow`): `key: ProcessKey`, `active: DetailTab`, `tabs: PropsTabs` (one lazily created entity per tab: `GeneralTab` here; `ThreadsTab`, `FdsTab`, `MapsTab`, `SecurityTab`, `EnvironTab`, `StringsTab` are added to `PropsTabs` by their beads; a tab without its entity yet renders an empty body), `filter: [Entity<PropsFilter>; 7]` (created in the constructor), `exited: bool`, `last_record: Option<ProcessRecord>`, `last_detail: Option<Arc<TargetDetail>>`, `labels: [(Option<u32>, SharedString); 7]`, `_subs: Vec<Subscription>`.
- `pub fn open_process_properties(key: ProcessKey, cx: &mut App)`:
  - `WindowRegistry` has `WindowKey::Properties(key)`: activate it (`window.activate_window()`), active tab unchanged.
  - Registry already holds 8 Properties windows: no window; the source window's `ToastQueue` shows "Too many process properties windows are already open" (Warning).
  - Key missing from `Snapshot.processes` at open, or the record is exited: no window; the main window shows "Could not open properties." (Error).
  - Else open through `open_pwn(cx, PwnWindow::ProcessProperties, props_title(name, pid, false), None, ..)`, centred on the main window's output, registered as `WindowKey::Properties(key)`; it closes with the main window (registry rule).
- Data path (UI-PWN-002): the constructor registers `DetailDemand { target: DetailTarget::Process(key), tab: active }` with the `DemandAggregator` (the General tab is always also loaded by the engine); a tab switch updates the entry; `on_release` removes it. The constructor also sends `Command::ComputeHashes(key)` once. On `SnapshotChanged`: re-render only when mask bit `PROCESSES` changed this key's record, `WINDOWS` changed, or `DETAILS` changed and the `Arc` pointer of this target's active-tab payload (or General payload) differs from the last rendered one. One record lookup by binary search on `records` (sorted by key).
- Window layout: title bar (frame), tab strip 32, filter bar 32 (E23-009 `filter_bar` with the active tab's tools), optional exited banner 24, tab body with padding `sp5` left/right and `sp4` top/bottom for key/value tabs (table tabs set their own padding 0). Tab bodies are embedded with `.cached(StyleRefinement::default().size_full())`, except table bodies (they own scrolling).
- Tab strip (UI-PWN-004): `TlTabs` id `("props-tabs", window_id)`, labels in order "General", "Threads", "File descriptors", "Memory maps", "Security", "Environment", "Strings". Count suffix one space then `[n]` with count formatting (thin-space grouping, table d), e.g. `File descriptors [1 204]`: Threads from `ProcessRecord.threads`; File descriptors, Memory maps, Environment from their last payload (the counts each tab bead reports through `PropsWindow::set_count(tab, n)`); General, Security, Strings never. No suffix until a value exists. A label is rebuilt only when its count changes. Cell tooltip `{label} (Alt+{n})`. No tab is ever disabled.
- Keys: `PropsSelectTab(n)` selects tab n; `PropsNextTab`/`PropsPrevTab` step (Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+PgDn / Ctrl+Shift+Tab, Ctrl+PgUp); `PropsFocusFilter` (Ctrl+F) focuses the active tab's filter; `PropsRefreshNow` (F5) sends `Command::DetailRefresh { target, tab: active }`; `PropsCloseWindow` (Ctrl+W) closes; `PropsEscape` follows `frame::esc_step` (popup, then running scan, then focused non-empty filter, then close).
- Initial focus: the active tab's first focusable element (the table for table tabs, the filter for General and Security).
- Toasts in this window: top centre, 8 px under the tab strip (the window's own `ToastQueue`).
- Exited state: when the key leaves `Snapshot.processes` after `ProcFlags::EXITED` was seen, or the payload validity is `Missing`: title becomes `... (not running)` via `window.set_window_title`; values keep the last rendered `ProcessRecord` and `TargetDetail`; a 24 px banner under the tab strip: background `status.warning` at 15% alpha, bottom border 1 px `status.warning` at 40% alpha, Lucide `circle-off` 14 px `status.warning`, text `t_sm` `text_primary` "This process has exited. Values are frozen at the last update."; every action control is disabled with tooltip "The process is not running." (tabs read `PropsWindow::exited`); the demand entry is removed; the window does not close by itself.
- Access block helper (UI-PWN-018, P2 texts, no button): `pub fn access_block(text: &'static str, button: Option<AccessButton>) -> impl IntoElement` (RenderOnce): centred, 64 px from the body top, Lucide `shield-alert` 24 px `text_secondary` (decorative), `sp4` gap, message `t_base` `text_primary` centred, max width 420, wrapping, `sp5` gap, then the optional button slot. Texts as constants: `ACCESS_FDS = "Handles unavailable (insufficient privileges)"`, `ACCESS_MAPS = "Needs administrator access."`, `ACCESS_SECURITY = "Security information unavailable (insufficient privileges)"`, `ACCESS_ENV = "Environment unavailable (insufficient privileges)"`, `ACCESS_STRINGS = "Strings unavailable: needs administrator rights"`. Shown when a tab payload has validity `Restricted`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/mod.rs`: nothing new (props already listed by E23-009). Strings `pwn-props-*` appended to `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a Properties window open for key K **When** `open_process_properties(K)` runs again **Then** one window exists, it became active, and its active tab did not change.
- **Given** 8 Properties windows **When** a ninth is requested **Then** no window opens and the toast "Too many process properties windows are already open" shows.
- **Given** key K missing at open **When** opening **Then** no window and the main window toast "Could not open properties.".
- **Given** a window for K **When** opened then closed **Then** `Demand.details` contains `DetailDemand { Process(K), General }` while open and lacks it after.
- **Given** the window on General **When** Alt+2 is pressed **Then** Threads is active and the demand entry's tab is `Threads`.
- **Given** another key's detail payload changes **When** the snapshot installs **Then** this window's render counter is unchanged.
- **Given** 1204 fds and 51 variables reported **Then** the labels read "File descriptors [1 204]" and "Environment [51]"; before any payload "Memory maps" has no suffix.
- **Given** K removed from the fake snapshot after EXITED **When** the snapshot installs **Then** the title ends " (not running)", the banner text shows, values are unchanged, and the demand entry is gone.
- **Given** F5 on the General tab **Then** `Command::DetailRefresh { Process(K), General }` is sent.
- **Given** a payload with validity `Restricted` on File descriptors **Then** `access_block` shows "Handles unavailable (insufficient privileges)" with no button (P2).

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/mod.rs`: fill.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_props.rs`: tests.
- `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: chain-edit keys.

## Tests
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_open_focuses_existing_window`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_ninth_window_shows_toast`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_open_failure_toast`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_exited_freezes_values` (title suffix, banner text, values unchanged)
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_demand_registered_and_removed`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_tab_switch_updates_demand`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_ignores_other_targets_detail_change`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_tab_counts_format`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_tab_no_count_before_load`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_alt_number_selects_tab`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::access_block_texts_per_tab`

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: "Could not open properties." (Error), "Too many process properties windows are already open" (Warning).
- Validity: tab payload `Restricted` shows the access block; `Missing` marks exited.
- Accessibility: the title names the process; every tab reachable by Alt+1..7 and Ctrl+Tab (kit tabs are not focusable); tooltips name the shortcut.
- Performance: one record lookup and one pointer compare per visible tab per snapshot; only the active tab renders; titles and counts are cached `SharedString`s.
- Privacy: titles hold the display name and PID only.

## Notes
- Ctrl-pause does not apply to secondary windows (UI-PWN-005).
- `set_window_title`: gpui-pre-0.3.7 `src/window.rs:2876`; `activate_window`: `src/window.rs:6413`; `on_release`: `src/app/context.rs:127`.
- The `OpenProperties` handler on process rows is E23-015.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-ui --test ui_props`.

title: Properties per-tab filter bar and debounce (windows/props/filter.rs)
description:
## Context
The per-tab filter bar of the Properties windows: the filter field, the debounce and generation logic, and the shared empty-state text. Every Properties tab uses one `PropsFilter`. Sources: UI-PWN-005, PROC-077 (filter per tab, empty state), PROC-084 (Strings filters Value), ADR-009 (100 ms debounce, generation rule).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/filter.rs`:
- `pub struct PropsFilter` (Entity): `input: Entity<InputState>`, `debounce: Option<Task<()>>`, `generation: u64`, `applied_generation: u64`, `needle_lower: SharedString`.
- `pub fn filter_bar(filter: &Entity<PropsFilter>, tools: Option<AnyElement>, cx) -> impl IntoElement`: bar height 32, background `window_bg`, bottom border 1 px `divider`, padding left and right `sp5` (12), top and bottom `sp2` (4). Left: `TlTextInput` sm (24 high), fixed width 280, prefix Lucide `search` `i_sm` with tooltip "Filter", placeholder "Filter", cleanable, `clean_on_escape`. Right-aligned tab tools slot (gap `sp4`), filled by the tabs.
- Accessible name of the input: "Filter {tab label}" (passed in).
- Matching: case-insensitive with Unicode simple lowercase, substring only, no globs. `pub fn matches(haystack_lower: &str, needle_lower: &str) -> bool`.
- Debounce: a Change event starts a 100 ms timer (`cx.spawn` + `Timer::after`); when it fires, `generation += 1` and the owner is called with `(generation, needle)`. `pub fn run_filter(&mut self, rows: Arc<[Box<str>]>, cx) -> Task<Option<(u64, Arc<[u32]>)>>` computes the matching row indexes: synchronously when `rows.len() <= 2000`, else on `cx.background_spawn` in chunks of 50,000 rows; the result is applied only when its generation equals the latest (`is_current(gen)`); the previous result stays visible meanwhile.
- Haystacks are precomputed by the owner once per payload version as `Arc<[Box<str>]>` (lowercase); a keystroke allocates only the result vector.
- Empty state: `pub fn no_match(text: &'static str, cx) -> impl IntoElement` rendering `TlEmptyState` with the given text and its "Clear filter" button, which clears the input. Default text "No properties match the current filter."; the Threads tab passes "No threads match the current filter.".
- Esc in a focused non-empty filter clears it (kit `clean_on_escape`); the window's Esc chain (E23-002) handles the next Esc.
- Filter text is per tab, kept for the window's life, never saved. Filtering sends no `Command`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/mod.rs` does not exist yet; this bead creates `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/` with `filter.rs` and adds `pub mod props;` to `windows/mod.rs` with a stub `props/mod.rs` containing only `pub mod filter;` (the anchor E23-A1 fills `props/mod.rs`).
- Strings `pwn-props-filter-*` appended to `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** rows ["pid", "ppid", "user"] **When** the filter text is "PID" and 100 ms pass **Then** the result is [0, 1].
- **Given** two keystrokes 50 ms apart **When** time advances 100 ms after the second **Then** the filter runs once.
- **Given** a background filter of generation 3 still running **When** generation 4 completes first **Then** the result of generation 3 is discarded.
- **Given** 3,000 rows **When** filtered **Then** the work runs on the background executor; with 2,000 rows it runs synchronously.
- **Given** no row matches **When** rendered **Then** the empty state shows "No properties match the current filter." and its "Clear filter" button empties the input.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/filter.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/mod.rs`: create stub with `pub mod filter;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/mod.rs`, `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: chain-edit lines.

## Tests
- `windows::props::filter::tests::matches_case_insensitive_unicode` (`"ÄBC"` matches `"äb"`)
- `windows::props::filter::tests::debounce_runs_once` (TestAppContext time advance)
- `windows::props::filter::tests::props_filter_stale_generation_ignored`
- `windows::props::filter::tests::background_above_2000_rows`

## Cross-cutting

- Validity: N/A

- Performance: no per-row allocation per keystroke; 1,000,000-row filtering is chunked off the UI thread.
- Privacy: masked environment values are not in the haystack while masked (the Environment bead passes name-only haystacks for masked rows).

title: Properties General tab layout, fields and formatters (props/general.rs)
description:
## Context
The General tab of Process Properties: three key/value column panels with every field in order, value formatters, the command line block, and the loading, restricted and exited looks. Copy, links, hashes and the window block are later beads on the same file. Sources: UI-PWN-006, PROC-078, R-050, R-096, R-008, D-004, canonical table (d), UI-FND-025, R-127.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/general.rs` (large file: commit it before building or testing):
- `pub struct GeneralTab` (Entity) built by `PropsWindow` with the `ProcessKey`.
- Field model: `pub struct KvField { pub id: FieldId, pub label: SharedString, pub value: SharedString, pub kind: KvKind, pub validity: Validity, pub full: Option<SharedString> }`, `pub enum KvKind { Text, Link(LinkTarget), Hash, Status }`, `pub enum FieldId` (one variant per field below). Fields are built into `Arc<[KvField]>` per column only when a source changes; value strings cached by `(FieldId, value bits, validity)`.
- Layout: body scrolls vertically as one region (`v_flex().overflow_y_scroll()`), padding `sp5` left and right, `sp4` top and bottom. Three equal column panels when the body is at least 840 px wide, else stacked in order 1, 2, 3. Panel: background `list_bg`, radius `r_sm`, padding `sp4` horizontal and `sp3` vertical, gap `sp4` between panels. Each panel is a `TlKeyValueGrid` inline layout with `.row_height(26 x ui_scale)` (not affected by `row_height_pct`) and `.label_width(w)` where `w` = widest shaped label of that column + `sp5` (12), clamped to 96..=150 px, computed once per UI scale and cached. Labels `t_base` regular `text_secondary` ending with ":"; values `t_base` `text_primary`, single line, end ellipsis, tabular figures for numbers.
- Command line block under the panels, `sp4` above: background `list_bg`, radius `r_sm`, padding `sp4`; header 26 high with "Command line" `t_base` medium `text_secondary` and `TlButton` Ghost sm "Copy" with Lucide `copy` 12 px at the right (its click handler is E23-011); body: the full command line (up to 32 KiB, R-008), arguments joined by single spaces, wrapped at any character, `t_sm` Noto Sans (not monospace), `text_primary`, line height 18. It is a cached child view `CmdLineBlock`, re-shaped only when the text changes.
- Column 1, in order (label: format): `Process:` display name (PROC-007); `PID:` integer without grouping; `Started:` `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` local; `PPID:` parent PID (link kind, wired in E23-011), `0 (none)` as plain text for PID 1 and kernel threads; `User:` `oystein (1000)`, with `, euid root (0), suid root (0)` appended when they differ; `Priority:` `Nice 0, SCHED_OTHER, kernel prio 120`, realtime `RT 50, SCHED_FIFO, kernel prio 49`; `Autogroup:` `autogroup-12 nice 0`, `Not supported` when `/proc/<pid>/autogroup` is absent; `Affinity:` `All (0-31)` or `0-7,16-23 (16 CPUs)`, plus ` (threads differ)` (link kind); `Hardening:` enabled items in this order, comma separated: `PIE, NX stack, Full RELRO, Shadow stack, NoNewPrivs, Seccomp`, `None` when none; `PIE:` `Yes`/`No`; `NX stack:` `Yes`/`No (executable stack)`; `RELRO:` `Full`/`Partial`/`None`; `Shadow stack:` `Enabled`/`Disabled`/`Not supported`; `ASLR:` `Full (2)`/`Partial (1)`/`Off (0)` plus `, disabled for this process` with `ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE`; `NoNewPrivs:` `Yes`/`No`; `Seccomp:` `Disabled`/`Strict`/`Filter (3 filters)`; `Architecture:` `x86-64`/`x86 (32-bit)`/`AArch64`/`Unknown`; `Executable:` absolute path (link kind), when it ends " (deleted)" plain text `{path} (deleted)` in `status.warning`; `Location:` one of `Temp directory`, `User Downloads`, `User data`, `User profile`, `System`, `Optional software`, `Flatpak`, `AppImage`, `Wine prefix`, `Deleted`, `Other`; `Package:` `firefox 131.0-1` or `Not packaged`; `Description:` package `%DESC%`, else desktop file `Comment`, else `Not reported`; `Working dir:` path; `Root:` only when not `/`; `Cgroup:` path from the cgroup root starting with `/`; `Unit:` unit name (link kind, wired in E23-014), hidden without a unit; `App ID:` hidden when none.
- Column 2: `SHA-256:`, `MD5:`, `Package status:` (placeholders `Computing…`/`Not verified` until E23-012), `Packager:` (hidden when not packaged), `Threads:` count, `Handles:` fd count, `Memory:` RssAnon size, `Working set total:` VmRSS, `Working set shared:` RssFile + RssShmem, `PSS:`, `USS:`, `Swap:`, `Commit:` VmData + VmStk, `Memory %:` RssAnon / MemTotal one decimal, `CPU %:` percent of the machine one decimal, `CPU time:` `h:mm:ss`, `I/O read bytes:` rchar, `I/O write bytes:` wchar, `I/O read ops:` syscr count, `I/O write ops:` syscw count.
- Column 3: `Disk read bytes:`, `Disk write bytes:`, `Cancelled write bytes:` sizes; `Disk read rate:`, `Disk write rate:`, `Disk total rate:` fixed `MiB/s` one decimal; `Net I/O:` `Receive 1.2 Mbps, send 0.3 Mbps` in the `units.network` unit; `GPU %:`; `VRAM:` size; `GPU memory shared:` size or `Not supported`; `GPU engine:` `3D`/`Compute`/`Video decode`/`Video encode`/`None`; then the window block slot (E23-013).
- Sizes, counts, percents and rates use the `tl_model::units` formatters (table d) writing into reused `String` buffers.
- Formatter functions (pure, tested): `fmt_priority`, `fmt_affinity`, `fmt_user`, `fmt_aslr`, `fmt_seccomp`, `fmt_hardening`, `fmt_net_io`.
- States: before the first General payload, payload-backed fields show `Collecting…`; record-backed fields (PID, Threads, Memory and other live numbers from `Snapshot.processes`) show values at once. Missing values show the R-050 words in `text_secondary` (`Collecting…`, `Restricted`, `Needs setup`, `Not supported`, `Not reported`, `Unavailable`, `Unknown`), never a zero. Restricted fields (exe, cwd, root, personality, io, smaps_rollup of other UIDs) show `Restricted` with tooltip "Needs administrator access." (P2 text; P3 switches to "Needs administrator access. Click the shield to grant it." through E23-025). Exited: values frozen, links drawn as plain text `text_secondary`. Filtered (UI-PWN-005): non-matching fields hidden with no gap; a panel with no visible field stays empty.
- Data binding: `TabPayload::General(Arc<GeneralDetail>)` for static fields; `ProcessRecord` (bit `PROCESSES`) for live numbers. Re-render when the payload `Arc` changes or this key's record value fields differ from the last rendered copy. A sweep that changes only live numbers re-formats at most 25 values.
- Truncated values show their full text in a tooltip after 500 ms (foundation).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** body width 876 px **When** rendered **Then** three panels show side by side.
- **Given** body width 800 px **When** rendered **Then** the panels stack in order 1, 2, 3.
- **Given** policy OTHER nice 0 prio 120 **Then** `Priority:` reads `Nice 0, SCHED_OTHER, kernel prio 120`; FIFO rt 50 reads `RT 50, SCHED_FIFO, kernel prio 49`.
- **Given** affinity 0-7,16-23 with threads differing **Then** `Affinity:` reads `0-7,16-23 (16 CPUs) (threads differ)`; all of 32 reads `All (0-31)`.
- **Given** uid 1000 and euid 0 **Then** `User:` reads `oystein (1000), euid root (0), suid root (0)` when suid is also 0.
- **Given** seccomp mode 2 with 3 filters **Then** `Seccomp:` reads `Filter (3 filters)`.
- **Given** exe of another UID **Then** `Executable:` shows `Restricted` in `text_secondary` with tooltip "Needs administrator access.".
- **Given** no payload yet **Then** `Package:` shows `Collecting…` and `PID:` shows the PID.
- **Given** 10 sweeps with an unchanged command line **Then** the command line is shaped once.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/general.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/mod.rs`: `pub mod general;` line.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_props.rs`: render tests.

## Tests

- `windows::props::general::tests::fmt_affinity_all_and_list_threads_differ`
- `windows::props::general::tests::fmt_user_with_euid`
- `windows::props::general::tests::fmt_aslr_personality`
- `windows::props::general::tests::fmt_seccomp_filters`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::general_three_columns_at_900`

- `tests/ui_props.rs::props_filter_hides_general_fields` (filter "pid" leaves PID and PPID)

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A (payload validity drives the words).
- Validity: Valid, WarmingUp (`Collecting…`), Restricted, Unsupported (`Not supported`/`Not reported`), Failed (`Unavailable`), Missing (field hidden where the list says hidden).
- Accessibility: values are selectable text (UI-FND-025); full text in tooltips.

title: Properties General tab copy, links, field menu and keyboard
description:
## Context
General tab interaction: copy on click, the PPID, Executable and Affinity links, the field menu with "Copy all fields", the grid keyboard model, and the command line Copy button. Sources: UI-PWN-007, PROC-078, PROC-071, PROC-073, APP-044, UI-FND-025, R-134.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/general.rs`:
- Each value is `div().id(("kv", field_id))` covering the value cell (label's right edge to the panel's right padding), 26 high, with `.on_click` and `.on_mouse_down(MouseButton::Right, ..)`; `.cursor(CursorStyle::PointingHand)` only on links.
- Looks: plain value hover `row_hover` background on the value cell, radius `r_sm`; link: the foundation link style (`status.info`, underline on hover); keyboard cursor: 1 px `accent` outline around the whole field row, radius `r_sm`, inset 1 px; pressed: value background `row_selected` for 120 ms (`m_fast`), none with reduced motion.
- Left click on a plain or hash value copies the full value (untruncated; hashes the full hex) with `cx.write_to_clipboard`, toast "Process property value copied." (Success, 5 s); clipboard failure toast "Failed to copy to clipboard" (Error, 8 s).
- Links: PPID dispatches the jump to the parent through E22's entry point `pages::processes::jump::select_by_key(parent_key, JumpSource::Properties)` and activates the main window (PROC-071 toasts as defined there); Executable sends `Command::Action(ActionRequest { kind: ActionKind::ShowInFileManager { path: exe, properties: false }, targets: [], privileged: false })` with the toast "Opening file location"; Affinity calls `windows::affinity::open([ActionTarget::Process(key)], subtitle, this window, cx)`. Link tooltips: PPID "Go to parent process", Executable "Open file location", Affinity "Set affinity…".
- Right click on any field opens a `TlMenu` with the foundation value-menu items "Copy value", "Copy row", "Copy section" (a section is one column panel) plus "Copy all fields" (`PropsCopyAllFields`): every visible field of the three columns as `Label: value` lines in column order, then `Command line: …`. Toasts: "Process property value copied." for Copy value, "Copied to clipboard" for the others.
- Keyboard (context `PropsWindow > KvGrid`; the grid region is one focus stop with `tab_stop(true)`): Up/Down move within a column; Left/Right move to the same row index in the neighbouring column, clamped to its last row; Home/End first and last field of the column; Enter activates a link or copies a plain value; Ctrl+C copies the value; Shift+F10 or Menu opens the field menu. Tab leaves the grid to the command line Copy button, then the Verify button.
- Command line "Copy" button copies the full command line, toast "Process property value copied.".
- Exited: links render as plain text `text_secondary`; copying still works.
- Strings appended under `pwn-general-*` in `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`.

- **Given** the SHA-256 field done **When** clicked **Then** the clipboard holds the 64 hex characters and the toast "Process property value copied." shows.
- **Given** a PPID link to key P **When** clicked **Then** the jump entry point is called with P and the main window is activated.
- **Given** the Executable link **When** clicked **Then** a `ShowInFileManager { path, properties: false }` action with empty targets is sent and the toast "Opening file location" shows.
- **Given** the cursor on column 1 row 3 **When** Right is pressed **Then** the cursor is on column 2 row 3; on a 2-row column it clamps to row 2.
- **Given** "Copy all fields" **When** run **Then** the clipboard text lists column 1, then 2, then 3 fields as `Label: value` lines, then `Command line: …`.
- **Given** the window exited **When** rendered **Then** links are plain `text_secondary` text and clicking copies.

title: Properties General tab hashes and Verify against package
description:
## Context
General tab hashes (SHA-256, MD5) and the "Verify against package" control with its status words and toasts. Sources: UI-PWN-008, PROC-078, PROC-074 (shared hash cache), R-096.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/general.rs`:
- Data: `GeneralDetail.hashes: HashState { Pending, Done { sha256: [u8; 32], md5: [u8; 16] }, Failed(HashError) }`, `GeneralDetail.package_check: PackageCheck`. Hex strings formatted once when `HashState` changes.
- Hash values: the first 16 lowercase hex digits plus "…", tabular figures; tooltip the full hash. Pending: `Computing…` in `text_secondary`. Failed: both values `Unavailable` with tooltip "Failed to compute one or more hashes" (read error, errno text on a second line) or "Executable path unavailable".
- `Package status:` values: `Not verified` (initial), `Verifying…`, `Matches package` (`status.success` text), `Does not match package` (`status.danger` text), `Not packaged` (button hidden), `No checksum in package database` (button disabled with that tooltip).
- Verify button row: its own 26 px row under `Package status:`, aligned with the value column: `TlButton` Secondary sm (24 high) "Verify against package". States: hover `menu_hover`; focused ring; loading while verifying (kit `.loading(true)`, label "Verifying…", inert); disabled when exited (tooltip "The process is not running.") or no checksum; hidden when not packaged.
- Click, Enter or Space on the button sends `Command::VerifyPackage(key)` (`PropsVerifyPackage`). When the payload's `package_check` moves to a final state: toast "Executable matches the package." (Success), "Executable does not match the package." (Warning), or on a database read failure "Could not verify against the package." (Error).
- Hashes are requested once per window open by `PropsWindow` (`Command::ComputeHashes`, E23-A1); this bead does not send it again.
- Status colours always come with words.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `HashState::Pending` **Then** SHA-256 and MD5 show `Computing…`.
- **Given** `Done` with sha256 starting `3f9a0c41e2b77d09` **Then** the value reads `3f9a0c41e2b77d09…` and its tooltip the full 64 digits.
- **Given** `Failed(ExePathUnavailable)` **Then** both values read `Unavailable` with tooltip "Executable path unavailable".
- **Given** `PackageCheck::NotPackaged` **Then** the Verify button is hidden and the status reads `Not packaged`.
- **Given** the button pressed **Then** `Command::VerifyPackage(K)` is sent and the button shows "Verifying…" loading.
- **Given** the payload moves to `Matches` **Then** the toast "Executable matches the package." shows and the status reads `Matches package`.

title: Properties General tab window block
description:
## Context
The window block at the end of General tab column 3: the process's top-level window from the KWin bridge. Sources: UI-PWN-009, PROC-078, PROC-052, PROC-053, ADR-004 (KWin worker, `WindowsSnapshot`).

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/general.rs`, after `GPU engine:` in column 3: an 8 px gap and a 1 px `divider` line inset `sp4` on both sides, then:
- Fields: `Window title:` caption; `Window ID:` KWin `internalId` as given (braced UUID); `Window state:` `Minimized`, `Maximized` or `Normal`; `Window class:` `resourceClass`; `Window rect:` `L:%d T:%d R:%d B:%d` (logical px of the frame geometry); `Window size:` `%d x %d`.
- Several windows: the first in KWin stacking order (topmost first), then a plain row with no label, `text_secondary`: "And N more" (N = count of the others), tooltip listing up to 10 more captions, one per line.
- No window: one field `Window:` `No top-level window`.
- Bridge missing (`Snapshot.windows` validity `Unsupported`): `Window:` `Not supported`, tooltip "Needs the KDE window bridge.".
- Bridge starting (`WarmingUp`): `Window:` `Collecting…`.
- Exited: frozen.
- Values copy on click (E23-011 behaviour). Window title is not a link.
- Data: entries of `Snapshot.windows` for this pid (bit `WINDOWS`), looked up by pid (sorted by pid); the record's pid is re-checked against the key. At most 7 strings re-formatted when this pid's entries change.

title: Properties and App Properties Unit link to Go to service
description:
## Context

title: Properties Threads tab table (props/threads.rs)
description:
## Context
The Threads tab of Process Properties: a flat, fixed-column table of the process's threads with sorting, selection by TID and copy. The row menu is E23-017. Sources: UI-PWN-010, PROC-079, R-097, UI-PRC-001 (TlTreeTable), UI-PWN conventions (tables).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/threads.rs`:
- `pub struct ThreadsTab` (Entity): `table: Entity<TlTreeTable<ThreadsDelegate>>`, `order: Arc<[u32]>` (sorted row indexes), `filtered: Arc<[u32]>`, `sort: (ColumnId, SortDir)`, a cell string cache keyed by `(tid, ColumnId)`, `last_payload: Option<Arc<TabPayload>>`.
- `ThreadsDelegate: TreeTableDelegate`: rows `RowKind::Plain`, `RowId` = TID, `header_lines()` -> `HeaderLines::One` (28 px), `columns_fixed()` -> true (no picker, no Hide or Reset; resize and sort work; widths kept in memory only), `row_index(id)` O(1) via a `FxHashMap<u32, u32>` rebuilt per payload.
- Columns (header, width (min), align, format): `tid` "Thread ID" 80 (60) right integer no grouping; `name` "Name" 160 (60) left thread `comm` (main thread TID = PID in weight 500); `state` "State" 96 (60) left `Running`/`Sleeping`/`Disk sleep`/`Stopped`/`Tracing stop`/`Zombie`/`Dead`/`Idle`/`Parked`; `cpu` "CPU %" 70 (60) right one decimal; `utime` "User time (ms)" 104 (80) right count; `stime` "Kernel time (ms)" 112 (80) right count; `prio` "Priority" 100 (70) left `Variable`/`Realtime 50`/`Deadline` with tooltip naming the policy (`SCHED_OTHER`, `SCHED_BATCH`, `SCHED_IDLE`, `SCHED_FIFO`, `SCHED_RR`, `SCHED_DEADLINE`); `base` "Base priority" 100 (70) right nice or rt_priority; `aff` "Affinity" 110 (60) left `All` or a CPU list; `lastcpu` "Last CPU" 72 (60) right; `ctx` "Ctx switches" 140 (100) right `1 204 / 33` (voluntary / involuntary, counts); `wchan` "Wait channel" 160 (60) left symbol, `0` shown as `-`.
- Header tooltips: "User time (ms)": "Time spent in user mode, in milliseconds"; "Kernel time (ms)": "Time spent in the kernel, in milliseconds"; "Ctx switches": "Voluntary / involuntary context switches"; "Wait channel": "Kernel function the thread is sleeping in".
- Body padding 0 (table edge to edge under the filter bar).
- Data: `TabPayload::Threads(Arc<[ThreadRow]>)` where `ThreadRow { tid, comm, state, cpu_pct, utime_ms, stime_ms, policy, rt_prio, nice, cpus: CpuListText, last_cpu, vol_ctx, invol_ctx, wchan, validity }` (bit `DETAILS`); refreshed each sweep (`processes.interval_ms`); re-sort only when the payload version or sort changes. Tab count from `ProcessRecord.threads` (set by `PropsWindow`).
- Sort: header click descending first, then ascending; default Thread ID ascending; kept by `ColumnId` for the window's life. Selection by TID survives refresh and re-sort.
- Filter (E23-009): matches TID, Name, State, Wait channel; no-match text "No threads match the current filter.".
- States: loading "Loading threads..." centred; empty "No threads found."; restricted `wchan` cells show the ADR-003 lock glyph with the R-050 tooltip "Needs administrator access."; exited: rows frozen (menu disabled in E23-017).
- Keys: Enter does nothing; Ctrl+C copies the focused row as `Label: value` lines for all columns; Ctrl+Shift+C copies the selected rows as TSV with a header line; toast "Copied to clipboard".
- Register the tab entity in `PropsTabs` in `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/mod.rs` (own epic's file) and add `pub mod threads;`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** threads with policies OTHER, FIFO 50 and DEADLINE **Then** the Priority cells read "Variable", "Realtime 50" and "Deadline".
- **Given** TID 4325 selected **When** the user sorts by CPU % and a new payload arrives **Then** TID 4325 is still selected.
- **Given** no payload **Then** "Loading threads..." shows; an empty payload shows "No threads found.".
- **Given** vol 1204, invol 33 **Then** the Ctx switches cell reads `1 204 / 33`.
- **Given** wchan `0` **Then** the cell reads `-`.
- **Given** filter "xyz" with no match **Then** "No threads match the current filter." shows with the header kept.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/threads.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/mod.rs`: register the tab (own file).
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_props.rs`: tests.

## Tests
- `tests/ui_props.rs::threads_priority_words`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::threads_selection_survives_resort`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::threads_loading_and_empty_texts`
- `windows::props::threads::tests::threads_ctx_format`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::threads_copy_row_and_tsv`

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A
- Validity: cells use ADR-003 glyphs (`…`, lock, `n/a`, `-`, `!`).
- Accessibility: header tooltips above; table keyboard model from TlTreeTable.
- Performance: sorting 2,000 threads under 0.2 ms, only on payload or sort change; cell strings re-formatted only when value bits change.
- Privacy: thread names are untrusted text: display through the E15 untrusted-text rules.

## Notes
- `TlTreeTable`, `TreeTableDelegate`, `CellOut`: E18-A1. Cells are written into the caller's `CellOut` buffer so the text cache skips unchanged cells.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-ui --test ui_props`.

title: E23-A2 Action dialogs: Send Signal submenu and Real-time signal dialog (windows/signal.rs)
description:
## Context
Anchor E23-A2 "Action dialogs". This bead finishes the process action dialogs: it builds the Send Signal submenu content, the Real-time signal dialog and the several-targets signal confirmation in `windows/signal.rs`. Set Affinity (E23-003, E23-005) and Custom priority (E23-006) are done before it, so when this anchor closes all three dialog files exist. Sources: UI-PWN-026, UI-PWN-027, UI-PWN-025 (several-targets signal row), UI-PRC-020 (Send Signal list), PROC-065, PROC-059, R-039, R-036, R-104.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/signal.rs`:
- `pub struct SignalInfo { pub name: &'static str, pub number: i32, pub label: &'static str, pub ends_process: bool, pub top_level: bool }` and `pub static SIGNALS: [SignalInfo; 31]`, numbers from `libc` constants at build time. Top-level, in order: "Terminate (TERM)", "Kill (KILL)", "Hangup (HUP)", "Interrupt (INT)", "Quit (QUIT)", "Stop (STOP)", "Continue (CONT)", "User 1 (USR1)", "User 2 (USR2)". "Other signals", in order, label `{NAME} ({number})`: ABRT (6), ALRM (14), BUS (7), CHLD (17), FPE (8), ILL (4), IO/POLL (29), PIPE (13), PROF (27), PWR (30), SEGV (11), STKFLT (16), SYS (31), TRAP (5), TSTP (20), TTIN (21), TTOU (22), URG (23), VTALRM (26), WINCH (28), XCPU (24), XFSZ (25) (x86-64 numbers; another architecture shows its own).
- `ends_process` true for TERM, KILL, HUP, INT, QUIT, USR1, USR2, ABRT, ALRM, BUS, FPE, ILL, IO/POLL, PIPE, PROF, PWR, SEGV, STKFLT, SYS, TRAP, VTALRM, XCPU, XFSZ; false for STOP, CONT, CHLD, TSTP, TTIN, TTOU, URG, WINCH.
- `pub fn signal_submenu(menu: PopupMenu, all_kernel_threads: bool, cx: &mut App) -> PopupMenu`: item height 26, min width 240, label `t_base` `text_primary` left, suffix "(ends process)" `t_sm` `text_secondary` right-aligned (part of the accessible text); the nine top-level items, a separator, "Other signals >" submenu, "Real-time signal…" (`SignalOpenRealtime`). Each item dispatches `SendSignal { signo }`. Signals map to `tl_model::actions::Signal` (`Term`, `Kill`, `Hup`, `Int`, `Quit`, `Stop`, `Cont`, `Usr1`, `Usr2`, others `Signal::Other(n)`).
- `pub fn signal_label(signo: i32) -> SharedString` used by toasts: `SIGHUP`, `SIGRTMIN+2` and so on.
- `pub fn send_signal(signo: i32, targets: SmallVec<[ActionTarget; 1]>, names: TargetNames, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut App)`: applies the PROC-059 rules, then sends `Command::Action(ActionRequest { kind: Signal(sig), targets, privileged: false })`:
  - Refusals before sending (toasts from PROC-059/R-036): tasklens itself "Refusing to end tasklens itself.", PID 1 "PID 1 (systemd) cannot be ended.", kernel threads "Kernel threads cannot be signalled.".
  - Protected target or another user's process: `pages::processes::confirm::confirm(..)` with the UI-PRC-014 rows "signal, freeze or kill on a PROTECTED target" and "any action on another user's process".
  - More than one target (and no protected or other-user row): this file's own confirmation with `TlDialog::confirm` (window title "tasklens"): heading "Send signal to N processes?", text "Send SIG{NAME} to N selected processes?", confirm button "Send signal" (`Danger` when `ends_process`, `Primary` otherwise), Cancel; focus starts on Cancel when Danger, on the action button otherwise; Enter activates the focused button; Esc cancels (R-104).
  - Toasts: one process "Sent SIGHUP to firefox (1234)"; several "Sent SIGHUP to 4 processes"; app row "Sent SIGHUP to Firefox (3 processes)"; failures in the PROC-058 forms.
- `pub struct RtSignalDialog` (Entity) and `pub fn open_rt_signal(targets, subtitle, parent, cx)`: `PwnWindow::RealtimeSignal`, modal, title "tasklens Send Signal", width 360, key context `SignalDialog`. Content: subtitle row 24 (`firefox (PID 4321)`); row 32 "Signal" + `TlStepper` width 72, range `libc::SIGRTMIN()..=libc::SIGRTMAX()` (34..=64 here), then the name `t_base` `text_primary`: `SIGRTMIN+{n - SIGRTMIN}`, and for SIGRTMAX `SIGRTMIN+30 (SIGRTMAX)`; note "Real-time signals end the process unless it handles them." `t_sm` `text_secondary`; footer "Cancel" and "Send signal" (Primary, default). Default value: the last value sent in this session (a process-global `AtomicI32`), else SIGRTMIN. Typed values outside the range clamp on blur. Enter sends (`SignalSendRealtime`) through `send_signal` with the same rules; toast "Sent SIGRTMIN+2 to firefox (1234)". Esc cancels.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/mod.rs`: `pub mod signal;`; strings `pwn-signal-*` appended to `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `signal_submenu` built **When** inspected **Then** "Terminate (TERM)" has the suffix "(ends process)" and "Stop (STOP)" and "CHLD (17)" do not.
- **Given** the SIGNALS table **When** compared with `libc::SIGHUP` .. `libc::SIGSYS` **Then** every number matches.
- **Given** one own process target **When** `SendSignal { signo: SIGHUP }` is sent **Then** no confirmation opens and the success toast is "Sent SIGHUP to firefox (1234)".
- **Given** 4 own targets **When** SIGHUP is sent **Then** the confirmation "Send signal to 4 processes?" opens with a Danger "Send signal" button and focus on Cancel; Confirm sends one request; toast "Sent SIGHUP to 4 processes".
- **Given** 4 own targets **When** SIGCONT is sent **Then** the button is Primary and focus starts on it.
- **Given** an app row with 3 processes **When** SIGHUP succeeds **Then** the toast is "Sent SIGHUP to Firefox (3 processes)".
- **Given** a PID 1 target **When** a signal is chosen **Then** nothing is sent and the toast "PID 1 (systemd) cannot be ended." shows.
- **Given** the Real-time dialog at 34 **Then** the name reads `SIGRTMIN+0`; at 64 `SIGRTMIN+30 (SIGRTMAX)`.
- **Given** 36 was sent earlier this session **When** the dialog opens again **Then** the stepper starts at 36.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/signal.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_dialogs_process.rs`: tests.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/mod.rs`, `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: chain-edit lines.

## Tests
- `tests/ui_dialogs_process.rs::signal_menu_labels_and_suffixes`
- `windows::signal::tests::signal_other_numbers_match_libc`
- `tests/ui_dialogs_process.rs::signal_toast_single_multi_app`
- `tests/ui_dialogs_process.rs::signal_multi_target_confirmation_text_and_focus`
- `tests/ui_dialogs_process.rs::signal_refusals_send_nothing` (security regression: tasklens itself, PID 1, kernel thread)
- `tests/ui_dialogs_process.rs::rt_signal_label_for_34_and_64`
- `tests/ui_dialogs_process.rs::rt_signal_remembers_last_value`

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: PROC-059 refusal toasts; PROC-058 failure forms.
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: nested kit menus (Right opens, Left closes); suffix is part of the item text; dialog fully keyboard driven.
- Performance: submenu built on open only.
- Privacy: N/A

## Notes
- Security: signals can end processes; the refusal and confirmation rules have regression tests above.
- The several-targets signal confirmation is not in E22's UI-PRC-014 table, so it lives here and uses `TlDialog::confirm` (E16-A2) directly.
- Kit `PopupMenu::submenu` at `gpui-component/crates/component/src/menu/popup_menu.rs:694`.
- The row-menu wiring is E23-008.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-ui --test ui_dialogs_process`.

title: Properties Threads row menu and thread actions
description:
## Context
The Threads tab row menu and its thread-level actions: copy, set thread priority, set thread affinity, send signal to thread. Sources: UI-PWN-011, PROC-079, PROC-066, PROC-067, PROC-059, PROC-058, R-097, ADR-006 (`ActionTarget::Thread`, `tgkill`).

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/threads.rs`:
- Row menu (`TlMenu`, item height 26, min width 220), built with `PopupMenu::build` on open:
  - "Copy" (`CopyCell`): copies the right-clicked cell text, toast "Copied to clipboard".
  - "Set thread priority >": Realtime / High / Above normal / Normal / Below normal / Low / Idle / Custom…; the right-clicked thread's current class is checked; with several selected threads a class is checked only when all share it.
  - "Set thread affinity…".
  - "Send signal to thread >": "Terminate (TERM)", "Kill (KILL)", "User 1 (USR1)", "User 2 (USR2)", each with the suffix "(ends process)" (`t_sm` `text_secondary`, right-aligned); submenu tooltip "A signal that ends a thread ends the whole process.".
- Right-click selects the row if not selected and captures `SmallVec<[ActionTarget; 1]>` of `ActionTarget::Thread { process: key, tid }` for every selected row (max 256).
- Priority classes map to nice values as the process Set Priority submenu does (PROC-066 classes; same mapping table E22 uses) and dispatch `SetThreadNice(n)` -> `ActionKind::SetNice(n)`; "Idle" dispatches `SetThreadSched { policy: idle, rt_prio: 0 }`; "Realtime" first opens E22's Realtime confirmation (UI-PRC-014 row "Set Priority > Realtime"), then sends `SetSched { policy: Rr, rt_prio: 1 }`; "Custom…" opens `windows::priority::open` with the thread targets and subtitle `Thread 4325 of firefox (PID 4321)` or `3 threads of firefox (PID 4321)`.
- "Set thread affinity…" opens `windows::affinity::open` with the thread targets and their current masks from the payload.
- Signals dispatch `SignalThread { signo }` -> `ActionKind::Signal(..)` on thread targets. Confirmation per PROC-059 (protected process, other user, or more than one target) through `windows::signal`'s rules.
- Toasts: "Thread priority updated", "Thread affinity updated", "Sent SIGUSR1 to thread 4325" (one) or "Sent SIGUSR1 to 3 threads"; failures in PROC-058 forms ("Permission denied", partial "Priority updated for 3 of 4 threads. 1 failed: permission denied").
- Exited: every item disabled with tooltip "The process is not running.". Realtime and Custom stay enabled otherwise (EPERM gives the failure toast).
- Keys: Shift+F10 and Menu open the menu on the focused row; Esc closes and returns focus to the table.
- Requests: `Command::Action(ActionRequest { kind, targets: thread targets, privileged: false })`; results through `ActionTracker`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** threads 4325 and 4326 selected **When** "Send signal to thread > User 1 (USR1)" is chosen and confirmed **Then** one request with two `Thread` targets and `Signal(Usr1)` is sent and the success toast reads "Sent SIGUSR1 to 2 threads".
- **Given** one thread **When** USR1 succeeds **Then** the toast reads "Sent SIGUSR1 to thread 4325".
- **Given** the window exited **When** the menu opens **Then** every item is disabled with "The process is not running.".
- **Given** a thread with nice 0 **When** the priority submenu opens **Then** "Normal" is checked.
- **Given** "Realtime" chosen **Then** the Realtime confirmation opens before anything is sent.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/threads.rs`: extend.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_props.rs`: tests.
- `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: chain-edit keys `pwn-threads-menu-*`.

## Tests
- `tests/ui_props.rs::thread_menu_captures_thread_targets`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::thread_signal_toast_text_single_and_multi`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::thread_menu_disabled_when_exited`
- `tests/ui_props.rs::thread_realtime_confirms_first` (security regression)

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: PROC-058 failure and partial forms.
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: Shift+F10, Menu, arrow keys, Esc.
- Performance: menu built on open only.
- Privacy: N/A

## Notes
- Security: thread actions change scheduling and can end the process; confirmation rules have regression tests.
- Thread targets are allowed for Signal, SetNice, SetSched, SetAffinity (ADR-006); the engine uses `tgkill` and re-checks `/proc/<pid>/task/<tid>`.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-ui --test ui_props`.

title: Properties File descriptors tab with details pane (props/fds.rs)
description:
## Context
The File descriptors tab: the fd table, the "Hide unnamed handles" switch, the details pane with decoded flags, copy and the Copy and Open file location menu items. "Go to connection" is E23-019. Sources: UI-PWN-012, UI-PWN-018 (texts), PROC-080, PROC-073, canonical table (a) `[properties] hide_unnamed_handles = true`.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/fds.rs`:
- `pub struct FdsTab` (Entity): a `TlTreeTable<FdsDelegate>` and a cached child view `FdDetailsPane`, inside kit `v_resizable("fds-split")`.
- Columns: FD 64 (60) right; Type 96 (60) left; Name flex (min 240) left, middle ellipsis for paths; Access 120 (80) left (e.g. `RW +A +NB CLOEXEC`); Position 110 (80) right, count or `-` for sockets and pipes. `RowId` = FD number. `HeaderLines::One`, `columns_fixed() = true`.
- Type words: `file`, `directory`, `TCP`, `UDP`, `unix`, `netlink`, `pipe`, `FIFO`, `eventfd`, `eventpoll`, `timerfd`, `signalfd`, `inotify`, `fanotify`, `memfd`, `dmabuf`, `DRM`, `pidfd`, `io_uring`, `anon_inode`, `device`.
- Filter bar tool: `TlCheckbox` "Hide unnamed handles" on the right, bound to `properties.hide_unnamed_handles` (default true) through the settings global (`SetSetting`); changing it writes the setting (500 ms debounced save, ADR-011) and applies to every open Properties window.
- Details pane under the table: 4 px horizontal splitter (drag handle `divider`, hover `accent`, tooltip "Drag to resize"); default height 132, minimum 80, maximum 50% of the body; kept for the window's life, not saved. A `TlKeyValueGrid` with two columns: left `Raw flags:`, `Access mode:`, `Status flags:`, `Descriptor flags:`; right `Mount ID:`, `Inode:`, plus for eventfd `Count:` (`eventfd-count`), for DRM `DRM client:` (`drm-client-id`) and `DRM driver:` (`drm-driver`).

Raw flags shown in octal `0o2104002`.

- States: loading "Loading handles..."; empty "No handles reported."; pane without selection "Select a descriptor to see its flags." centred `text_secondary`; fdinfo unreadable "Handle detail query unavailable."; no access: `access_block(ACCESS_FDS, None)` (button added in P3 by E23-025); exited: frozen, menu disabled.

title: Properties Memory maps tab (props/maps.rs)
description:
## Context
The Memory maps tab: a tree of mapped files ("(Primary)" first, "Outside loaded modules" last) with region children, the "Shared libraries only" switch, and copy items. Sources: UI-PWN-013, UI-PWN-018 (text), PROC-081, R-098, canonical table (a) `[properties] shared_objects_only = true`.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/maps.rs`:
- `pub struct MapsTab` (Entity) with a `TlTreeTable<MapsDelegate>` in tree mode (expand chevrons and indentation of the process table), `expanded: FxHashSet<Box<str>>` (node paths, kept for the window's life), and the flattened visible rows `Arc<[TreeRowRef]>` rebuilt only on payload, expansion, sort or filter change.
- Columns (header, width (min), align, node row, region row): `name` "Name" 260 (120) left tree, file name / `firefox (Primary)` / `Outside loaded modules`, region `7f3a2c000000-7f3a2c021000`; `base` "Base address" 140 (110) right, lowest start `0x7f3a2c000000`, region start; `size` "Size" 90 (70) right, sum / region size; `rss` "RSS" 90 (70) right, sum / region RSS; `perms` "Perms" 64 (60) left, empty / `r-xp`; `offset` "Offset" 100 (80) right, empty / `0x0001a000`; `path` "Path" 280 (60) left middle ellipsis, full path / empty; `desc` "Description" 200 (60) left, package `%DESC%` / empty; `pkg` "Package" 140 (60) left, `glibc 2.42-1` / empty.
- Order: "(Primary)" node first, "Outside loaded modules" last, others by the active sort (default Base address ascending); region children always in address order. Node addresses lowercase hex with `0x`, no padding. Sizes in table (d) memory format.
- "Outside loaded modules" children: `[heap]`, `[stack]`, `[vdso]`, `[vvar]`, `anonymous`, `memfd:<name>` rows drawn with the region format plus the name in the Name cell (`[heap] 55d3f1a00000-55d3f1c21000`).
- All nodes start collapsed. Right/Left expand and collapse; Space toggles.
- Filter bar tool: `TlCheckbox` "Shared libraries only" (setting `properties.shared_objects_only`, default true, applies to all windows, written through `SetSetting`). Filter (E23-009) matches node Name and Path; a matching child keeps its parent; a matching parent shows all its children.
- Tooltips: "(Primary)" -> "Main executable"; "Outside loaded modules" -> "Anonymous, heap, stack and other mappings without a file".
- States: loading "Loading memory maps..."; empty (kernel thread) "No memory maps."; no access: `access_block(ACCESS_MAPS, None)` ("Needs administrator access."); RSS before the first `smaps` read: the `…` glyph (WarmingUp).
- Row menu: "Copy" (cell), "Copy path" (node rows), "Open file location" (node rows with a path; `ShowInFileManager { path, properties: false }`, toast "Opening file location"). Copy toasts "Copied to clipboard".

- **Given** groups wheel and docker **Then** `Admin groups:` reads `wheel, docker (root-equivalent)`.
- **Given** PID 1's ns not readable and the user ns equal to tasklens's **Then** `User namespace:` reads `Same as tasklens` with tooltip "Compared with tasklens (PID 1 not readable)".

title: Properties Environment tab with secret masking (props/environ.rs)
description:
## Context
The Environment tab with secret masking, reveal, copy and refresh. Secrets must not leave by accident (ADR-015). Sources: UI-PWN-016, UI-PWN-018 (text), PROC-083, R-099, ADR-015, canonical table (a) `[properties] env_mask = true`.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/environ.rs`:
- `pub struct EnvironTab` (Entity): `TlTreeTable<EnvDelegate>` flat (`RowId` = payload row index), `masked: Arc<[bool]>` computed once per payload, `revealed: FxHashSet<u32>`, lowercase haystacks per payload (masked rows contribute only their name).
- Mask rule (R-099): a name is masked when it contains, case-insensitive, any of `TOKEN`, `SECRET`, `PASSWORD`, `PASSWD`, `KEY`, `COOKIE`, `CREDENTIAL`. `pub fn is_secret_name(name: &str) -> bool`. Masking is off when `properties.env_mask = false` (no masks, no eye buttons).
- Columns: Name 240 (80) left; Value flex (min 160) left, single line, end ellipsis. Default sort Name ascending.
- Masked value shows "••••••" (six U+2022) in `text_secondary`, tooltip "Hidden because the name looks like a secret". On hover or keyboard focus of a masked row an eye button (`TlButton` Icon sm 24 x 24, Lucide `eye` 14 px, accessible name "Reveal value") appears at the right end of the Value cell; a revealed row shows Lucide `eye-off` ("Hide value") and keeps it visible. Revealed values show in `text_primary`.
- Reveal toggles: eye click, Space on the focused masked row (`PropsToggleRevealEnv`), or the row menu "Reveal value" / "Hide value". Reveal lasts until the row is hidden again, Refresh is pressed, or the window closes; never saved.
- Filter bar tools (right): Lucide `info` 14 px `text_secondary` plus "Environment at process start" `t_sm` `text_secondary`; `TlButton` Ghost sm "Refresh" with Lucide `refresh-cw` 12 px.
- Refresh (button or F5): sends `Command::DetailRefresh { target, tab: Environment }`, clears `revealed` (re-masks all rows), and the button shows loading until the next Environment payload arrives (at most one sweep).
- Truncation: when the payload's `truncated` is true, a 24 px footer under the table reads "Showing the first 1 MiB of the environment." in `text_secondary`.
- States: loading "Loading environment..."; no access `access_block(ACCESS_ENV, None)`; zombie or kernel thread "Environment block unavailable" centred; read error: one row with Name "(read failed)" in `text_secondary`, empty Value, tooltip the errno text; exited: frozen, Refresh disabled.
- Row menu: "Copy name", "Copy value", "Copy all as NAME=value", separator, "Reveal value" or "Hide value" (masked rows only). "Copy all" copies every row passing the filter, in table order. A masked value is copied as "••••••" unless its row is revealed. Ctrl+C copies the selected rows as `NAME=value` lines with the same rule. Toast "Copied to clipboard".
- Filter (E23-009) matches Name and Value; masked values match by name only while masked.
- Values are never logged and never placed in tooltips while masked.
- Data: `TabPayload::Environ(Arc<EnvDetail>)` with `vars: Arc<[(Box<str>, Box<str>)]>`, `truncated: bool`; read when the tab first opens and on Refresh only. Tab count = variable count.
- Register the tab in `props/mod.rs` and add `pub mod environ;`.

- **Given** names `api_key`, `GH_TOKEN`, `MyPassword`, `SESSION_COOKIE`, `PATH` **Then** the first four are masked and `PATH` is not.
- **Given** `GH_TOKEN` masked **When** "Copy value" **Then** the clipboard holds "••••••"; after reveal it holds the real value.
- **Given** a revealed row **When** Refresh **Then** a `DetailRefresh` for Environment is sent and the row is masked again.
- **Given** `env_mask = false` **Then** no value is masked and no eye button shows.
- **Given** a read error **Then** one row "(read failed)" with the errno tooltip shows.
- **Given** a filter equal to part of a masked value **Then** no row matches.
- **Given** `truncated = true` **Then** the footer "Showing the first 1 MiB of the environment." shows.

- `pub struct StringsTab` (Entity): options state, current `ScanId` (new id per scan from a process-global `AtomicU64`), `TlTreeTable<StringsDelegate>` (`RowId` = row index), chunk index `row -> (chunk, offset)` so rows are never copied, sort permutation `Arc<[u32]>` computed on the background executor after the scan.
- Options bar (height 32, padding `sp5` horizontal, gap `sp4`): "Minimum length" `t_sm` `text_secondary` + `TlStepper` width 72, range 4..=64, step 1, default 4; `TlCheckbox` "ASCII", "UTF-8", "UTF-16LE" (all on); `TlCheckbox` "Include file-backed mappings" (off); right-aligned `TlButton` Primary sm "Scan" (Lucide `scan-search` 14 px), replaced while scanning by `TlButton` Secondary sm "Cancel" (Lucide `square` 12 px, tooltip "Stop the scan (Esc)").
- Progress row 24 (only while scanning): `TlProgress` md (6 high), width 200, determinate, 1% buckets without transition; status text `t_sm` `text_secondary` tabular: "Scanning process memory... 42%  18 234 strings found" (counts with thin-space grouping). After the scan the bar is removed and only the status text stays.
- Table columns: Address 140 (110) right, `0x` + lowercase hex; Encoding 90 (70) left; Length 70 (60) right, count; Value flex (min 200) left, single line, first 512 characters then an ellipsis, tabs and newlines shown as `\t` and `\n`.
- States and texts: before the first scan "Press Scan to search this process's memory for text." centred `text_secondary` (the scan never starts by itself); scanning: options disabled, sorting off (header click tooltip "Sorting is available after the scan"), rows appear in batches in address order; finished "Scan finished. 18 234 strings found.", sorting on; cancelled "Scan cancelled. 18 234 strings found." (results kept); limit (1,000,000 strings or 256 MiB of text): scan stops, 24 px banner above the table, `status.warning` at 15% alpha, "String scan stopped: not enough memory." (results kept); errors "Failed to read process memory." as body text when nothing was read, or a Warning toast with a partial result; kernel threads "Strings unavailable for this process." body text with options and Scan disabled; no access `access_block(ACCESS_STRINGS, None)` (the "Enable" button is E23-025); no encoding checked: Scan disabled, tooltip "Choose at least one encoding"; exited: Scan disabled, a running scan ends with "Scan stopped: the process exited. 18 234 strings found.".
- Scan (`PropsStartStringScan`, click or Enter in the options bar): sends `Command::StringScan { scan, key, opts: StringScanOpts { min_len, ascii, utf8, utf16le, include_file_backed } }`; clears previous results; payloads with an older `ScanId` are dropped.
- Cancel (`PropsCancelStringScan`, click, or Esc while a scan runs and focus is in the tab, before Esc closes the window): sends `Command::CancelStringScan(scan)`. Switching tabs keeps the scan running; closing the window sends `CancelStringScan`.
- Row menu: "Copy value" (full value, not the 512-character cut), "Copy address", "Copy row" (TSV). Ctrl+C copies the selected values, one per line. Toast "Copied to clipboard".
- Filter (E23-009) matches Value only, off the UI thread, chunked.
- Data: `TabPayload::Strings(Arc<StringScanState>)` with `scan: ScanId`, `progress_pct: u8`, `found: u32`, `chunks: Arc<[Arc<[StringHit]>]>` (append-only; new payloads reuse old chunk `Arc`s), `state: Scanning | Finished | Cancelled | Stopped(Limit) | Failed(Error)`; at most 4 payloads per second while scanning.
- Register the tab in `props/mod.rs`, `pub mod strings;`, and report `scan_running` to `PropsWindow` for the Esc chain.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** the tab opened **When** no button is pressed for 10 s **Then** no `StringScan` command was sent.
- **Given** progress 42% and 18234 found **Then** the status reads "Scanning process memory... 42%  18 234 strings found".
- **Given** scan 2 running **When** a payload for scan 1 arrives **Then** it is ignored.
- **Given** state `Stopped(Limit)` **Then** the banner "String scan stopped: not enough memory." shows and results stay.
- **Given** a kernel thread **Then** "Strings unavailable for this process." shows and Scan is disabled.
- **Given** two payloads during a scan **Then** the first payload's chunk `Arc`s are pointer-equal in the second.
- **Given** a scan running and the filter non-empty **When** Esc is pressed three times **Then** the scan is cancelled, the filter cleared, the window closed, in that order.
- **Given** all encodings unchecked **Then** Scan is disabled with tooltip "Choose at least one encoding".

title: Properties Grant access and Enable buttons for restricted tabs
description:
## Context
P3 privilege buttons in the Properties tab access states: "Grant access" (File descriptors, Memory maps, Environment) and "Enable" (Strings), which start the helper session, plus the P3 Restricted tooltip text. Sources: UI-PWN-018, UI-PWN-006 (Restricted tooltip), APP-003, PROC-076, R-050, UI-FND-028 (`StartHelperSession`).

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/props/mod.rs` (and the call sites in `fds.rs`, `maps.rs`, `environ.rs`, `strings.rs`, which pass the button):
- `pub enum AccessButton { GrantAccess, Enable }` rendered by `access_block` as `TlButton` Secondary sm with label "Grant access" or "Enable". Security never gets a button.
- The button dispatches `StartHelperSession` (the title-bar shield's Action, E16-A3). Enter or Space activates it; it is the body's first focus stop.
- Button states from `Snapshot.health` helper session state (bit `HEALTH`): helper not installed -> disabled, tooltip "Needs administrator helper (not installed)"; waiting for authentication -> loading with label "Waiting for authentication…"; authentication cancelled -> back to default and toast "Authentication cancelled"; session active -> the window sends `Command::DetailRefresh { target, tab: active }` once, the block is replaced by the tab's normal loading state, and the engine reads the tab through the helper.
- The Restricted tooltip on General and Security values changes from "Needs administrator access." to "Needs administrator access. Click the shield to grant it.".

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a Restricted fds payload and the helper installed **Then** the block shows the "Grant access" button; Strings shows "Enable"; Security shows no button.
- **Given** the button clicked **Then** `StartHelperSession` is dispatched and the button shows "Waiting for authentication…" while health reports the prompt pending.
- **Given** health reports the prompt cancelled **Then** the button returns to default and the toast "Authentication cancelled" shows.
- **Given** health reports the session active **Then** one `DetailRefresh` for the active tab is sent.
- **Given** the helper not installed **Then** the button is disabled with tooltip "Needs administrator helper (not installed)".
- **Given** a Restricted General field **Then** its tooltip reads "Needs administrator access. Click the shield to grant it.".

title: E23-A3 Notices: VirusTotal notice and hashing toast (windows/notices.rs)
description:
## Context
Anchor E23-A3 "Notices". Creates `windows/notices.rs` with the VirusTotal flow: the one-time notice, the delayed hashing toast, the browser open and its error toasts. The dump toasts are added to this file in P3 (E23-033). Sources: UI-PWN-036, UI-PWN-025, PROC-074, R-095, R-134 (`ActionKind::OpenUri`), UI-PRC-014 row "Open in VirusTotal, first use", canonical table (a) `state.toml [processes] virustotal_notice_accepted = false`.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/notices.rs`:
- `pub fn open_virustotal(key: ProcessKey, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut App)`:
  1. If `UiState.processes.virustotal_notice_accepted` is false: open E22's confirmation (UI-PRC-014 row: title "Open VirusTotal?", text "This opens virustotal.com with the file's hash. The file is not uploaded.", buttons "Open" (Primary) and "Cancel"; focus on "Open"). "Open" sets the flag true through the state store's debounced save and continues; Cancel does nothing and leaves the flag false. Later uses skip the notice.
  2. Send `Command::ComputeHashes(key)` and add `DetailDemand { target: Process(key), tab: General }` while the request is pending (removed when it ends).
  3. Start one `Timer::after(500 ms)` task: if the hash has not arrived, push the Info toast "Computing SHA-256…" with key `VtToast(action_id)`. The timer is dropped when the hash arrives first.
  4. When the General payload's `HashState` is `Done`: remove the toast if shown, then send `Command::Action(ActionRequest { kind: ActionKind::OpenUri("https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/{sha256 lowercase hex}"), targets: [], privileged: false })`.
  5. Errors replace the hashing toast (Error): hash failed with a read error -> "SHA-256 unavailable"; no readable exe and no readable argv path -> "Process image unavailable"; the OpenUri action fails -> "Could not open the browser.".
- `pub struct VtToast(pub u64)` toast key type.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/mod.rs`: `pub mod notices;`; strings `pwn-notices-vt-*` in `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** the flag false **When** `open_virustotal` runs **Then** the notice opens before any `ComputeHashes` is sent; "Open" sets the flag true and then `ComputeHashes(key)` is sent.
- **Given** the flag false **When** Cancel **Then** nothing is sent and the flag stays false.
- **Given** the flag true **Then** no notice opens.
- **Given** the hash arrives after 200 ms **Then** no "Computing SHA-256…" toast was shown; after 800 ms the toast shows at 500 ms and is removed when the hash arrives.
- **Given** the hash `Done` **Then** an `OpenUri` action with `https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/<64 hex>` is sent.
- **Given** `HashState::Failed(ExePathUnavailable)` **Then** the Error toast "Process image unavailable" shows.
- **Given** the OpenUri action fails **Then** the toast "Could not open the browser." shows.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/notices.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_dialogs_process.rs`: tests.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/mod.rs`, `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: chain-edit lines.

## Tests

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: "SHA-256 unavailable", "Process image unavailable", "Could not open the browser.".
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: the notice states what is sent (the hash) and what is not (the file).
- Performance: hashing off the UI thread; one timer task.

title: Run dialog command history store and matcher (windows/run_history.rs)
description:
## Context
The Run dialog's command history store and matcher: load and save `run-history.json`, the 50-entry cap, and the prefix-then-contains ordering. Sources: PROC-095 (history format, 50 entries, prefix matches first), UI-PWN-029 (tie rule), R-061, ADR-011 (path), canonical table (c).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/windows/run_history.rs`:
- `#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)] pub struct RunEntry { pub command: String, #[serde(rename = "executedAt")] pub executed_at: String, pub elevated: bool }` and `#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Default)] pub struct RunHistoryFile { pub entries: Vec<RunEntry> }` (JSON form `{"entries":[{"command","executedAt","elevated"}]}`), newest first.
- `pub const RUN_HISTORY_MAX: usize = 50;`
- `pub fn load(path: &Path) -> Arc<[RunEntry]>`: missing or unparsable file gives an empty history (no error toast).
- `pub fn record(history: &[RunEntry], command: &str, elevated: bool, now: &str) -> Vec<RunEntry>`: removes an existing entry with the same command text, inserts the new one at the front, truncates to 50.
- `pub fn save(path: &Path, history: &[RunEntry]) -> io::Result<()>` run on the background executor (write route: see Notes); `pub fn clear(path: &Path) -> io::Result<()>` writes `{"entries":[]}`.
- Path: `$XDG_STATE_HOME/tasklens/run-history.json` from the app paths (the `Paths` global set by `tl-app`).
- `pub fn matches(history: &[RunEntry], text: &str) -> SmallVec<[u32; 16]>`: empty text returns all indexes newest first; else entries starting with the text (case-insensitive) newest first, then entries containing it, newest first; no duplicates.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/mod.rs`: `pub mod run_history;`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a file with 2 entries **When** loaded **Then** both are returned in file order.
- **Given** a corrupt file **When** loaded **Then** history is empty.
- **Given** 50 entries **When** a new command is recorded **Then** the list has 50 entries with the new one first.
- **Given** an existing "firefox" entry **When** "firefox" is recorded again **Then** only one "firefox" entry exists, at the front.
- **Given** entries ["xfirefox" (newest), "firefox --new", "fire"] **When** matching "fire" **Then** the order is "firefox --new", "fire", then "xfirefox".
- **Given** a saved history **When** reloaded **Then** `executedAt` and `elevated` round-trip.

- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_run.rs`: create.

## Cross-cutting

- Privacy: command texts are stored only in this file; never logged.

## Notes
- Open item (leader): ADR-001 forbids `tl-ui -> tl-ops`, so `write_atomic` (R-130) is not reachable from `tl-ui`, and no doc says how `tl-ui` writes `run-history.json` or how `executedAt` is formatted (`tl-ui` has no date crate). Recommendation: `tl-app` passes a `RunHistoryStore` callback (load, save) into `TasklensUi::init` that uses `write_atomic`, and `executedAt` uses RFC 3339 local time `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM` produced by a `tl_model::units` helper. Do not start `save` and the timestamp until the leader answers; `load`, `record` and `matches` can be built now.
- Build rule: run cargo through `flock -w 7200 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/heavy-build.lock" systemd-run --user --scope --quiet --collect --slice=builds.slice -p MemoryHigh=16G -p MemoryMax=18G -p MemorySwapMax=2G -p OOMPolicy=kill env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 cargo test -p tl-ui --test ui_run`.

description:
## Context

Sources: UI-PWN-028, UI-PWN-029, UI-SHL-097, PROC-095, APP-014, R-061, R-134 (`ActionKind::Launch(LaunchSpec)`), table (b) RunDialog keys, U-15.

- Combo: `TlTextInput` md (28 high) with suffix `TlButton` Icon sm 24 x 24, Lucide `chevron-down` 14 px, accessible name "Show command history"; accessible name of the input "Open". Popup: kit `Popover` anchored to the input, same width, a plain `v_flex` of up to 50 rows of 26 inside a 130 px scroll area (5 visible rows), background `menu_bg`, 1 px border `divider`, radius `r_sm`, foundation popup shadow. Row: command `t_base` single line ellipsis; elevated entries show Lucide `shield-check` 12 px `text_secondary` at the right with tooltip "Ran as administrator". Highlighted row `menu_hover`.
- Combo behaviour: typing filters with `run_history::matches`; the popup opens when at least one entry matches and the text is not empty, closes when none match. Down opens the popup (all history when empty) and highlights the next row; Up the previous; the highlighted command is copied into the input as it moves. Click on a row puts it in the input and closes the popup; double-click runs it. The chevron toggles the popup. Esc closes the popup first, then the window.

- Run: Enter (`RunCommand`) and OK run with the checkbox state (administrator only when it is checked); Shift+Enter (`RunCommandElevated`) always runs as administrator.

(Error, stays); else send `Command::Action(ActionRequest { kind: ActionKind::Launch(LaunchSpec { what: LaunchWhat::Command(text), as_admin, cwd: None }), targets: [], privileged: false })`; while pending OK shows loading and other controls are disabled. Final event `Succeeded`: record the command in history (`run_history::record` then save), close the Run window, and the main window shows "Command launched" (Success). `Failed`: "Failed to run command" (Error, stays). A cancelled polkit prompt (the engine's dismissed-prompt error, U-39): "Authentication cancelled" (Info, stays).

[ ] { } ``).

Found 12 matches"; error: toast "Handle search failed" (Error) and status "Handle search failed"; "Search all" pending: loading; prompt cancelled: toast "Authentication cancelled".

title: Search File Handles results table and row menu
description:
## Context
The Handle Search results table and its row menu: End Task, End Process, Go to process, Copy path, Open file location, with the keys of the `HandleSearch > Table` context. Sources: UI-PWN-031, PROC-096, R-102, R-036, PROC-060, PROC-061, PROC-071, PROC-073, D-009.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/windows/handle_search.rs`:
- `TlTreeTable<HandleHitsDelegate>` flat (`RowId` = hit index, which is also the row index), `HeaderLines::One`, `columns_fixed() = true`, rows read through the chunk index without copying.
- Columns: `proc` "Process" 200 (100) left, 16 px process icon, gap `sp3`, display name; `pid` "PID" 80 (60) right; `user` "User" 110 (60) left; `type` "Type" 70 (60) left `fd`/`mmap`/`cwd`/`exe`/`root`; `fd` "FD" 60 (60) right, empty for other types; `path` "Path" flex (200) left, middle ellipsis. Default sort Process ascending, then PID, then FD.
- Cap: at 100,000 hits the engine stops and the status reads "Showing the first 100 000 matches.".
- Row menu (`TlMenu`): "End Task" (SIGTERM), "End Process" (SIGKILL), separator, "Go to process", separator, "Copy path", "Open file location". Targets are the distinct `ProcessKey`s of the selected rows (captured at search time).
- End rules (PROC-059 to PROC-061, R-036, D-009): one own unprotected process: End Task and End Process send at once (no confirmation); End Process toast "End process requested."; two or more targets: E22's confirmation rows "End N processes?" with "End N selected processes?" (SIGTERM) / "End N selected processes immediately?" (SIGKILL) and buttons "End tasks" / "End processes"; protected or another user's process: their UI-PRC-014 rows; refusals (tasklens itself, PID 1, kernel threads) use their toasts. Call `pages::processes::confirm::confirm(kind, targets, window, cx)` with this window as parent. Requests: `Command::Action(ActionRequest { kind: Signal(Term) or Signal(Kill), targets, privileged: false })`; toasts and failures in PROC-058 forms in this window. Rows of processes that exited after the search stay listed; actions on them get the identity toast "The selected process changed; wait for the list to update and try again.".
- "Go to process": E22's `select_by_key(key, source)`; activates the main window.
- "Copy path": toast "Copied to clipboard". "Open file location": `ActionKind::ShowInFileManager { path, properties: false }`, empty targets, toast "Opening file location".
- Keys (`HandleSearch > Table`): Delete and Ctrl+E End Task; Shift+Delete and Ctrl+X End Process; Enter Go to process; Ctrl+C copies the selected paths one per line; Ctrl+Shift+C copies rows as TSV with header. Menu items show their key hints.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a hit row **When** the menu opens **Then** the labels are exactly "End Task", "End Process", "Go to process", "Copy path", "Open file location".
- **Given** two rows of different own processes selected **When** Delete **Then** the confirmation "End 2 processes?" opens before anything is sent.
- **Given** one row of an own unprotected process **When** Shift+Delete **Then** `Signal(Kill)` is sent at once and the toast "End process requested." shows.
- **Given** two rows of the same process **When** End Task is confirmed **Then** the request has one target.
- **Given** a row **When** Enter **Then** the jump entry point is called with its key.
- **Given** 100,000 hits **Then** the status reads "Showing the first 100 000 matches.".
